text: Dueling Shield is a weapon in the Thrusting Shields category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 9.0 and requires: Str 15, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Shield Strike. A "thrusting shield," or combined weapon and shield. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously. An armament once used in ritual combat performed to honor the Erdtreea custom that had somehow remained within the realm of shadow.

Carian Thrusting Shield is a weapon in the Thrusting Shields category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 10.5 and requires: Str 17, Dex 13, Int 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Shield Strike. Silver thrusting shield embedded with glintstones. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously. Once wielded by Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, during her sole entry into ritual combata demonstration of fidelity to the Erdtree.

Dryleaf Arts is a weapon in the Hand-to-Hand Arts category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Palm Blast. A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art combines fist strikes and kicks. The teachings of a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect, revealed only to those of worthy valor and character. The practice of this martial art marks the dawn of an ascetic's journey.

Dane's Footwork is a weapon in the Hand-to-Hand Arts category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Palm Blast. A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art focuses on kicking techniques. This kick-based martial art is unique to Dane, a Dryleaf and sworn ally of Leda. He acquired these skills by training with the aid of a waterfall; letting the water beat his body, and throwing himself into its basin.

Smithscript Dagger is a weapon in the Throwing Blades category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 5, Dex 11, Int 11, Fai 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Piercing Throw. Dagger engraved with a smithscript. Reduced mass enhances the effects of the smithing arts, allowing this weapon to function as a throwing dagger for all attacks. Once thrown, the dagger instantly reappears in the wielder's hand.

Backhand Blade is a weapon in the Backhand Blades category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Blind Spot. Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip. A type of weapon wielded by hornsent for generations. The style of combat associated with this weapon is marked by spinning slashes and gouging thrust attacks.

Smithscript Cirque is a weapon in the Backhand Blades category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 9, Dex 14, Int 11, Fai 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Blind Spot. Circular backhand blade engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack to throw the backhand blade, causing it to fly in a curved trajectory.

Curseblade's Cirque is a weapon in the Backhand Blades category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 9, Dex 22. Passive effect: (45) Hemorrhage. Skill: Deadly Dance. Weapon of the masked Curseblades. Circular backhand blade with wave-like cutting edges, sharpened into points that incite blood loss. Long ago, this was employed by the ascetics who strove to become tutelary deities as a ritualistic object in their self-flagellating dances.

Firespark Perfume Bottle is a weapon in the Perfume Bottles category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 1.0 and requires: Str 3, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing sparks of fire. The crusade was a violent purge, and the perfumers were not called there to heal.

Chilling Perfume Bottle is a weapon in the Perfume Bottles category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 1.0 and requires: Str 3, Dex 13, Int 13. Passive effect: (60) Frostbite. Skill: Kick. Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing an icy chill. From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens.

Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle is a weapon in the Perfume Bottles category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 1.0 and requires: Str 3, Dex 10, Int 12, Fai 12. Passive effect: (60) Madness. Skill: Kick. Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing frenzied flame. From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens.

Lightning Perfume Bottle is a weapon in the Perfume Bottles category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 1.0 and requires: Str 3, Dex 16, Fai 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing lightning. From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens.

Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle is a weapon in the Perfume Bottles category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 1.0 and requires: Str 3, Dex 13, Arc 18. Passive effect: (66) Poison. Skill: Deadly Poison Spray. Perfume bottle customized by Thiollier. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing deadly poison. There are some techniques of the perfuming arts that employ poison. Upon learning of this, Thiollier threw himself into mastering those techniques, and he made them his own.

Red Bear's Claw is a weapon in the Beast Claws category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 20, Dex 10. Passive effect: (45) Hemorrhage. Skill: Red Bear Hunt. Claw of a great red bear wielded without modification by Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength. "I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less

Beast Claw (Weapon) is a weapon in the Beast Claws category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 13, Dex 11. Passive effect: (45) Hemorrhage. Skill: Savage Claws. Weapon in the form of a carnivorous beast's vicious claws. Used to perform bestial slashing attacks uncanny to humankind. An imitation of the esoteric technique of the horned warriors. Those who carry this weapon wield it as though they have been possessed by a savage beast.

Milady is a weapon in the Light Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 6.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 17. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. A light greatsword; that is, a sword whose blade matches the length of a greatsword, while being constrained to a minimal weight. Nicknamed after ladies of noble status for its refined appearance. With cultivated form, one can wield this weapon as swiftly as one might a straight sword.

Leda's Sword is a weapon in the Light Greatswords category, dealing Standart/Pierce damage. It weighs 7.5 and requires: Str 11, Dex 22, Fai 19. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Needle Piercer. Light greatsword with gold inlaid. Weapon of Leda, the Needle Knight. Deals holy damage. Though polished to a mirror sheen, this blade still reeks with the stench of crusted blood that lingers from the cull of her knightly comrades.

Rellana's Twin Blades is a weapon in the Light Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.0 and requires: Str 13, Dex 16, Int 16, Fai 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Moon-and-Fire Stance. Carian light greatsword embedded with blue glintstone. Weapon of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight. Two swords as a single armament. When two-handing, a straight sword engraved with golden flame will be carried in the left hand. Here, and here alone, were moon and fire ever together.

Great Katana is a weapon in the Great Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 9.0 and requires: Str 14, Dex 18. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Overhead Stance. Large katana with a long, heavy blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. Designed for aggression, this armament requires the wielder to throw their entire body into swinging it. The slashing attacks of its honed edge incite blood loss.

Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is a weapon in the Great Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 10.5 and requires: Str 15, Dex 20. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Dragonwound Slash. Great katana with spines of gravel stone along its blade, wielded by the Ancient Dragon-Man of the Dragon's Pit. Has an anti-dragon effect. Formerly a Dragon Communion warrior, the Ancient Dragon-Man was once arbiter of those worthy to devour the Dreaded One.

Rakshasa's Great Katana is a weapon in the Great Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 9.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 27. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Weed Cutter. A great katana with the tempering pattern of its blade forever stained red with blood. Weapon of Rakshasa, who cuts down and devours. A berserker's weapon used to endure enemy attacks and reply with one's full fury. When attacking, the wielder is less likely to stagger from counterattacks, but will also take increased damage.

Dagger is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 5, Dex 9. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Quickstep. A standard dagger with a straight blade. Though modest in reach and capacity for harm, this weapon is light enough to jab in rapid succession and delivers devastating critical hits.

Parrying Dagger is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 5, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Parry. A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them. For master of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.

Misericorde is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 7, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Quickstep. Dagger favored by military physicians in white. The pointed blade is hard and sharp, making critical hits especially potent. Medicine is mercy. and mercy upon the battlefield is ruthless. Beware the killers clothed as men of compassion

Great Knife is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 6, Dex 12. Passive effect: : (38) Hemorrhage. Skill: Quickstep. Large knife with a broad, curved blade. This weapon is designed to slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.

Bloodstained Dagger is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 9, Dex 12. Passive effect: (38) Hemorrhage. Skill: Quickstep. Dagger with a bloodstained blade. Afflicts targets with blood loss. As blood darkened the dagger through repeated slashing and stabbing, its blade only grew sharper and harder.

Erdsteel Dagger is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 7, Dex 12, Fai 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Quickstep. An erdsteel dagger with a grass crest engraved upon its blade. Carried by the Erdtree royalty for self-defense in times of peace. Though forged to a high standard, the weapon is difficult to wield. Attack power also scales with faith.

Wakizashi is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 9, Dex 13. Passive effect: (38) Hemorrhage. Skill: Quickstep. Short sword with a tempering pattern on the blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. Afflicts targets with blood loss. These swords are considered auxiliary weapons. Yet, one man is known to wield this weapon in his left hand while using a full-sized katana in his right. A demonic swordsman known only as Okina.

Celebrant's Sickle is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 6, Dex 11. Passive effect: Rune Gain on Hit. Skill: Quickstep. Sickle decorated with flowers and many-coloured fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.

Ivory Sickle is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 6, Dex 11, Int 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Quickstep. Sickle fashioned form ivory. Weapon carried by aged Albunaurics. These weapons are evidence of their dedication to the Haligtree, despite never having entered its presence.

Crystal Knife is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 12, Int 9. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Quickstep. A knife made by sharpening hard crystal.Signature weapon of glintstone miners. Used as a tool to extract glintstone from broken rock, and as such a faint magic enwreathes the blade.

Scorpion's Stinger is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 6, Dex 12. Passive effect: (50) Scarlet Rot. Skill: Repeating Thrust. Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot. A ceremonial tool used by heretics, crafted from the relic of a sealed outer god.

Cinquedea is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Quickstep. Short sword given to high ranking clergymen of Farum Azula. Raises potency of bestial incantations. The design celebrates a beast's five fingers, symbolic of the intelligence once granted upon their kind.

Glintstone Kris is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 5, Dex 12, Int 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Glintstone Dart. Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.

Reduvia is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 5, Dex 13, Arc 13. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Reduvia Blood Blade. Jagged dagger with a distinctive curled blade.Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. This dagger rips the flesh as it enters, inflicting blood loss with sickening efficacy. A proud testament to the success of its vicious design, this weapon is perpetually coated in blood.

Blade of Calling is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 6, Dex 13, Fai 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Blade of Gold. Dagger given to one who set out on a journey to fulfill her duty long ago. The power of its former owner, the kindling maiden, is still apparent. The one who walks alongside flame, Shall one day meet the road of Destined Death.

Black Knife is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 12, Fai 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Blade of Death. Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives. A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death.

Main-gauche is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 7, Dex 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Parry. Dagger with a large hand guard. Intended to be used in the left hand, thereby complementing a piercing sword or identical blade held in the right to enable a distinctive style of fighting.

Fire Knight's Shortsword is a weapon in the Daggers category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 13, Fai 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Quickstep. Shortsword used by the Fire Knights. A slender blade that undulates like fire. Blessed with a flame incantation. Further flame imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

Short Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. A short straight sword with a short blade. In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks. Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.

Longsword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Square Off. A straight sword with a double-edged blade. In addition to its easily-inflicted standard damage, this well- balanced weapon can also perform powerful piercing attacks.

Broadsword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 4 and requires: Str 10, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Square Off. A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks. Horizontal swings boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.

Weathered Straight Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3 and requires: Str 7, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Square Off. Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people. Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.

Lordsworn's Straight Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Square Off. Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a servicable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.

Noble's Slender Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Square Off. Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles.Made to be easy to wield. Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

Cane Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Square Off. Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behindhim, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn. Though bent of back and without the brawn required even toraise the sword aloft, still he wished to meet his end with weaponin hand.

Warhawk's Talon is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3 and requires: Str 10, Dex 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of the Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use. The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.

Lazuli Glintstone Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 9, Int 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Glintstone Pebble. A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage. Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made of wood.

Carian Knight's Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 10, Int 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Carian Grandeur. Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty. These knights' swords could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle.

Crystal Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 13, Dex 10, Int 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

Rotten Crystal Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 13, Dex 10, Int 15. Passive effect: (50) Scarlet Rot. Skill: Spinning Slash. Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human.It festers with scarlet rot. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

Miquellan Knight's Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 11, Dex 11, Fai 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Sacred Blade. Sword forged by servants of Miquella of the Haligtree, with a design modeled after those carried by Carian knights. Instead of glintstone however, amber from the Haligtree is embedded in the blade. A sumptuous piece, yet it has never been offered to any knight an ill-starred sword with no master. Skill: Sacred Blade

Ornamental Straight Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Golden Tempering. Slender straight sword patterned after an antique ornament.Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand. After falling from grace, the dregs of the golden lineage sought power and purpose in the past.

Golden Epitaph is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 10, Fai 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Last Rites. A sword made to commemorate the death of Godwyn the Golden, first of the demigods to die. Infused with the humble prayer of a young boy; "O brother, lord brother, please die a true death."

Sword of St Trina is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3 and requires: Str 10, Dex 12, Int 14. Passive effect: (66) Sleep. Skill: Mists of Slumber. Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina. Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes. St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.

Regalia of Eochaid is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 18, Arc 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Eochaid's Dancing Blade. Treasured sword of Eochaid, a lesser, long-vanished domain. The copper coloration is not to be confused for rust, but is a conduit for its wielder to move it by their will alone. Swords of Eochaid dance through the skies

Coded Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Fai 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Unblockable Blade. Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel. Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.

Sword of Night and Flame is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 12, Dex 12, Int 24, Fai 24. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Night-and-Flame Stance. Storied sword and treasure of Caria Manor.One of the legendary armaments. Astrologers, who preceded the sorcerers, established themselves in mountaintops that nearly touched the sky, and considered the Fire Giants their neighbors.

Velvet Sword of St Trina is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 12, Int 14. Passive effect: (42) Sleep. Skill: Mists of Eternal Sleep. Silver sword of St. Trina, now stained the color of velvet. Inflicts eternal sleep. When St. Trina was abandoned, the faint, light-purple mists coalesced into an intoxicating deep-purple cloud.

Stone-Sheathed Sword is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 5.0 and requires: Str 16, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Square Off. A sword that none can pull from its scabbard of cracked stone. Relic of a lost civilization from a time long past, said to have served a ritual purpose at altars of light and darkness.

Sword of Light is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 14, Dex 11, Fai 24. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Light. Sword of light, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar. From the quick of the root, unswerving rays of light intersect and reflect to give the silver blade form.

Sword of Darkness is a weapon in the Straight Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 14, Dex 11, Fai 24. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Darkness. Sword of darkness, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar. From the quick of the root, wandering coils of darkness coalesce and release, their eddies and vortices giving form to the dark blade.

Bastard Sword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 9.0 and requires: Str 16, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut). A large sword with a straight blade.This heavy sword is normally wielded with two hands, but those with sufficient strength can wield it in one alone.The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.

Claymore is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 9.0 and requires: Str 16, Dex 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Lion's Claw. A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient. In addition to the heavy sweeping attacks, it can also make a heavy piercing thrust making this a versatile weapon.

Iron Greatsword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 12 and requires: Str 18, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut). Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept. Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.

Lordsworn's Greatsword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 9 and requires: Str 16, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut). Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Through blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.

Knight's Greatsword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 16, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut). Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title. Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.

Banished Knight's Greatsword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 17. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut). A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. G iven to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

Forked Greatsword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 9 and requires: Str 14, Dex 16. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut). Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

Flamberge is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 15, Dex 14. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut). Greatsword featuring a flame-like undulation.Shreds enemy flesh, inducing blood loss. Scarlet rot is kept at bay with flame at Redmane Castle, and as such, this beloved sword of Jerren's eventually became the symbol of the castle itself.

Gargoyle's Greatsword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 11.5 and requires: Str 18, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Vacuum Slice. Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles. Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

Gargoyle's Blackblade is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 11.5 and requires: Str 18, Dex 10, Fai 22. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Corpse Wax Cutter. Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Inseparable Sword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 18, Dex 18, Fai 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Sacred Blade. Sword forged by compounding silver and gold. A sacred weapon to hunt Those Who Live in Death. Deals holy damage. The inseparable twins found solace in the Golden Order, the only institution not to revile them as accursed beings.

Sword of Milos is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 10 and requires: Str 15, Dex 19. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Shriek of Milos. Sinister greatsword fashioned from a giant's backbone. Metes out wounds like a lopsided saw-blade, and restores some FP upon defeating an enemy. Milos was undersized for a giant, and was viewed as sullied and terribly grotesque.

Marais Executioner's Sword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 11.5 and requires: Str 24, Dex 14, Arc 23. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Eochaid's Dancing Blade. Storied sword of House Marais, the family of executioners who presided over the Shaded Castle. One of the legendary armaments. Elemer of the Briar, the Bell Bearing Hunter, snatched the sword from the site of his looming execution, and furnished it with battle skills from his home of Eochaid..

Ordovis's Greatsword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 12.0 and requires: Str 25, Dex 13, Fai 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Ordovis's Vortex. Greatsword of Ordovis, one of the two honored as foremostamong the Crucible Knights. This sword is imbued with an ancient holy essence.Its red tint exemplifies the nature of primordial gold, said to beclose in nature to life itself.

Alabaster Lord's Sword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.0 and requires: Str 16, Dex 12, Int 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Alabaster Lords' Pull. Greatsword forged from a blue-white meteoric ore.The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic. A weapon unique to the Alabaster Lords, a race of ancients withskin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteorstruck long ago.

Death's Poker is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 15, Dex 17, Int 11. Passive effect: (65) Frostbite. Skill: Ghostflame Ignition. Barbed rod carried by Deathbirds. The birds are graveyard fire keepers; it is said they rake out the ashen remains of the dead from their kilns.

Helphen's Steeple is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 11.5 and requires: Str 19, Dex 10, Int 22. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Ruinous Ghostflame. Greatsword patterned after the black steeple of the Helphen, the lampwood which guides the dead of the spirit world. The lamplight is similar to grace in appearance, only it is said that it can only be seen by those who met their death in battle.

Blasphemous Blade is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 13.5 and requires: Str 22, Dex 15, Fai 21. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Taker's Flames. Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade. Now they share the same blood, bound together as family.Some HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

Golden Order Greatsword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 16, Dex 21, Fai 28. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Establish Order. Greatsword made of light, modeled after the Elden Ring itself. Forged by King Consort Radagon to proudly symbolize the tenets of the Golden Order. One of the legendary armaments. Telltale signs betray that this was once the greatsword bequeathed to him by his first wife, Rennala.

Dark Moon Greatsword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 16, Dex 11, Int 38. Passive effect: (55) Frostbite. Skill: Moonlight Greatsword. A Moon Greatsword, bestowed by a Carian queen upon herspouse to honor long-standing tradition.One of the legendary armaments. Ranni's sigil is a full moon, cold and leaden, and this sword is but a beam of its light.

Sacred Relic Sword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 11.0 and requires: Str 14, Dex 24, Fai 22. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Wave of Gold. Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal. Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of great devastation. Some think of it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.

Lizard Greatsword is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Strike/Pierce damage. It weighs 9.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut). A peculiar weapon carried by imps. Greatsword smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued lizard. Strong attacks allow the wielder to fire the forked tongue from the blade.

Greatsword of Damnation is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.0 and requires: Str 20, Dex 15, Fai 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Golden Crux. Golden greatsword that once pierced the body of Midra, master of the manse. Used by the hornsent in the execution of a damnation like no other. The barbs that pierce the victim from within wind gently around the blade.

Greatsword of Solitude is a weapon in the Greatswords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 15.5 and requires: Str 27, Dex 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Solitary Moon Slash. Steel greatsword wielded by the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Through a secret rite, they relinquished their hearts for heightened battle prowess. Next, they engraved their blades with two crests: one depicting the light of birth, and the other, solitude.

Zweihander is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 15.5 and requires: Str 19, Dex 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut). Just about the largest sword a mere man is capable of swinging. True to its name, it is designed to be wielded in both hands, but those of merely ordinary strength will still struggle to do so.The long blade is heavy and sharp, sending foes reeling back with its broader strokes, while also capable of a devastating piercing thrust.

Greatsword is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 23 and requires: Str 31, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut). A coarse iron lump of an ultra greatsword. Mows down foes by utilizing its incredible weight. Though handling it likely requires the wielder to have surpassed the realm of the merely human, it is precisely for this reason the weapon is used to slaughter even inhuman foes.

Watchdog's Greatsword is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 22 and requires: Str 30, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut). Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.

Troll's Golden Sword is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 19 and requires: Str 29, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Troll's Roar. Sword given to the lesser giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago. Though the giants have lost their minds, they stay inseparable from their swords that are in sad shapesuch that the gold plating had flaked away.

Troll Knight's Sword is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 18 and requires: Str 20, Dex 14, Int 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Troll's Roar. Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone.Weapon of the trolls in service to the royal family of Caria. Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.

Royal Greatsword is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 20.0 and requires: Str 26, Dex 18, Int 22. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Wolf s Assault. Greatsword decorated in royal Carian Style. Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf. In defiance of the fate he was born to, Blaidd swore to serve no master but Ranni. As proof. the sword was imbued with a cold magic at the moment oath was sworn.

Grafted Blade Greatsword is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 21.0 and requires: Str 40, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Oath of Vengeance. The storied sword of Castle Morne. A revenger's weapon, it is burdened with oceans of anger and regret. One of the legendary armaments. A lone surviving champion from a country now vanished was so determined to continue fighting that he claimed the swords of an entire clan of warriors.

Ruins Greatsword is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 23.0 and requires: Str 50, Int 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Wave of Destruction. Originally rubble from a ruin which fell from the sky, this surviving fragment was honed into a weapon.One of the legendary armaments. The ruin it came from crumbled when struck by a meteorite, as such this weapon harbors its destructive power.

Starscourge Greatsword is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 20.0 and requires: Str 38, Dex 12, Int 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Starcaller Cry. Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in his youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest upon these blades.

Godslayer's Greatsword is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 17.5 and requires: Str 20, Dex 22, Fai 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: The Queen's Black Flame. Sacred sword of the Gloam-Eyed Queen who controlled the Godskin Apostles before her defeat at the hands of Maliketh. The black flames wielded by the apostles are channeled from this sword.

Maliketh's Black Blade is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 22 and requires: Str 34, Dex 12, Fai 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Destined Death. Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of theRune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory. After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night,Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that nonemight ever rob Death again.

Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 22.0 and requires: Str 35, Dex 10, Arc 19. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: White Light Charge. One of the treasures of the ruined forges. Greatsword of ancient meteoric ore, ending in a sharp point. Fashioned from an excavated shard of an arrowhead that once was a part of the old gods' arsenal. A capable piercing weapon that excels at thrusting attacks.

Fire Knight's Greatsword is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 16.0 and requires: Str 22, Dex 18, Fai 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut). Greatsword of the Fire Knights. A long, slender blade that undulates like fire. Blessed with a flame incantation. Further flame imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

Greatsword of Radahn (Light) is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 20.0 and requires: Str 32, Dex 24, Int 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Lightspeed Slash. Greatswords of black steel wielded by Radahn in his youth. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. These were in his possession immediately before his triumph over the starsthe swords of a lord who does not rely on physical strength and gravity alone.

Greatsword of Radahn (Lord) is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 19.0 and requires: Str 32, Dex 24, Int 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Promised Consort. Greatswords of black steel wielded by Radahn in his youth. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. These were in his possession immediately before his triumph over the starsthe swords of a lord who does not rely on physical strength and gravity alone.

Moonrithyll's Knight Sword is a weapon in the Colossal Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 18.0 and requires: Str 20, Dex 14, Int 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Tremendous Phalanx. Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. The favored weapon of the steadfast Carian knight, Moonrithyll. Moonrithyll was the Twin Moon Knight's chamberlain. She was also a friend to the trolls, who served the royal family, and proudly wielded their weapons as she fought arm in arm with her gargantuan comrades.

Rapier is a weapon in the Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 7, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade.In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield. As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrust area easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.

Estoc is a weapon in the Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 11, Dex 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks. For its large size, it can be wielded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.

Noble's Estoc is a weapon in the Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 9, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Estoc carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield. Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

Cleanrot Knight's Sword is a weapon in the Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 4 and requires: Str 11, Dex 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long- handled armament.

Rogier's Rapier is a weapon in the Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 17. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Repeating Thrust. Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier. High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.

Antspur Rapier is a weapon in the Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 20. Passive effect: (55) Scarlet Rot. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Spur of a giant ant which has been fashioned into a rapier. The blade drips with scarlet rot. Scarlet rot is an old legend, of which Maleigh Marais of the Shaded Castle was a private believer. And indeed, he eventually found his own personal goddess.

Frozen Needle is a weapon in the Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 11, Dex 18. Passive effect: (60) Frostbite. Skill: Impaling Thrust. A razor-thin piercing blade of ice.Forged by Ijii, the carian Royal Blackmith. Can inflict frost upon enemies, and launch its blade with a strong attack. The blade immediately regenerates.

Carian Sorcery Sword is a weapon in the Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 19, Int 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. One of the Carian royal family's glintstone swords. A smaller piercing sword with a slender blade. Formerly used by the Carian knights of old before the full refinement of their sorcerous combat techniques, this armament functions as a catalyst for glintstone sorcery when executing strong attacks.

Great Epee is a weapon in the Heavy Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 6.5 and requires: Str 15, Dex 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Large rapier featuring a thin, sharp blade. Commonly used in life or death duels.Like its smaller counterparts, its made for thrusting attacks, and can be used while guarding with a shield.

Godskin Stitcher is a weapon in the Heavy Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 7.0 and requires: Str 14, Dex 17. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Elegant piercing sword with a celadon colored blade wielded by Godskin Nobles. The nobles possess skill with the sword unmatched by any lowborn. Despite its size, successive attacks from this weapon are swifter than the eye can follow.

Bloody Helice is a weapon in the Heavy Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.0 and requires: Str 16, Dex 19, Arc 17. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Dynast's Finesse. Ominous piercing sword with a winding blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. Designed to bore into flesh, causing severe blood loss at the wound. The extracted blood trickles gracefully down the length of the blade.

Dragon King's Cragblade is a weapon in the Heavy Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8 and requires: Str 18, Dex 37. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Thundercloud Form. Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance. This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.

Queelign's Greatsword is a weapon in the Heavy Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 7.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 18, Fai 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Greatsword of the Fire Knight Queelign. A weighty piercing sword with a blade that undulates like fire. Queelign devoted his all to the crusade, and remade his greatsword in the shape of the lance wielded by his liegeaspiring to become a second Impaler.

Sword Lance is a weapon in the Heavy Thrusting Swords category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 9.0 and requires: Str 21, Dex 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Weapon once wielded by Commander Gaius. A combination of greatsword and lance. Weighty and capable of being brought to bear with great force, this armament shows its true potential when used astride a mount. Gaius himself was never without his boar.

Scimitar is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 7, Dex 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against armor and hides covered in tough scales. Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.

Falchion is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 9, Dex 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales. Wielders of the weapon employ a unique style that enhances attacks with spinning motions.

Shamshir is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 7, Dex 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Curved sword with a thin blade of ample length. Light of weight despite its larger size, its slicing attacks come in rapid succession. A devastatingly powerful weapon in the hands of a skilled swordsman.

Grossmesser is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Curved sword boasting a large blade. This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge. A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.

Bandit's Curved Sword is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 5.0 and requires: Str 11, Dex 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Curved sword with a light, crescent-shaped blade. Used by the bandits who ran rampant in the wake of the Shattering. Most of the blade is now darkened and covered in rust, but with enough dexterity this weapon may still stand up to some use.

Shotel is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 9, Dex 19. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield efficiently.

Scavenger's Curved Sword is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 9, Dex 14. Passive effect: (45) Hemorrhage. Skill: Spinning Slash. Unique curved sword, notched like shark's teeth. Weapon carried by corpse pillagers who prowl the sites of old battles. The blade is tacky with blood and covered in hefty nicks, making it totally uneven. Life can be sinister indeed.

Mantis Blade is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. A curved sword with a blade at both ends wielded by the Cemetery Shades, the insect-ridden grave keepers. The blade is thin and sharp, and strong attack unleashes a far-reaching slash.

Beastman's Curved Sword is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 4 and requires: Str 13, Dex 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.

Flowing Curved Sword is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 9, Dex 17. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Legends speak of a master of the sword garbed in blue, and his curved blade that was patterned after flowing water. Strong attack unleashes a series of strikes akin to a dance, offering a glimpse into the legend. Skill: Spinning Slash Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

Serpent-God's Curved Sword is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 4 and requires: Str 13, Dex 9. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir. Formerly used to offer up sacrifices, this sword restores HP upon slaying an enemy.

Magma Blade is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 4 and requires: Str 9, Dex 15, Fai 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Magma Shower. Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made. Deals fire damage.

Nox Flowing Sword is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Flowing Form. A grim weapon wielded by swordsmen of the Eternal City, thisshotel has a blade as fine as a needle. Forged from the liquid metal of a Silver Tear, it is thoroughlytempered until hardened

Wing of Astel is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 7, Dex 17, Int 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Nebula. Sword fashioned from a delicate wing, suffused with the magic ofthe stars.Strong attack unleashes a wave of enchanted light. Crafted from a relic of the Naturalborn of the Void who is said tohave assailed the Eternal City.

Eclipse Shotel is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 25, Fai 30. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Death Flare. Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color. One of the legendary armaments. In Sol, the sight of an eclipse inspires a dreadful awe, preventing an onlooker from averting his gaze.

Spirit Sword is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 16, Int 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Rancor Slash. Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A sword that has seen many years of use in the gravesite. Said to serve as a medium for communion with spirits.

Falx is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 12, Dex 15. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Revenger's Blade. Curved swords with long, sickle-like blades. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Forged by a hornsent in the name of revenge. "In vengeance for the flames, my blade I wield..."

Dancing Blade of Ranah is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 9, Dex 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Unending Dance. Decorative swords ablaze with impassioned red. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Used by the dancers of Ranah. Strikes enemies with a dancing assault when executing a strong attack.

Horned Warrior's Sword is a weapon in the Curved Swords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 5.0 and requires: Str 11, Dex 14, Faith 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Horn Calling. Curved sword of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. The ornamental tangled horns allow the blade to serve as a medium for horn-calling.

Dismounter is a weapon in the Curved Greatswords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 19, Dex 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet. A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.

Omen Cleaver is a weapon in the Curved Greatswords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 11.5 and requires: Str 19, Dex 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength. The pattern etched upon the blade is the remnant of a deteriorating malediction. Indeed, when bestowing a weapon, preparations must be made for taking it away.

Monk's Flameblade is a weapon in the Curved Greatswords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 9.0 and requires: Str 18, Dex 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.

Beastman's Cleaver is a weapon in the Curved Greatswords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 16.5 and requires: Str 25, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula.The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.

Bloodhound's Fang is a weapon in the Curved Greatswords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 11.5 and requires: Str 18, Dex 17. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Bloodhound's Finesse. Curved greatsword with a gently undulating blade wielded by Bloodhound Knights. A fearsome blade capable of brutal airborne attacks.

Onyx Lord's Greatsword is a weapon in the Curved Greatswords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 11.5 and requires: Str 20, Dex 16, Int 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Onyx Lord's Repulsion. Greatsword forged from golden-hued meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic. A weapon unique to the Onyx Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.

Zamor Curved Sword is a weapon in the Curved Greatswords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 9.0 and requires: Str 16, Dex 18. Passive effect: (65) Frostbite. Skill: Zamor Ice Storm. Weapon wielded by the knights of Zamor who earned greatrenown during the War against the Giants. In apparent devotion to winter, the curved blade is styled after anicy wind and imbued with a powerful frost effect.

Magma Wyrm's Scalesword is a weapon in the Curved Greatswords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 15.0 and requires: Str 24, Dex 15, Fai 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Magma Guillotine. Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales. It's said these land-bound dragons were once human heroes who partook in dragon communion, a grave transgression for which they were cursed to crawl the earth upon their bellies, shadows of their former selves.

Morgott's Cursed Sword is a weapon in the Curved Greatswords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 7.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 35, Arc 17. Passive effect: (60) Hemorrhage. Skill: Cursed-Blood Slice. Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King. The accused blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.

Horned Warrior's Greatsword is a weapon in the Curved Greatswords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 13.0 and requires: Str 19, Dex 16, Fai 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Horn Calling: Storm. Curved greatsword of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. A heavy weapon made to bring the deft strength of the warriors to bear. The ornamental tangled horns allow the blade to serve as a medium for horn-calling.

Freyja's Greatsword is a weapon in the Curved Greatswords category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 14.0 and requires: Str 25, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Weapon of Freyja, a Redmane. Greatsword decorated with a mane, much like the weapons used by her liege. The spirit of Freyja's training lingers in this sword, enhancing the power of Redmane battle skills.

Uchigatana is a weapon in the Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 11, Dex 15. Passive effect: (45) Hemorrhage. Skill: Unsheathe. A katana with a long single-edged curved blade. A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds. The blade, with its undulating design, boasts extraordinary sharpness, and its slash attacks cause blood loss.

Nagakiba is a weapon in the Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 7 and requires: Str 18, Dex 22. Passive effect: (45) Hemorrhage. Skill: Unsheathe. Katana with a ferociously long blade.Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers. Reminiscent of a reinforced spear, its imposing length can be put to good use with powerful thrusting attacks.

Serpentbone Blade is a weapon in the Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 6 and requires: Str 11, Dex 22. Passive effect: (66) Poison. Skill: Double Slash. Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone. The densely packed row of spines that jut away from the cutting edge are coated in a lethal poison.

Meteoric Ore Blade is a weapon in the Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 7.5 and requires: Str 15, Dex 14, Int 18. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Gravitas. Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars.Deals magic damage.The blade is weighty, known to deliver slashes of such ferocity that the impact is said to resemble the crash of a falling meteor.

Moonveil is a weapon in the Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 6.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 18, Int 23. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Transient Moonlight. Katana forged of glintstone.Masterpiece of a Sellian swordsmith. Light enwreathes the blade when sheathed, explaining its Moonveil moniker.

Rivers of Blood is a weapon in the Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 6.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 18, Arc 20. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Corpse Piler. Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds.A cursed weapon that has felled countless men. When Mohg, the Lord of Blood, first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal, to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.

Dragonscale Blade is a weapon in the Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Ice Lightning Sword. A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.

Hand of Malenia is a weapon in the Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 7.0 and requires: Str 16, Dex 48. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Waterfowl Dance. Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot. Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories. Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.

Star-Lined Sword is a weapon in the Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 5.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 23, Int 21. Passive effect: (45). Skill: Onze's Line of Stars. Sword encrusted with a line of stars fashioned from small pieces of crude glintstone. Weapon of the demi-human swordsmen. When bestowed with this weapon by their queen, the swordsmen swear to find the truth that lies at the end of the procession of stars.

Sword of Night is a weapon in the Katanas category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 6.5 and requires: Str 11, Dex 20. Passive effect: (45) Hemorrhage. Skill: Witching Hour Slash. Sword of an all-consuming, bottomless black that devours even the light that shines upon it. Wielded by Jolan, Swordhand of Night. The blade of the sword is only semicorporeal, and thus cannot be guarded against completely.

Twinblade is a weapon in the Twinblades category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 7.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt.This weapon is difficult to wield, and requires high dexterity. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is enabled with dual-handed spinning attacks.

Twinned Knight Swords is a weapon in the Twinblades category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.0 and requires: Str 16, Dex 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.

Godskin Peeler is a weapon in the Twinblades category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.0 and requires: Str 17, Dex 22. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Black Flame Tornado. Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh. Much skill is required to wield this weapon due to its asymmetric nature.

Gargoyle's Twinblade is a weapon in the Twinblades category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 18, Dex 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles. Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

Gargoyle's Black Blades is a weapon in the Twinblades category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 18, Dex 15, Fai 22. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Eleonora's Poleblade is a weapon in the Twinblades category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 6.0 and requires: Str 12, Dex 21, Arc 19. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Bloodblade Dance. Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds. Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger. Her mastery of the sword was such that her onslaught was likened to a whirlwind, but now her legacy is stained by accursed blood.

Black Steel Twinblade is a weapon in the Twinblades category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.0 and requires: Str 18, Dex 15, Fai 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Twinblade of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

Euporia is a weapon in the Twinblades category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 16, Dex 16, Fai 24. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Euporia Vortex. Twinblade symbolizing abundance. The secret treasure of the tower. Though the blades, fashioned from golden shoots, are largely wilted and darkened, their luster can be restored by dealing damage to foes. However, damage dealt to Those Who Live in Death will have no such effect.

Hand Axe is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 9, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Quickstep. Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool. Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.

Forked Hatchet is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 9, Dex 14. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Quickstep. Peculiar hatchet wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

Battle Axe is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Wild Strikes. A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weaponCapable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.

Warped Axe is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 7.5 and requires: Str 24, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: War Cry. Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance. Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.

Jawbone Axe is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Wild Strikes. Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal. This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.

Iron Cleaver is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 6.0 and requires: Str 15, Dex 7. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Wild Strikes. Fairly large iron cleaver, commonly used by the maltreated Misbegotten. Steeped in resentment, these weapons are swung wildly and relentlessly, often after rushing up to foes.

Highland Axe is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 9. Passive effect: Roar Buff. Skill: War Cry. Single-sided axe used by the warriors of the highlands. Brave combatants begin battle by crying out their names. Roars are enhanced by this weapon.

Celebrant's Cleaver is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Wild Strikes. Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

Sacrificial Axe is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 16, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Wild Strikes. Hatchet used in ancient sacrificial rite. A Deathbird is depicted as a malevolent deity. The power of the rite yet lingers. A small amount of FP is restored upon slaying a foe.

Icerind Hatchet is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 11, Dex 16. Passive effect: (65) Frostbite. Skill: Hoarfrost Stomp. A hatchet with a frost-coated blade. One of several gifts given by Castle Sol in the distant north. Known as "freezing fog," the blade is thought to be a dragon's scale. Inflicts a powerful frost effect.

Ripple Blade is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 11, Dex 11, Arc 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Wild Strikes. Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species. Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.

Stormhawk Axe is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 19, Dex 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Thunderstorm. Battle axe designed to resemble a hawk, with its wings comprising the blade. Signature weapon of warriors who strive to remain one with the storm, despite being so far from their place of birth. Their hearts are proud, and thereby easily undone.

Rosus' Axe is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 18, Dex 10, Int 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Rosus's Summons. Usher of Death, Rosus, who shows the path to the catacombs throughout the Lands Between, is depicted on this ritual axe. The dead easily lose their way, and have always been in sore need of a guiding hand.

Forked-Tongue Hatchet is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standar/Pierce damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 13. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Dragonform Flame. A peculiar weapon wielded by imps. Hatchet smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued dragon. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

Smithscript Axe is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 5.0 and requires: Str 13, Dex 10, Int 11, Fai 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Wild Strikes. Axe engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack or jumping strong attack to throw the axe.

Messmer Soldier's Axe is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: War Cry. Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A steel axe, worn from use. A favorite of those who lost themselves utterly in their lord's war. Capable of performing powerful charge attacks.

Death Knight's Twin Axes is a weapon in the Axes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 12, Fai 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Blinkbolt: Twinaxe. Golden war axes of the Death Knight. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.

Greataxe is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 13.0 and requires: Str 30, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barbaric Roar. Greataxe akin to a huge lump of iron. Recognized as the weapon of choice of badland chieftains.Too heavy to be wielded by those of merely ordinary strength, blows from this axe will flatten enemies, and the force of its charged attack is a sight to behold.

Crescent Moon Axe is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 12.5 and requires: Str 25, Dex 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: War Cry. Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia. Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.

Longhaft Axe is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 12.5 and requires: Str 24, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: War Cry. Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten. Making use of the force generated by its length, this weapon's resentment-charged blows are difficult to stop.

Executioner's Greataxe is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 15.0 and requires: Str 34, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: War Cry. Bulky cleaver welded to a long haft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated armies, felling them like timber. Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.

Great Omenkiller Cleaver is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 11 and requires: Str 23, Dex 12. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Wild Strike. The blade of this huge, loathsome cleaver comprises a row of amputated Omen horns. Weapon of slaughter wielded by Omen killers. The hideous horns cause blood loss, adding vibrant colors to the ongoing mayhem.

Rusted Anchor is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 12.5 and requires: Str 26, Dex 9. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barbaric Roar. A rusty anchor wielded as a weapon. Each of its four flukes is thick and sharp, enabling piercing attacks. While the Tarnished left the Lands Between with their Lord, one boat alone was said to have been left behind.

Butchering Knife is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 16, Dex 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barbaric Roar. Huge carving knife made to cleanly butcher the human body.Signature weapon of the Ogress Anastasia, known to have eatencountless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden. Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.

Gargoyle's Great Axe is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 24, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: War Cry. Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles. Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

Gargoyle's Black Axe is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 24, Dex 8, Fai 22. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: War Cry. Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Winged Greathorn is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 11.0 and requires: Str 30, Dex 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Soul Stifler. Distinctive horn suffused with the power of ancestral spirits. This large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as a weapon of spirit worship.In the ancestral spirit-worshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.
