Axe of Godrick is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 11 and requires: Str 34, Dex 22. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: I Command Thee, Kneel!. Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage. "I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!"

Putrescence Cleaver is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 13.5 and requires: Str 28, Dex 10, Arc 15. Passive effect: (55) Frostbite. Skill: Spinning Guillotine. Weapon wielded by the Putrescent Knight. A great cleaver of hardened putrescence affixed to an arch fashioned from human bones. Gains power from the wielder's arcane attribute.

Death Knight's Longhaft Axe is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 11.5 and requires: Str 23, Dex 10, Fai 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Blinkbolt: Long-hafted Axe. A long-hafted golden axe wielded by the Death Knight. Bears a representation of a decayed golden ring. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.

Bonny Butchering Knife is a weapon in the Greataxes category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 16, Dex 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Hone Blade. Weapon of the greater potentates of Bonny Village. An outsize butcher's cleaver used to dismember human bodies in the making of the great jars stored in the gaols. Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.

Club is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barbaric Roar. A thick, solid lump of wood.Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.

Curved Club is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 5 and requires: Str 11, Dex 7. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barbaric Roar. Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.

Spiked Club is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 5.0 and requires: Str 12, Dex 7. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Barbaric Roar. A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss. Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.

Stone Club is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 7 and requires: Str 16, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone. This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power. So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.

Mace is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 7. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions. Striking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances, Most suited to head on slugging matches.

Morning Star is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 8. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Kick. Battle hammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star is covered in spikes which cause blood loss. Ironic given its graceful name, this weapon often reeks of blood.

Warpick is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 11, Dex 9. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. Battle hammer with a hard protruding beak. A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence. A simple but highly effective weapon, the weighty piercing attack casually rips through metal armor.

Hammer is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 6.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 7. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. Hammer comprised of a large stone affixed to a metal handle.Originally a blacksmith's tool. The art of smithing is said to have originated among the giants.This weapon's striking attacks boast ample weight behind them.

Monk's Flamemace is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 6.0 and requires: Str 13, Dex 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. Battle hammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.

Varre's Bouquet is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2 and requires: Str 8, Dex 16, Arc 24. Passive effect: Causes blood loss buildup (65). Skill: Blood Tax. A steel mace resembling a charming bouquet of roses. Each petal has a sharpened edge, leaving the roses perpetually colored with blood. This weapon reflects White Mask Varre's manner of speech rather well, enticing in its splendor, but full of deadly consequence.

Envoy's Horn is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 12, Fai 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Oracular Bubble. Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

Nox Flowing Hammer is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 6.5 and requires: Str 17, Dex 7. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Flowing Form. Mace shaped like a suspended metal droplet wielded by monks of the Eternal City. Forged from liquid metal from a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.

Ringed Finger is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 15, Dex 9. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Claw Flick. Bludgeon made of an enormous finger sheathed in several heavy rings. Thought to have been cut from an ancestor of the Fingercreeper. Some life yet remains in this legacy of an ancient act of blasphemy, as evidenced by the barely perceptible warmth it still exudes.

Scepter of the All-Knowing is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike/Pierce damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 18, Int 21. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Knowledge Above All. Scepter in the form of a hand grasping a pearl. Signature weaponof Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. The pearl stands for theworld, the heavens, and an eye, representing the many forms ofknowledge, never fully attainable. Even knowing that, the All-Knowing's hand grasps for it.

Marika's Hammer is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 6.0 and requires: Str 20, Dex 12, Fai 19. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Gold Breaker. Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it. The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.

Flowerstone Gavel is a weapon in the Hammers category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 6.0 and requires: Str 14, Dex 8, Arc 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Flower Dragonbolt. Weapon of the Dragon Communion priestess. A dragonstone hammer resembling an ancient flower. The four petals and the flower's core are all sharp, ending in points, and are capable of dealing heavy damage to dragons.

Flail is a weapon in the Flails category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 18. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Spinning Chain. Weapon consisting of a bludgeoning head attached to a handle by chain. The iron ball is spiked and induces blood loss. Blows from this weapon cannot be parried. The charge attack whirls the iron ball around for increased force before striking.

Nightrider Flail is a weapon in the Flails category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 6.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 24. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Spinning Chain. A flail with two additional bludgeoning heads. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds. The large spikes make it highly effective at inducing blood loss, but also demand higher dexterity to wield.

Chainlink Flail is a weapon in the Flails category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 8 and requires: Str 18, Dex 12. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Spinning Chain. A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads. Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.

Family Heads is a weapon in the Flails category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 18, Int 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Familial Rancor. Three bludgeoning copper heads attached to a handle by chains. Signature weapon of Necromancer Garris, the heretical sage.The heads were made to resemble those of his wife and two children.

Bastard's Stars is a weapon in the Flails category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 22, Int 22. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Nebula. Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel. Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.

Serpent Flail is a weapon in the Flails category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 6.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 24, Fai 21. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Flare, O Serpent. A flail with coiled snakes for bludgeoning heads. Fire roars within the snakes' bodies, inflicting horrible burns. Some of Messmer's army used these flails to burn hornsentto brand them with agony and fear.

Large Club is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 22. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barbaric Roar. A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength to swing about.

Curved Great Club is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 24, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barbaric Roar. Large curved club of hard wood, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.

Great Mace is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 11.5 and requires: Str 28. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Endure. Huge bludgeon with sharp protrusions. An enlarged version of its smaller cousin. Maintains all the advantages of smaller bludgeons, boasting few deficiencies while being very capable at breaking enemy guards and stances. A shrewd choice for simple slugging matches.

Pickaxe is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 22, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Endure. Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners. Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept at piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"

Brick Hammer is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 12.5 and requires: Str 31. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barbaric Roar. Weapon made from an ordinary stone brick. Wielded by a laborer who lead a rebellion, and later become a champion himself. Even among other bludgeons of its size, this weapon is especially weighty. The strength of a giant is required to wield it.

Battle Hammer is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 26, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Braggart's Roar. Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.

Rotten Battle Hammer is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 26, Dex 8. Passive effect: (65) Scarlet Rot. Skill: Braggart's Roar. Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike. Skill: Braggart's Roar Declare your presence with a boastful roar. Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed.

Celebrant's Skull is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 18, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barbaric Roar. Large bludgeon decorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. The striking end is a skull too large in size to be human. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.

Great Stars is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 22, Dex 12. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Endure. Huge bludgeon with three stars at the striking end. Though primarily a striking weapon, the stars' spikes cause blood loss.A blood-stained star is an ill omen, a fact not lost upon those against whom this weapon is brought to bear. Landing attacks slightly restores HP.

Greathorn Hammer is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 22, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barbaric Roar. Huge thick horn carved with tree ring-like markings adapted into a bludgeoning weapon. Wielded by ancestral follower warriors. The ancient horn is imbued with the power of ancestral spirits. A small amount of HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

Envoy's Long Horn is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 9.5 and requires: Str 23, Dex 11, Fai 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Bubble Shower. Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

Cranial Vessel Candlestand is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 12.5 and requires: Str 26, Dex 8, Fai 22. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Surge of Faith. Candlestand used in worship of Birac, the most hallowed MonkPrelate of the Giants' Flame. Concerned over the lazy arrogancewith which the monks treated the Flame, Birac severed his ownhead as a lesson to the others, intending it be used as a candlestand. His faith yet smolders from within the cranial vessel.

Beastclaw Greathammer is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 9.0 and requires: Str 20, Dex 10, Fai 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Regal Beastclaw. Greathammer with a striking end modelled to resemble five beastly claws. The black nails protruding from golden fur are said to represent Serosh, Lord of Beasts, who went to become King Godfrey's Regent.

Devourer's Scepter is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 11.5 and requires: Str 24, Dex 20, Fai 25. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Devourer of Worlds. Scepter in the shape of a serpent devouring the world. Thisweapon will one day become the very symbol of the Lord of Blasphemy.One of the legendary armaments. A vision of the future briefly seen by Rykard in his final momentsbefore being devoured by the great serpent.

Black Steel Greathammer is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 12.0 and requires: Str 25, Dex 11, Fai 17. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Endure. Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Greathammer of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power. Guard Counters cause a burst of power.

Smithscript Greathammer is a weapon in the Great Hammers category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 9.0 and requires: Str 20, Dex 10, Int 11, Fai 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Endure. Greathammer engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack or dashing strong attack to spin and fling the greathammer.

Duelist Greataxe is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 20 and requires: Str 30, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Endure. Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.

Rotten Greataxe is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 20.0 and requires: Str 30, Dex 10. Passive effect: (65) Scarlet Rot. Skill: Endure. Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

Golem's Halberd is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 21.5 and requires: Str 36, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Charge Forth. A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.

Giant-Crusher is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 26.5 and requires: Str 60. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Endure. A hammer made from a boulder, used in the War against the Giants.One of the heftiest weapons in the entire Lands Between. After the giants were quelled, and man turned against man in violence, this weapon was all but forgotten. Man has grown feeble in comparison to his forebears.

Prelate's Inferno Crozier is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 23.5 and requires: Str 45, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Prelate's Charge. Colossal hammer with the appearance of roiling flames. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks.Its heft represents the weight of their guardianship. The hammer's head is unusually substantial, and strong attacks' will fling foes into the air.

Great Club is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 17.0 and requires: Str 35. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Golden Land. An enormous club of hardwood. Wildly hammering foes with this striking weapon requires no dexterity; only brute force. While it may seem sacrilegious, this weapon is said to be a withered branch of the Erdtree. Imbued with holy power, this weapon will never snap.

Troll's Hammer is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 16.0 and requires: Str 28, Dex 8, Fai 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Troll's Roar. Mining tool of stonedigger trolls used to crack bedrock. Trolls are descended from the giants, and these were supposedly once used as ceremonial smithing tools. In the distant past, smithing was considered divine.

Dragon Greatclaw is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 16.0 and requires: Str 30, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Endure. Weapon said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree. The claw is enwreathed with lightning, and tears through the dragons' feeble descendants with ease.

Watchdog's Staff is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 19 and requires: Str 34, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Sorcery of the Crozier. Large stone staff embedded with glintstone. Wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs who protect catacombs. The Watchdogs, battered and broken over their lengthy tenure, rule the catacombs and are even said to command the imps. Unique Skill: Sorcery of the Crozier Channel magic into the glintstone to activate an ancient sorcery, producing floating magic projectiles that chase enemies automatically.

Staff of the Avatar is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 20.0 and requires: Str 34, Dex 8, Fai 24. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Erdtree Slam. Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees. The avatars, emerging in the wake of the Elden Ring's shattering, were determined to protect the withering Erdtree's offspring.

Rotten Staff is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 18 and requires: Str 34, Dex 8. Passive effect: (75) Scarlet Rot. Skill: Erdtree Slam. Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. It festers with scarlet rot. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.

Envoy's Greathorn is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 19.5 and requires: Str 28, Dex 12, Fai 24. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Great Oracular Bubble. Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

Ghiza's Wheel is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 19.0 and requires: Str 28, Dex 18. Passive effect: (70) Hemorrhage. Skill: Spinning Wheel. Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. Device of torture used by Inquisitor Ghiza. As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss. The design was adopted for use as the iconic weapon wielded by Iron Virgins.

Fallingstar Beast Jaw is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 21.5 and requires: Str 34, Dex 12, Int 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Gravity Bolt. Part of a Falling star Beast's jaw, hard and shining black, fashioned into a weapon. With its sharp point, this colossal weapon can skewer foes.

Axe of Godfrey is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Standard damage. It weighs 18 and requires: Str 42, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Regal Roar. Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March. This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage. In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.

Bloodfiend's Arm is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 20.0 and requires: Str 28, Dex 11, Arc 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Endure. Weapon used by the bloodfiends. An arm pulled from the corpse of one of their kin, and wielded as a makeshift weapon. Having been sanctified by a blood ritual, this armament is capable of spraying blood stored within when executing a strong attack.

Anvil Hammer is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 22.0 and requires: Str 39, Dex 10, Int 11, Fai 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Smithing Art Spears. One of the treasures of the ruined forges. A tremendous hammer that incorporates as its head the red-hot anvil of the forge. It is said that the anvil's shape is inspired by that of an altar, and that long ago, it was indeed used as such in rite and ritual.

Devonia's Hammer is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 20.0 and requires: Str 30, Dex 13, Fai 19. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Devonia's Vortex. Great hammer wielded by Devonia, longest-serving of the Crucible Knights. Weapon forged of primordial gold, marked by its reddish hue and inhabited by ancient holiness. A torrent of life is engraved upon the striking face.

Shadow Sunflower Blossom is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 16.0 and requires: Str 24, Dex 8, Fai 25. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Shadow Sunflower Headbutt. The head of a monstrous shadow sunflower manifestation of the Scadutree. Then again, it might be just a flower, wielded as a weapon. Much like the Scadutree itself in appearance, a second stalk winds tightly around the first, almost as if in a tender embrace.

Gazing Finger is a weapon in the Colossal Weapons category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 15.0 and requires: Str 20, Dex 8, Int 20, Fai 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kowtower's Resentment. The head of Metyr, the finger-mother, wielded as a weapon without modification. From within the center of the fingerprint that wrinkles the creature's foremost protrusion, a tiny wart-like eye gazes vacantly into the beyond.

Short Spear is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 4 and requires: Str 10, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. An exceedingly plain spear of modest weight. Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, its strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.

Iron Spear is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 13, Dex 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Charge Forth. Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits.The blade is severely rusted.

Spear is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long haft. A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.

Partisan is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 6.5 and requires: Str 15, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Spear with a wide tip. In addition to its thrusting attacks, this highly versatile weapon can be swung to sweep through foes.

Pike is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 7.5 and requires: Str 20, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Charge Forth. A longspear featuring an especially lengthy handle. Specialized for use from long distances, it boasts the longest reach of any melee weapon. Incredibly useful even against foes on horseback, but hard to wield in cramped spaces.

Spiked Spear is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Strike/Pierce damage. It weighs 6.0 and requires: Str 14. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Weapon comprised of a spiked cylinder attached to a long pole. Capable of dealing strike damage when swung. The spikes induce blood loss. Weapon of the Marionette Soldiers employed by sorcerers.

Cross-Naginata is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 8 and requires: Str 16, Dex 20. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Weapon consisting of a three-pronged blade affixed to a long pole. The long central blade closely resembles a katana. A weapon of the Land of Reeds, known for its ability to be wielded as a spear while still being capable of performing slashing attacks.

Clayman's Harpoon is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 10, Int 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains. The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.

Celebrant's Rib-Rake is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barbaric Roar. Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

Torchpole is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 6 and requires: Str 14, Dex 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Charge Forth. Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead. Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.

Inquisitor's Girandole is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 7.5 and requires: Str 18, Dex 15, Fai 16. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Charge Forth. Instrument of torture used on nobles behind the curtain at the Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir. Its numerous spikes pierce the flesh, then singe the wounds withflame. The smell of burnt blood induces despair in the victim. Acandlestick conveived by a thorough mind.

Crystal Spear is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 16, Int 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

Rotten Crystal Spear is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 16, Int 16. Passive effect: (55) Scarlet Rot. Skill: Charge Forth. Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

Cleanrot Spear is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 16, Dex 16, Fai 14. Passive effect: Raises Immunity by 50. Skill: Sacred Phalanx. Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shield is blessed with an incantation that wards off rot.

Death Ritual Spear is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 6.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 20, Int 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spearcall Ritual. Ritual spear used by priests of old who were permitted to come among the Deathbirds. The priests became guardians of the birds through the rite of Death, which also serves as an oath sworn to their distant resurrection.

Bolt of Gransax is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 20, Dex 40. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Ancient Lightning Spear. Spear whittled from the weapon wielded by Gransax.One of the legendary armaments. A great ancient dragon, Gransax once rained calamity upon the Royal Capital - the only time in historical record that Leyndell's walls have fallen. This marked the dawn of the war against dragons.

Smithscript Spear is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 9, Dex 12, Int 11, Fai 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Spear engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack, a dashing strong attack, or a mounted strong attack to throw the spear.

Swift Spear is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 26. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. A metal-bodied spear of extremely lightweight make, being the result of a sophisticated molding technique. Capable of swift consecutive attacks.

Bloodfiend's Fork is a weapon in the Spears category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 8, Arc 13. Passive effect: (30) Hemorrhage. Skill: Barbaric Roar. Weapon used by the bloodfiends. Three tines of carved bone spear the victim to provoke blood loss. A ritual implement for blood offerings to the Formless Mother. At times, the bloodfiends will spill even their own blood using these forks.

Lance is a weapon in the Great Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 9.0 and requires: Str 20, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Charge Forth. Considered a type of greatspear, this weapon has no blade, but instead features a long, conical body designed to pierce.Though heavy and hard to wield, this weapon displays its worth in horseback combat whether mounted or even on foot.

Treespear is a weapon in the Great Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 9.5 and requires: Str 15, Dex 22, Fai 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Sacred Order. Golden spear with tree-like design. Wielded by knights employed as palace guards in the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Deals holy damage. Requiring superior dexterity to wield, this greatspear can perform consecutive thrust attacks despite its larger size.

Serpent-Hunter is a weapon in the Great Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 12 and requires: none. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Great-Serpent Hunt. Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature. When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt their lord.

Siluria's Tree is a weapon in the Great Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 10 and requires: Str 27, Dex 13, Fai 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Siluria's Woe. Siluria's Tree, weapon of one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights. The primordial form of the Erdtree is close in nature to life itself, and this spear, modeled on its crucible, is imbued with ancient holy essence.

Vyke's War Spear is a weapon in the Great Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 8 and requires: Str 16, Dex 20, Fai 18. Passive effect: (65) Madness. Skill: Frenzyflame Thrust. War spear singed and blistered by fingers, used by Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable Hold. Like Vyke himself, it has been tormented by the yellow flame of frenzy from within.

Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear is a weapon in the Great Spears category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 24, Dex 14, Arc 27. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Bloodboon Ritual. Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty. As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.

Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear is a weapon in the Great Spears category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.0 and requires: Str 22, Dex 12, Arc 13. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Bloodfiend's Bloodboon. Greatspear of the bloodfiend hexers. One of the most significant implements used in their blood rituals. Sacred spears of blood are the instruments of communion with an outer god. The mother of truth desires a wound.

Messmer Soldier's Spear is a weapon in the Great Spears category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 19, Dex 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a steel blade worn from use. Being made for overwhelming onslaughts, attacks with this weapon can be charged to unleash consecutive strikes.

Spear of the Impaler is a weapon in the Great Spears category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 9.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 35, Fai 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Messmer's Assault. Weapon of Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a warped blade in the shape of undulating flame. Remade by the forging arts of the realm of shadow, this weapon can be thrown by executing a strong attack, dashing strong attack, or mounted strong attack. Charge the attack to produce flame on impact.

Barbed Staff-Spear is a weapon in the Great Spears category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 7.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 18, Fai 22. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Jori's Inquisition. Greatstaff of Jori, elder inquisitor. The tip bristles with golden barbs symbolic of the inquisition's torture, allowing one to wield the staff as a greatspear. Attacks deal holy damage, and potency increases with faith.

Halberd is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.0 and requires: Str 14, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Charge Forth. A long-handled polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear. Can be used to press a single enemy with continuous thrusting attacks or swept at groups, taking advantage of its great reach and cleaving blade. A versatile weapon for any situation.

Banished Knight's Halberd is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8 and requires: Str 14, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Charge Forth. A finely-crafted halberd intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

Lucerne is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 7.0 and requires: Str 15, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Charge Forth. This polearm features a hard, sharpened beak-like spike attached to its head, designed to pierce armor. Though designed mainly as a thrusting weapon, its long handle can be utilized to get around an enemy's guard with a sideward sweeping attack.

Glaive is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 10 and requires: Str 18, Dex 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war. This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.

Vulgar Militia Shotel is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.0 and requires: Str 14, Dex 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. The vulgar militia are the undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world

Vulgar Militia Saw is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.0 and requires: Str 15, Dex 13. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Spinning Slash. A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss. The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.

Guardian's Swordspear is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 9 and requires: Str 17, Dex 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees. Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat. The power of this weapon scales greatly with dexterity.

Gargoyle's Halberd is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 12.0 and requires: Str 26, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyles. Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

Gargoyle's Black Halberd is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 12.0 and requires: Str 26, Dex 10, Fai 22. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Nightrider Glaive is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 12.0 and requires: Str 26, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. A jet-black glaive with a blade as weighty as a bludgeon. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds. This glaive excels at weighty slash attacks that crash into foes, making it a powerful weapon even on horse back.

Pest's Glaive is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 7 and requires: Str 13, Dex 13. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation. Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.

Ripple Crescent Halberd is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 12, Arc 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics. The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.

Golden Halberd is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 13.5 and requires: Str 30, Dex 14, Fai 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Golden Vow. Weighty halberd forged of gold. Wielded by the Order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Deals holy damage. A masterfully crafted weapon that lives up to its heft, but is difficult for one mere human strength to wield.

Dragon Halberd is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 10.5 and requires: Str 22, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Spinning Slash. Halberd shaped like a dragon, enwreathed with both ice and lightning. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.

Loretta's War Sickle is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 10 and requires: Str 20, Dex 15, Int 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Loretta's Slash. Intricately crafted silver war sickle wielded by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Originally given for service as a personal guard to Carian royalty, the weapon's blue glintstone has been replaced with unalloyed gold.

Commander's Standard is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 11.5 and requires: Str 24, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Rallying Standard. A beaten red battle standard is furled around this time-worn halberd. Even after his lord was fled, Commander O'Neil continued to brandish this flag in the devastation of the rot-eaten field of battle, the sole veteran who remembers this battle with pride.

Spirit Glaive is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 6.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 17, Int 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Rancor Slash. Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A glaive that has seen many years of use in the gravesite. Said to serve as a medium for communion with spirits.

Poleblade of the Bud is a weapon in the Halberds category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 14, Dex 22, Arc 20. Passive effect: (55) Scarlet Rot. Skill: Romina's Purification. Weapon of Romina, Saint of the Bud. A scarlet glaive with a dangling bud-like blade. Attacks cause buildup of rot. Once, in the crumbling, burning church, Romina held the bud in speechless silence. That bud would become her blade.

Scythe is a weapon in the Reapers category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 7.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 14. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Spinning Slash. Large scythe featuring a long, slender blade. Designed to reap, this weapon is capable of rapidly inflicting blood loss while also slipping through an enemy's guard. In the hands of a highly dexterous wielder it is capable of striking fear into the heart of any foe.

Grave Scythe is a weapon in the Reapers category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 9.5 and requires: Str 17. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Spinning Slash. Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between. This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.

Halo Scythe is a weapon in the Reapers category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 8.5 and requires: Str 13, Dex 16, Fai 15. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Miquella's Ring of Light. War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.

Winged Scythe is a weapon in the Reapers category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 7.5 and requires: Str 16, Dex 16, Fai 24. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Angel's Wings. Sacred scythe resembling a pair of white wings. Deals holy damage. According to pagan belief, white-winged maidens are said to be Death's gentle envoys.

Obsidian Lamina is a weapon in the Reapers category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 6.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 25, Arc 17. Passive effect: (33) Hemorrhage. Skill: Dynastic Sickleplay. Signature weapon of the Pureblood Knight Ansbach. A viciously keen and slender scythe made for combat. The obsidian edge relies not upon trickery to fulfil its violent purposethrough skill alone the wielder can rip and rend through foes, sowing blossoms of red upon the battlefield.

Whip is a weapon in the Whips category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. A leather whip. Not originally used for combat, but as an instrument of pain. Through its supple attacks cannot be thwarted by parrying or even guarding, it is incapable of dealing critical hits.

Thorned Whip is a weapon in the Whips category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 16. Passive effect: (50) Hemorrhage. Skill: Kick. Hefty whip coverd in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of sin. Very effective at inflicting blood loss.

Urumi is a weapon in the Whips category, dealing Slash damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 19. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfolk warriors. Though in essence a whip with a cutting edge, it can also be used as a spear to pierce foes.

Hoslow's Petal Whip is a weapon in the Whips category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 20. Passive effect: (55) Hemorrhage. Skill: Kick. Metal whip formed of razor-sharp chain-link blades that have theappearance of flower petals. This work of art is handed downthough the generations of the illustrious House Hoslow.High dexterity is required to wield this weapon, but it excels at inflicting devastation

Magma Whip Candlestick is a weapon in the Whips category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 16, Fai 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Sea of Magma. This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solidflames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir. When wielded as a weapon, the flames become supple whips oflava.

Giant's Red Braid is a weapon in the Whips category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 18, Dex 12, Fai 21. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Flame Dance. Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant. Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.

Tooth Whip is a weapon in the Whips category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 24. Passive effect: (66) Poison. Skill: Painful Strike. Whip bestrewn with rotting, misshapen teeth. Filthy and seething with disease, the teeth are embedded in the whip and dose the victim with deadly poison upon each strike. As the wounds ripen they grow inflamed and ooze pus. The flesh of shamans was said to meld harmoniously with others.

Caestus is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Endure. A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of tough leather inlaid with iron rivets. Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

Spiked Caestus is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2 and requires: Str 8, Dex 10. Passive effect: (45) Hemorrhage. Skill: Endure. A Caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes. Fists weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

Katar is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. Imported dagger design with a rather unique handle. The blade can be swung about as the extension of one's fist.

Iron Ball is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 11, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Endure. Iron manifer of spherical shape. Big Boggart the blackguard's weapon of choice. Not a weapon to be taken lightly, as its weighty blows shatter bones with ease.

Star Fist is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3 and requires: Str 12, Dex 8. Passive effect: (45) Hemorrhage. Skill: Endure. Spherical iron manifer covered in spikes which induce blood loss. Used in brutal games of pugilism.

Clinging Bone is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 3 and requires: Str 8, Dex 22, Arc 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Lifesteal Fist. Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains. Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in. ""O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand.""

Veteran's Prosthesis is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 4 and requires: Str 15, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Storm Kick. Bladed prosthetic leg enwreathed with the power of lightning, instead attached to the fist. Commander Niall, veteran of Castle Sol, offered this prosthesis in exchange for the lives of defeated knights held prisoner. He went on to lead these men as an army of no nation.

Cipher Pata is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 0 and requires: Fai 30. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Unblockable Blade. One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage. The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.

Grafted Dragon is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 20, Dex 14, Fai 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Bear Witness!. The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was grafted to Godrick's left arm. The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist.This weapon cannot be two-handed.

Pata is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Standard/Pierce damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 11, Dex 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Impaling Thrust. A weapon comprised of a linear, double-sided blade attached to a substantial guard. Wielded by the Oathseeker Knights. This versatile armament can be swung about like a fist or used in the manner of a straight sword.

Golem Fist is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 5.0 and requires: Str 24, Dex 8, Int 11, Fai 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Endure. A giant fist of fractured rock. Taken from the body of a golem of the ruined forges. Carved with a smithscript enabling strong attacks to launch the entire fist straight ahead.

Madding Hand is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 8, Int 13, Fai 20. Passive effect: (55) Madness. Skill: Madding Spear-Hand Strike. A glove stitched together from the flayed skin of the victims of a butcherous bloodbath. Afflicts target with madness. Raises attack power when madness is triggered in the vicinity. Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who were hunted down as heretics by their own brethren, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.

Thiollier's Hidden Needle is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Pierce damage. It weighs 0.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 22, Int 15. Passive effect: (42) Sleep. Skill: Sleep Evermore. Concealed weapon used by Thiollier, of a design generally favored by poison-wielders for dark and subtle purposes. Like St. Trina, who blossomed in the deep-purple garden, a rich poison is secreted from within which sends its victims into an eternal sleep.

Poisoned Hand is a weapon in the Fists category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 8, Arc 28. Passive effect: (36) Poison. Skill: Poison Spear-Hand Strike. A glove stitched together from the flayed skin of the victims of a butcherous bloodbath. Afflicts target with deadly poison. Raises attack power when poisoning occurs in the vicinity. Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who have had everything burned or stolen from them, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.

Hookclaws is a weapon in the Claws category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 14. Passive effect: (60) Hemorrhage. Skill: Quickstep. Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark. Lacerations cause blood loss with great effect. Claw weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

Bloodhound Claws is a weapon in the Claws category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 15. Passive effect: (60) Hemorrhage. Skill: Bloodhound's Step. Large curved claws used by Bloodhound Knights. The curve allows the weapon to slip through an enemy's guard.

Venomous Fang is a weapon in the Claws category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 9, Dex 9. Passive effect: (72) Poison. Skill: Quickstep. One of the weapons designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. The black fang protruding from the bronze snake head is coated in deadly poison.

Raptor Talons is a weapon in the Claws category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 6, Dex 14. Passive effect: (60) Hemorrhage. Skill: Quickstep. Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades, wielded by the assassins of Ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds. Besides excelling at airborne attacks, its charge attack mimics the vicious swoop of a bird of prey.

Claws of Night is a weapon in the Claws category, dealing Slash/Pierce damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 20. Passive effect: (45) Hemorrhage. Skill: Scattershot Throw. Claws of a bottomless black from which no light can escape. Wielded by Anna, Swordhand of Night. Engraved with a smithscript enabling strong attack to launch all three claws at a target. The blades are only semicorporeal, and cannot be fully guarded against.

Shortbow is a weapon in the Light Bows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barrage. Small bow made to fire arrows over great distances. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

Composite Bow is a weapon in the Light Bows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 15, Dex 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Mighty Shot. Bow composited from a mix of Materials. Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.

Red Branch Shortbow is a weapon in the Light Bows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barrage. Shortbow of polished red wood. Fashioned by a master craftsman and wielded by pages. A bow which requires dexterity rather than strength to master.

Misbegotten Shortbow is a weapon in the Light Bows category, dealing LightBows damage. It weighs 3 and requires: Str 16, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barrage. Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it.Designed to inflict additional damage by sacrificing range.

Harp Bow is a weapon in the Light Bows category, dealing LightBows damage. It weighs 2 and requires: Str 9, Dex 9. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barrage. Bow fashioned from a minstrel's harp. Sonorous tones still resound when firing arrows. Troubadours sing tales of champions, both in the honorable service of the Erdtree, and the one who spurns honor for blasphemy.

Bone Bow is a weapon in the Bows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Rancor Shot. A crude shortbow fashioned from sickly bone. A medium for spirit-calling, and a product of the ancient hexing arts of the tower.

Longbow is a weapon in the Bows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 9, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Mighty Shot. Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

Albinauric Bow is a weapon in the Bows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 7, Dex 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Mighty Shot. Longbow featuring delicate silverwork. Wielded by Albinauric wolfback archers. This bow requires dexterity over strength to master.

Black Bow is a weapon in the Bows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 9, Dex 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Barrage. Longbow carved from black wood to resemble a blade. One of the most difficult bows to master. The blade-like body of the bow is light and cuts through the air.Though a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a shortbow.

Pulley Bow is a weapon in the Bows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 5.0 and requires: Str 11, Dex 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Mighty Shot. Longbow which utilizes a series of pulleys and strings. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order Fundamentalism. Enhances precision while shooting, enabling arrows to fly much further distances.

Horn Bow is a weapon in the Bows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 14, Int 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Mighty Shot. Longbow made from animal horn. Wielded by the master hunters of the ancestral followers. Imbues arrows fired with magic damage.Reveals its true worth when used with magic-infused arrows.

Serpent Bow is a weapon in the Bows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 8, Dex 15, Arc 11. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Mighty Shot. Malformed bow in the shape of a pair of poisonous snakes. Imbues arrows with poison through pagan magic, revealing its true worth when used with poison-infused arrows. Used by assassins known as the Formless Serpents.

Erdtree Bow is a weapon in the Bows category, dealing - damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 8, Dex 12, Fai 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Mighty Shot. Longbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

Ansbach's Longbow is a weapon in the Bows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 9, Dex 43. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Fan Shot. Weapon of Sir Ansbach. A longbow consisting of two bow bodies and two strings. Unusually for a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a light bowprovided that the wielder has the extraordinary dexterity demanded.

Greatbow is a weapon in the Greatbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 10 and requires: Str 20, Dex 20. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Through and Through. Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary. A greatbow can only fire great arrows.

Golem Greatbow is a weapon in the Greatbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 14.5 and requires: Str 24, Dex 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Through and Through. Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem.Extremely heavy, this greatbow requires enormous strength just to draw, suggesting it was not designed for human use.

Erdtree Greatbow is a weapon in the Greatbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 11 and requires: Str 20, Dex 14, Fai 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Through and Through. Greatbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Great Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

Lion Greatbow is a weapon in the Greatbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 9.5 and requires: Str 22, Dex 18. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Radahn's Rain. Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion mane motif. Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.

Igon's Greatbow is a weapon in the Greatbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 12.5 and requires: Str 23, Dex 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Igon's Drake Hunt. Weapon of Igon, the broken drake warrior. A greatbow fashioned from two dragon bones bound with coarse rope. Covered in gashes left by claws. Imbued with Igon's obsession, enhancing the power of Igon's Harpoon.

Soldier's Crossbow is a weapon in the Crossbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

Light Crossbow is a weapon in the Crossbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 12, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. Ranged weapon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

Heavy Crossbow is a weapon in the Crossbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 5.5 and requires: Str 14, Dex 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt. Commonly employed in the Shattering.

Arbalest is a weapon in the Crossbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 6.0 and requires: Str 18, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. Large crossbow made from composite materials. One of the largest of all bolt firing devices. Its limbs are more pliable than metallic ones, allowing bolts fired from this weapon to pierce even forged of steel.

Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow is a weapon in the Crossbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 5.0 and requires: Str 14, Dex 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range. Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.

Pulley Crossbow is a weapon in the Crossbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 16, Dex 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. Crossbow made with pulleys and power springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism. One touch fires a volley of bolts. Be warned; large stores of bolts can be quickly spent.

Full Moon Crossbow is a weapon in the Crossbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 10, Int 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. One-of-a-kind enchanted crossbow of exquisitely detailed craftsmanship. Made to celebrate the matrimonial union, and reconciliation, between the houses of the Erdtree and the Full Moon, Leyndell and Raya Lucaria. The two rings dance when reloading the weapon. Reveals true worth when used with holy- infused bolts.

Repeating Crossbow is a weapon in the Crossbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 6.0 and requires: Str 13, Dex 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Repeating Fire. A mechanized crossbow that has been fitted with a fan-shaped contraption. This metallic piece adds a reloading system used in the execution of a unique battle art.

Spread Crossbow is a weapon in the Crossbows category, dealing None damage. It weighs 5.0 and requires: Str 11, Dex 17. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. A modified crossbow made by combining two crossbows into one. Capable of loading multiple bolts and firing them simultaneously, enabling a spread of fire.

Hand Ballista is a weapon in the Ballistas category, dealing None damage. It weighs 10.0 and requires: Str 30, Dex 14. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. An unconventional ballistic device modeled on a weapon used to besiege castles. Only capable of firing greatbolts. Perfect for reckless acts such as storming a castle or facing an entire army alone.

Jar Cannon is a weapon in the Ballistas category, dealing None damage. It weighs 15.0 and requires: Str 34, Dex 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. Jar cannon which uses explosives to fire greatbolts. Deals great damage but is slow to reload. Experimental firearm brought to the assault on Volcano Manor, where it was discovered that no one knew how to use it.

Rabbath's Cannon is a weapon in the Ballistas category, dealing None damage. It weighs 15.0 and requires: Str 28, Dex 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Kick. A type of jar cannon used to fire greatbolts. A masterwork of Spellmachinist Rabbath. The power of the glintstones that encircle the barrel imbues bolts with magic damage and guides shots toward their targets.

Astrologer's Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 7, Int 16. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. Staff of the astrologers. A glintsone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries. Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

Glintstone Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 6, Int 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries. Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

Academy Glintstone Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3 and requires: Str 6, Int 28. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. Staff of the Academy of Raya Lucaria,embedded with a turquoise glintstone. Only a recognized sorcerer is permitted to wield this staff.

Digger's Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 8, Int 12. Passive effect: Boosts Stonedigger Sorcery. Skill: No Skill. Staff of a sorcerer-miner who extracts glintstone from crystal tunnels. The staff itself is a tool used to mine, and the ferrule is also embedded with a glintstone. Boosts the power of Stonedigger sorceries

Demi-Human Queen's Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 6, Int 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. Glintstone staff styled as a scepter. A gift once given to the demi-humans to foster peace, it can be wielded even by those of low intelligence. Sneered at by fools in the academy.

Azur's Glintstone Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 10, Int 52. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Azur. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it. Reduces casting time of all sorceries, but consumes additional FP.

Lusat's Glintstone Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 4.0 and requires: Str 10, Int 52. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Lusat. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it. Enhances power of all sorceries, but consumes additional FP.

Carian Glintstone Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3 and requires: Str 6, Int 24, Dex 8. Passive effect: : Boosts Carian Sword Sorcery. Skill: No Skill. Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff. Given to sorcerers that they might enact the role of knight. Enhances Carian sword sorceries.

Carian Glintblade Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 6, Int 22, Dex 12. Passive effect: Boosts Glintblade Sorcery. Skill: No Skill. Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff. Gifted to enchanted knights, it enhances Glintblade sorceries.

Carian Regal Scepter is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3 and requires: Str 8, Dex 10, Int 60. Passive effect: Boosts full moon sorcery. Skill: Spinning Weapon. Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries. Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.

Albinauric Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 6, Int 10, Arc 12. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. Short staff with a blue glintstone embedded. Wielded by the albinaurics of old. The albinaurics harbor a secret; they cast sorcery with their innate arcaneness.

Staff of Loss is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 6, Dex 12, Int 14. Passive effect: Boosts Invisibility Sorcery. Skill: No Skill. Staff missing its glintstone. Wielded by sorcerers who believe that discovery comes through acts of asceticism. This staff only distinguishes itself when casting invisibility sorceries, but that is reason enough for some to wield it.

Gelmir Glintstone Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 6, Int 14, Fai 14. Passive effect: : Boosts Lava Sorcery. Skill: No Skill. Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries. The Man-Serpents of Mt. Gelmir draw from faith in addition to intelligence to enhance the potency of their sorcery.

Crystal Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 8, Int 48. Passive effect: Boosts Crystalian sorceries. Skill: No Skill. Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enhances Crystalian sorceris. The Crystalian's faint cognition is know as the "wisdom of stone." This staff can only be weilded by those of intellect high enough to grasp such wisdom.

Rotten Crystal Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 8, Int 48. Passive effect: Boosts Crystalian Sor. (50) Scarlet Rot. Skill: No Skill. Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.

Meteorite Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing StrikeDamage damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 6, Int 18. Passive effect: Boosts Gravity Sorcery. Skill: No Skill. Staff embedded with a dark purple glintstone, said to be the fragment of a meteorite. Boasts high sorcery scaling and boosts gravity sorceries as well.However, this staff cannot be strengthened in any way.

Staff of the Guilty is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 4.5 and requires: Str 8, Fai 12. Passive effect: (45) Boosts Thorn Sorcery Hemorrhage. Skill: No Skill. A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glintstone. Similar to hex magic. Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when wielding this staff which enhances Thorn sorceries in particular.

Prince of Death's Staff is a weapon in the Glintstone Staffs category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 6, Int 18, Fai 18. Passive effect: Boosts Death Sorceries. Skill: No Skill. Staff embedded with sullied amber, said to be a very part of the Prince of Death. Enhances death sorceries. One of the staves deemed heretical by the academy for its ability to allow sorceries to be augmented through faith in addition to intelligence.

Staff of the Great Beyond is a weapon in the Glinstone Staves category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 7, Int 25, Fai 25. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. Staff fashioned from the tail-fingers of Metyr, the Mother of Fingers, and the microcosm raised aloft over the crux they form. Catalyst for casting both sorceries and incantations. The Mother received signs from the Greater Will from the beyond of the microcosm. Despite being broken and abandoned, she kept waiting for another message to come.

Maternal Staff is a weapon in the Glinstone Staves category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 7, Int 21, Arc 21. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. Staff of Count Ymir, who made himself a Mother of Fingers. Carried for want of tail-fingers of his own. Enhances finger sorceries. The crystal ball, though representative of a microcosm, would not receive any sign.

Finger Seal is a weapon in the Sacred Seals category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 4, Fai 10. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. A sacred seal bestowed by a Finger Maiden which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations. Incantations must be memorized first at a site of grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.

Erdtree Seal is a weapon in the Sacred Seals category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 0 and requires: Fai 40. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. A formless sacred seal decorated with an Erdtree crest, once the focus of religion in the Lands Between.Even though the Elden Ring is shattered, and the Erdtree has dulled from its former radiance, earnest faith continues to hold the answers.

Golden Order Seal is a weapon in the Sacred Seals category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 0.0 and requires: Int 17, Fai 17. Passive effect: Boosts Fundamentalist Inc.. Skill: No Skill. A formless sacred seal depicting the ceremonial observation of Order. Enhances Golden Fundamentalist incantations. Fundamentalism is scholarship in all but name. Scales incantation using both intelligence and faith.

Gravel Stone Seal is a weapon in the Sacred Seals category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 4, Fai 18. Passive effect: Boosts Dragon Cult Incantations. Skill: No Skill. Sacred seal made from Gravel Stone thought to be an ancient dragon scale. Enhances Dragon Cult incantations of the Royal Capital. The worship of the ancient dragons does not conflict with belief in the Erdtree. After all, this seal, and lightning itself, are both imbued with gold.

Giant's Seal is a weapon in the Sacred Seals category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 4, Fai 14. Passive effect: Boosts Giants' FlameIncantations. Skill: No Skill. Sacred seal depicting the one eyed god of the Fire Giants, adorned with braids of red hair. Sacred seal wielded by Fire Monks and Prelates, this catalyst enhances Giants' Flame incantations.

Godslayer's Seal is a weapon in the Sacred Seals category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 4, Fai 27. Passive effect: Boosts Godslayer Incantations. Skill: No Skill. Sacred seal of the Godskin Apostles, inlaid with obsidian. Said to represent the manipulation of black flame, this catalyst enhances godslayer incantations.

Clawmark Seal is a weapon in the Sacred Seals category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 4, Fai 10. Passive effect: Boosts Bestial Incantations. Skill: No Skill. A sacred seal given by Gurranq, the BeastClergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantations to be scaled with strength. The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.

Frenzied Flame Seal is a weapon in the Sacred Seals category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 12 and requires: none. Passive effect: (55) Madness. Skill: No Skill. Formless sacred seal bestowed by the maiden of the Three Fingers. Enhances incantations of the frenzied flame. This seal is the mark of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. Scales incantations using strength, dexterity, intelligence, and faith all together.

Dragon Communion Seal is a weapon in the Sacred Seals category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 0 and requires: Fai 10, Arc 10. Passive effect: Boosts Dragon Communion Incantations. Skill: No Skill. Formless drakeblood seal with a dragon communion crest. Enhances Dragon Communion incantations. The sacrificial devouring of the heart gives power. Indeed, Dragon Communion is too primal in nature for the term "incantation" to be appropriate. This seal scales incantations with one's arcane attribute.
