Dryleaf Seal is a weapon in the Sacred Seals category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 8, Fai 27. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. Sacred seal of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Enhances incantations of Miquella. Those who saw the decline of the Erdtree in the fallen leaves long ago braced themselves for the weakening of Order, and embraced a strict faith. And then, they made to serve a new god.

Fire Knight's Seal is a weapon in the Sacred Seals category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 8, Fai 23. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. Sacred seal of the Fire Knights, who answer directly to Messmer the Impaler. Enhances fire incantations of Messmer. The emblem of Messmer's army depicts a golden ring and the fire of his sacred seal.

Spiraltree Seal is a weapon in the Sacred Seals category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 8, Fai 17. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: No Skill. Sacred seal of soiled amber engraved with a spiral tree design. Enhances spiral incantations. The majesty of the white tower, stretching to reach the gods, even inspired a secret faith in the invaders, the people of the Erdtree.

Torch is a weapon in the Torches category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 1.5 and requires: Str 5, Dex 5. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Torch Attack. This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or used to attack enemies. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.

Beast-Repellent Torch is a weapon in the Torches category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 12, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Torch Attack. A torch which burns oil infused with a special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts. Torches such as these were used to keep unwelcome beasts away from treasure troves hidden in caves.

Steel-Wire Torch is a weapon in the Torches category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 8. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Firebreather. Torch wound with metal wire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies. Heavier than a normal torch, but the heated filament boosts fire damage dealt.

Sentry's Torch is a weapon in the Torches category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 5.0 and requires: Str 15, Dex 8, Fai 15. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Torch Attack. Torch Given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.

Ghostflame Torch is a weapon in the Torches category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 10, Int 14. Passive effect: (65) Frostbite. Skill: Torch Attack. Metal torch that burns with cold ghostflame. Tool of the Fallen Hawks who prowl the underground rivers. When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity.

St. Trina's Torch is a weapon in the Torches category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3.0 and requires: Str 10, Dex 10, Fai 14. Passive effect: (72) Sleep. Skill: Fires of Slumber. Candlestand torch that burns with a light-purple flame. The carvings depict St. Trina, but in adult form, somewhat unnervingly. The light-purple flame induces sleep

Lamenting Visage is a weapon in the Torches category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 2.0 and requires: Str 9. Passive effect: No passive effects. Skill: Blindfold of Happiness. A stone lantern carved to resemble a lamenting human head, the eyes vacantly beaming out light. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area. The unusual expression somehow imparts a sense of contentment. The languid ease of one who needs not sight.

Nanaya's Torch is a weapon in the Torches category, dealing Strike damage. It weighs 3.5 and requires: Str 10, Dex 10, Int 14, Fai 16. Passive effect: (65) Madness. Skill: Feeble Lord's Frenzied Flame. A torch made by attaching a dying flame of frenzy to a small spinal column. In a distant land, in an age long past, was born a man who failed to become the Lord of Frenzied Flame. All that remains of him is cradled gently by Nanaya.

Dane's Hat is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.2. How to acquire: This Helm is obtained as a drop upon defeating Dryleaf Dane. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. Special effect: none. The sun-faded and lightly soiled hat of Dryleaf Dane. Worn low over the eyes, it obscures the wearer's vision. Meeting the gaze of another can overcome the senses, often leading to the downfall of those who would walk the noble and solitary seekers' path.

Gaius's Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 8.6. How to acquire: Purchased from the Enia at the Roundtable Hold, after defeating Commander Gaius.. Special effect: none. The black iron helm of Commander Gaius. Part of an armor set patterned after fallen seeds. Gaius was the most senior disciple of the same Alabaster Lord who taught Radahn and Gaea gravitational technique.

Oathseeker Knight Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.4. How to acquire: Found inside a hanging body, just outside the Church of Benediction. It contains the whole set: Oathseeker Knight Greaves, Oathseeker Knight Gauntlets, Oathseeker Knight Armor, and Oathseeker Knight Helm. It also contains Pata weapon. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. An Oathseeker Knight helm. Black with gold ornamentation. These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

Verdigris Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 11.1. How to acquire: Complete Moore's questline. Special effect: none. Helm made from an unusual metal known as verdigris. Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

Pelt of Ralva is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.6. How to acquire: This is a helmet type of armor that can be obtained after defeating Ralva the Great Red Bear. It is known to enhance incantations of what is jokingly called "Bear Communion." [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: Enhances incantations of "Bear Communion" by 15%.. The pelt of Ralva the Great Red Bear, worn upon the head without modification. Enhances incantations of what is jokingly called "Bear Communion." This untreated hide, won at the end of a bloody bout, is just the thing to make a wild bear out of a warrior.

Fang Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.7. How to acquire: Armor piece drops upon defeating the Red Bear located at the Northern Nameless Mausoleum. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. Helm of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. The cheek guards are shaped after lion fangs. Perhaps his fascination with the untamed strength of the wild stemmed from his past as a Redmane.

Thiollier's Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.8. How to acquire: Summon Thiollier during the battle at the end of his questline, then loot his body in the boss arena after the fight. Special effect: Increases Arcane +3. A mask upon which is carved a tranquil sleeping face. The silver hair is arranged in the same style as St. Trina's, increasing arcane. Just once, Thiollier was granted the sweet repose of velvety sleep. The remainder of his days would be spent attempting to recapture it.

High Priest Hat is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.7. How to acquire: Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers, who can be found in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr after interacting with the throne, you can only find Count Ymir there after you have defeated Metyr, Mother of Fingers. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: Increases Intelligence +1 and Arcane +1. The hat of Count Ymir, High Priest. The circular design at the top represents the Greater Will and its lightless abyss, imparting increased intelligence and arcane to the wearer. Though Count Ymir instructed Rellana in the sorcerous arts, he abandoned his allegiance to the moon. "It was merely the closest of the celestial bodies. Nothing more."

Caterpillar Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.4. How to acquire: Complete Hornsent quest.. Special effect: none. Grotesque mask constructed from countless solidified caterpillars. A ritual implement of the greater potentates of Bonny Village. Used to ward off thoughts of impurity, doubt, temptation, and other wickednesses one is vulnerable to while absorbed in divine ritual.

Dancer's Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.0. How to acquire: Dropped by defeating Dancer of Ranah at the Southern Nameless Mausoleum [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. Special effect: Enhances the power of dancing attacks by 2.5%.. Bright-red hood of the Ranah dancers. Enhances the power of dancing attacks. The dance of Ranah is one of burning passion, and the most passionate dancers never allow their fiery dance to end, losing even their names as they dance on. To see the passion fade is to see the dancer's flame extinguished.

Helm of Night is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.0. How to acquire: Bonny Gaol: Use the jar lift near the bridge twice to reach the top level of the gaol. First, hop on the jar, go to the bridge level, and activate the switch. Ride the jar lift for the second time to go to the top level. You can find the Night Set on a corpse laying on top of a table. [See SOTE Elden Ring DLC Map] [Video Link]. Special effect: none. Bottomless black helm, cool to the touch.Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

Igon's Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.3. How to acquire: Loot Igon after defeating Bayle the Dread.. Special effect: none. Helm of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set of armor comprised of a miscellany of parts. This tattered protective-wear is shaped like a bugle. The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

Igon's Helm (Altered) is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.0. How to acquire: Alter Igon's Helm at any Site of Grace. Special effect: none. Helm of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set of armor comprised of a miscellany of parts. Patched with scraps of cloth. The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

Wise Man's Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.0. How to acquire: Complete Sir Ansbach's questline all the way through the end, and side with him when facing Leda, and then Promised Consort Radahn/ Radahn, Consort of Miquella. After the fight is over, Sir Ansbach's body will be near the site of grace, alongside with his equipment and his Incantation. [Map Link]. Special effect: Enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills by 5%.. The iron mask of Sir Ansbach, giving the appearance of a quiet, wise, old bearded man. But an old fear lurks beneath, together with the cold, unflinching discipline that once honed his blade, now employed to enhance Blood Oath and dynastic skills.

Freyja's Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.8. How to acquire: Drop by Redmane Freyja.. Special effect: none. Golden helm of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights. A hideous scarlet wound was once hewn into the center of her face. Later, Miquella gently put his lips to it and the unfading scar became the compass that Freyja would thereafter follow.

Helm of Solitude is a piece of helm armor weighing 10.3. How to acquire: Can be obtained after defeating the Blackgaol Knight found inside Northern Nameless Mausoleum. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. Steel helm of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel. The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

Messmer Soldier Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.0. How to acquire: Drop from Messmer Soldiers. Special effect: none. Helm worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. The iron helm features a visor. Though the engraving upon the forehead is a Scadutree design, it is etched in gold. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

Black Knight Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.9. How to acquire: Black Knight Set pieces are dropped from Black Knights, found throughout the Lands of Shadow.. Special effect: none. Helm worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it. Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.

Rakshasa Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.5. How to acquire: Dropped by Rakshasa in Eastern Nameless Mausoleum. This area can only be accessed by using the ladder in Shadow Keep to get down to a special teleport coffin (this Elden Ring Map location). This will take you to Ruins of Unte and you must follow the cliffs downstream and then carefully drop down to bottom level to reach the mausoleum. [Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: Boosts All Damage by 2%. Helm of Rakshasa, soaked in the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free.Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer.Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.

Fire Knight Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.0. How to acquire: Drop by Fire Knights in the Shadow Keep. Special effect: Slightly increases maximum HP by 2%, Stamina by 5%, and Equip Load by 4%.. Pointed helm of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command. Slightly increases maximum HP, stamina, and maximum equip load. Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

Death Mask Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.4. How to acquire: Drops from a Fire Knight miniboss in the cathedral area of Shadow Keep, after draining out the water.. Special effect: Reduces FP to summon spirits by 12%. Helm of Wego, elder among the Fire Knights. Two warped death masks stacked one atop the other. Reduces FP used to summon spirits. Gnawed at by loneliness, the old man turned his attention to the spirituality of Messmer's flame, using it in a rite of resurrection. Yet the soulless bodies he brought to life were no comfort to poor Wego.

Winged Serpent Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.6. How to acquire: Shadow Keep: Sixth Floor: Climb the statues once you've used the lever to move them. Head outside, turn right and head up the stairs, turn left to find a Fire Knight at the end of the bridge. Drops this item and Ash of War: Flame Spear. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: Enhances Fire Knight skills by 10%.. Helm of Kood, captain of the Fire Knights. A winged serpent perches atop it. Enhances Fire Knight skills. The winged serpent is the token creature of Messmer's military forces. It is a wise friend which keeps the base serpent at bay and holds its power in check.

Salza's Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.8. How to acquire: From the West Rampart Site of Grace, take the bridge all the way. Use Torrent to avoid being trappped in the Rain of Fire. Defeat the Fire Knight at the end to obtain this and Rain of Fire. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: Increases Intelligence +2. Hood of Salza, sage of the Fire Knights.A prodigious amount of cloth wound around it, giving the impression of a greatly swollen head, and wearing it increases intelligence.A disciple of the elder Wego, he refused to burn down an old ruin, at the risk of his own life.

Leather Headband is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.0. How to acquire: To the northwest of the Ravine North Site of Grace, there is a forest inhabited by runebears. At the center of this forest, you'll find a large stone with several items on it, this whole armor set is at the top of the stone. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. Headband worn by highland warriors, made of woven leather. The white favor represents their home settlement. Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

Leather Crown is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.3. How to acquire: Found laying on the grounds in the middle of the woods, alongside the rest of the Highland Warrior Set. [Map Link]. Special effect: none. Helm worn by highland warriors, pieced together using leather. The white favor represents their home settlement. Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

Death Knight Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.6. How to acquire: Darklight Catacombs, on a Death Knight corpse. Special effect: Enhances skills and incantations of the ancient dragon cult by 2%.. Golden helm of the Death Knights, whose own death masks served as the visards of their armor. Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The decayed golden wheel that adorns it represents their unbroken loyalty to Godwyn, he who became Prince of Death.

Curseblade Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.2. How to acquire: Drop by Curseblade enemies.. Special effect: Increases Dexterity by +5, but reduces the flask value by -7%. A mask affixed with a crown of tangled horns, worn by those who would invoke divinity. Divine invocation heightens the dexterity of the wearer, but causes the blessing of the Erdtree to become nauseating, reducing the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears. Focus is also troubled by wearing this mask.

Messmer's Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.6. How to acquire: Purchase from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Messmer the Impaler. Special effect: Slightly enhances incantations of Messmer's fire and Fire Knight skills by 3%.. Black helm of Messmer the Impaler, crowned with two intertwined winged serpents.Slightly enhances incantations of Messmer's flame as well as Fire Knight skills.The winged snakes were Messmer's constant companions.They were there when the base serpent was sealed away behind his eye. They were there through his eternity of suffering. They will accompany him yet, in his hideous new form born when he destroyed the grace granted by his mother. They have accepted his fate as much as he.

Messmer's Helm (Altered) is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.3. How to acquire: Alter Messmer's Helm at any site of grace.. Special effect: Slightly enhances incantations of Messmer's fire and Fire Knight skills by 3%.. Black helm of Messmer the Impaler, crowned with two intertwined winged serpents. Slightly enhances incantations of Messmer's fire as well as Fire Knight skills.The winged snakes were Messmer's constant companions.They were there when the base serpent was sealed away behind his eye. They were there through his eternity of suffering. They will accompany him yet, in his hideous new form born when he destroyed the grace granted by his mother. They have accepted his fate as much as he.

Gravebird Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.6. How to acquire: From the Spiral Rise site of grace, climb the spire until you get the elevator shortcut back down. Ride the lift down and jump off halfway into a central altar. [Map Link]. Special effect: Empowers spells which summon rings of spectral light by 15%.. Stone helm with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird. Empowers spells which summon rings of spectral light. Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

Common Soldier Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.8. How to acquire: Drop by soldiers in Castle Ensis. Special effect: none. Helm of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army. A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

Horned Warrior Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.6. How to acquire: Dropped from Horned Warriors. Special effect: Increases Strength by +5, but decreases healing from Flask of Crimson Tears by -7%.. Helm featuring a crown of sturdy tangled horns, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Attire of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. Divine invocation bolsters the strength of the wearer, but causes the blessing of the Erdtree to become nauseating, reducing the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears. Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.

Divine Beast Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: Dropped by Divine Beast Warriors, Enir Ilim. Special effect: Heightens intensity of the storm by 4%, boost Strength by +3 and Dexerity by +3, but reduces restorative effect of sacred tears by -9% and lower focus by -45. A helm of tangled horn attached to a divine beast mask, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Worn by divine beast warriors; the chosen of the horned warriors. Divine invocation heightens intensity of the storm alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears. Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.

Divine Bird Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.6. How to acquire: Dropped by Divine Bird Warriors. Special effect: Heightens the power of divine bird feathers by 10%, boost Strength by +3 and Dexerity by +4, but reduces restorative effect of sacred tears by -9% and lower focus by -45. A helm of tangled horn attached to a divine bird mask, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Worn by divine bird warriors; the very first of all horned warriors. Divine invocation heightens the power of divine bird feathers alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears. Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.

Rellana's Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: The complete set (Rellana's Set) can be bought from Enia in the Roundtable Hold upon defeating Rellana Twin Moon Knight.. Special effect: none. Ornate helm of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel. Rennala, head of the royal family of Caria, was said to have given her younger sister, who renounced her lineage to chase after Messmer, a gift of lustrous black hair.

Young Lion's Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 6.4. How to acquire: Purchase from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Promised Consort Radahn / Radahn, Consort of Miquella in Enir-Ilim [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. The golden helm worn by Radahn in his younger years. Proudly displaying his heroic red hair, it is fitting attire for a lion. When Malenia, Blade of Miquella, let the rotflower blossom in Aeonia, Radahn heard a murmur in his ear "Miquella awaits thee, O promised consort."

Circlet of Light is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.0. How to acquire: Obtained after defeating Promised Consort Radhan. Special effect: +1 to Intelligence, Faith, and ArcaneBoosts the power of Miquella's Light. The circlet of light which adorned Miquella's head as he returned in divine aspect. It has begun to fade into nothingness. Slightly boosts intelligence, faith, and arcane, while also boosting the power of Miquella's light. This circle was to be the very foundation upon which Miquella's age of compassion would be built, should it have ever come to pass.

Shadow Militiaman Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.0. How to acquire: Dropped by the Shadow men. Special effect: none. Helm as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen. Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

Divine Beast Head is a piece of helm armor weighing 10.6. How to acquire: The Divine Beast Dancing Lion drops this Helm upon defeat. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: Heightens intensity of the storm by 10%, boost Strength by +4 and Dexerity by +4, but reduces restorative effect of sacred tears by -11% and lower focus by -63. Ritual headwear in the form of a divine beast's head, used to perform the lion dance. Worn by the very finest of the sculpted keepers. Alas, it no longer responds to the old woman's earnest prayer. Divine invocation heightens intensity of the storm alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears. Focus is also troubled by wearing this headwear.

St. Trina's Blossom is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.0. How to acquire: Garden of Deep Purple: After completing Thiollier and St. Trina's questline, return to her cave in Garden of Deep Purple. You can pick up this item from her fallen body. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Elden Ring DLC Map]. Special effect: Boosts max FP by 6%.. St. Trina's life withered and fell, as fleeting as the seasons. At her last, she left a single water lily. Slightly boosts max FP. Despite the velvety-purple hue, the flower is in no way poisonousit merely blooms in quietude.

Crucible Hammer-Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 7.5. How to acquire: Dropped by Devonia, Crucible Knight [Map Link]. Special effect: Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible Incantations.. Helm worn by Devonia, longest-serving of the Crucible Knights. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations. It is said Devonia quested in search of the Crucible's origin, and departed from the lands of the Erdtree alone.

Greatjar is a piece of helm armor weighing 12.3. How to acquire: Belurat Gaol: After leaving the jar labyrinth, you will pass a small bridge and fight 3 Mutated Prisoners, on quite a large platform. In order to advance the dungeon, you have to step on the jar at the end of the area, but don't do that. Instead, turn right to find another jar on a slightly lower level. Step on it, and it will take you high. Once there, jump from platform to platform, and once the area, opens up, the item is on a pedestal, beware of the enemies.. Special effect: Increases the power of all thrown pots by 16%.. A greatjar which fits comfortably over the head when upturned. Attire of the shamans who perform their worship at gaols. Increases the power of thrown pots of all sizes. They offer their prayers to the innards of the greatjars, such that they might be reborn one day into sainthood. This is the cycle of death and rebirth, taken into the hands of mortal men.

Imp Head (Lion) is a piece of helm armor weighing 8.1. How to acquire: Scorpion River Catacombs. Can be found on top of a platform if you ride one of the two spike trap platform lifts. [Video Link]. Special effect: +2 Vigor. Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling a lion in appearance, life force faintly clings to it.

Alberich's Pointed Hat is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.7. How to acquire: The entire Alberich's Set can be found in the main hall of the Fortified manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital, near the Fortified Manor, first floor Site of Grace. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: Strengthens thorn sorcery by 6%.. Mad Tongue Alberich's pointed hat, a sign of a heretical practitioner. Set with red glintstones said to be formed by the blood of sacrifices. Strengthens thorn sorcery. Alberiches was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

Alberich's Pointed Hat (Altered) is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.0. How to acquire: Boc the Seamster can alter the original Alberich's Pointed Hat if you have it in your possession.. Special effect: none. Mad Tongue Alberich's robe.Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

Albinauric Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.8. How to acquire: Found in Volcano Manor near the Guest Hall grace. Ascend the stairs to the top floor of the building. Head outside and take the ladder to your left onto the roof. Go to the back of the roof and jump off the right side to a balcony, then enter a room with an Omenkiller, the Albinauric Staff, and the Albinauric Mask. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: +4 Arcane,reduces the HP recovered from Flask of Crimson Tears by 10%.. Made from the largely unaltered hide of a young Albinauric.Raises arcane, but reduces the HP recovery effects of the Flask of Crimson Tears.A far cry from godskin, this Albinauric hide mask is the product of malicious mockery.

All-Knowing Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.6. How to acquire: The entire All-Knowing Set is dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing upon defeat. He is fought in Leyndell, Capital of Ash, an alternate version of the Royal Capital accessible only after making significant progress in the story. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Helm set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear. At the end that should not be.

Aristocrat Hat is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.0. How to acquire: Drops from Soldier Aristocrats that can be found wandering the roads of most areas.. Special effect: none. Leather hat decorated with a withered feather.Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belonging of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor.Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

Aristocrat Headband is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.2. How to acquire: Rare chance to drop from Aristocrat Sorcerers seen in larger groups of Aristocrat enemies that wander the roads of most areas.Easily farmed in Kingsrealm Ruins, south of the Road to the Manor site of grace.. Special effect: none. Valuable headband featuring fine goldwork.Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital.Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are pitiful product of unending life.

Ash-of-War Scarab is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: Behind the waygate on the Limgrave Tower Bridge that takes you to the Divine Tower of Limgrave on a broken section of the bridge. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: Reduces the FP cost of skills by ~14%. Increases damage taken by ~5%.. Gray scarab worn directly on the head.These scarabs roll clumps of Ashes of War during their labors.Slightly reduces the FP cost of skills, but increases damage taken.

Astrologer Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.7. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Astrologer ClassCan be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in Liurnia of the Lakes for 1,000 Runes. Elden Ring Map here.. Special effect: none. Hood fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

Azur's Glintstone Crown is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.6. How to acquire: The complete Azur's Glintstone Set is found at Azur's location after completing Sorceress Sellen's questline where you side with her. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: Increases the damage of Comet Azur by 15%, and Glintstone Cometshard and Comet by 10%. Increases FP consumption from sorceries by 15%.. Crown of Azur, primeval current sorcerer, set with a prominent blue-green glintstone.This crown replaced Azur's brain and skull altogether, and now, removed from his body, it is all but dead. What power remains within raises the potency of Azur's primeval current sorceries at the cost of additional FP consumption.

Bandit Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.0. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Bandit Class.Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in North Limgrave for 1500 Runes. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Mask of black cloth that covers the mouth. Favored by bandits for hiding their faces, it also provides some protection against poison.

Banished Knight Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 7.5. How to acquire: Dropped by Banished Knights in Stormveil Castle.. Special effect: none. Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Perhaps the deep-red scarf was used to block the winds, for on the outskirts, the winds bite with a stinging fierceness.

Banished Knight Helm (Altered) is a piece of helm armor weighing 7.1. How to acquire: Stormveil Castle. Looted from the Banished Knight located next to the Chapel in the northwest section, where Sorcerer Rogier is located.. Special effect: none. Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body.This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

Beast Champion Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 7.5. How to acquire: The entire Beast Champion Set drops from Knight Bernahl upon death. Either defeat him at Warmaster's Shack or defeat the Recusant Bernahl invasion in Crumbling Farum Azula. Location in Elden Ring Map here.. Special effect: none. Silver helm engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.The beasts, their eyes and ears covered, represent an oath: "See nothing, hear nothing, doubt nothing, and carry on, along the path set in stone."

Black Dumpling is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.7. How to acquire: Dropped by the enemies found at Volcano Manor who wear it.. Special effect: Raises attack (+10 % to all damage) when the wearer suffers from madness for 60 seconds. "Mask forced on a victim's head to lend torture an extra degree of cruelty.It magnifies one's fears and makes them acutely aware of all forms of pain.Raises attack power when the wearer suffers from madness.When the Black Dumpling goes on, the torturer no longer seeks answers; only to inflict suffering without hope of relief."

Black Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.0. How to acquire: In the Sage's Cave, in a treasure chest behind an illusory wall. See it on the Elden Ring Map here.. Special effect: none. Hood of lusterless black fabric that conceals its wearer's identity.In this world, there is very little that must necessarily be known.

Black Knife Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.8. How to acquire: The entire Black Knife Set is found on a corpse under an archway behind Ordina, Liturgical Town in Consecrated Grounds. Map Link.. Special effect: none. Hood used by the Black Knife Assassins. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

Black Wolf Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.9. How to acquire: Found behind Seluvis's Rise, reached by running and jumping up the crumbling part of the wall near the entrance to the tower. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. A mask fashioned after the head of a black wolf.Relic of an assassin who assumed the guise of Ranni the Witch's loyal shadow. The likeness is striking.

Blackflame Monk Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.0. How to acquire: Drops from Blackflame Monks. Special effect: none. Mail hood of iron links covering a headband engraved with black flames.Attire of the Blackflame Monks.The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

Blackguard's Iron Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 6.2. How to acquire: Dropped by the merchant Blackguard Big Boggart upon defeat. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Iron mask forced on convicted prisoners.Worn by the blackguard Big Boggart.To Boggart, the mask made him all the more threatening, and helped him get what he wanted. But it was also a mirror of his emptiness.

Bloodhound Knight Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.6. How to acquire: The entire Bloodhound Knight Set is dropped by the Bloodhound Knight guarding the Gelmir Knight Set pickup in the Gelmir Hero's Grave. See it on the Elden Ring Map here.. Special effect: none. Metal helm with a pointed beak. Worn by the Bloodhound Knights. The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers. Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.

Bloodsoaked Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.2. How to acquire: Looted from a corpse in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds near the Underground Roadside site of grace. Elden Ring Map here.. Special effect: none. Mask formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood. Even the most ghastly cover is more inviting than the festering face beneath.

Blue Cloth Cowl is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.7. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Warrior Class.Purchasable from Isolated Merchant (Raya Lucaria) Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Cowl of a nomadic warrior. The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer. Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors must remain ever-drifting.

Blue Festive Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.7. How to acquire: Dropped by the blue clothed dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village.. Special effect: none. Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.Use of this hood, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

Blue Silver Mail Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.8. How to acquire: Albinauric Wolfback Archers found in the Consecrated Snowfield, as well as the Ordina Gaol, drop the Blue Silver Set pieces.One that is easily farmed can be found shortly north of the Consecrated Snowfield site of grace.. Special effect: none. Chainmail hood crafted with blue silver.Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

Brave's Cord Circlet is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.0. How to acquire: Currently unavailable. Special effect: none. Warrior's headband of woven leather.Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands.The small flags, white cloths and sheaves of wheatoften found hung from these headbands areprayers of farewell from the people of their home.In bidding farewell to warriors departing ona journey from which they aren't like to return,this small act offers only meager relief.

Brave's Leather Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.8. How to acquire: Currently unobtainable.. Special effect: none. Battlewear wrapped in thick leather.Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands.

Briar Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: Purchased from the Enia in Roundtable Hold after defeating Elemer of the Briar in The Shaded Castle. Special effect: Deals damage when rolling into targets. Damage increases exponentially with more briar pieces.. Battered iron helm from a foreign land.Worn by Elemer of the Briar.The winding, rusted iron briars are the mark of the guilty, and typically indicate a sentence of death. They also cause this armor to deal damage when performing dodge rolls.Elemer murdered numerous instructors and merchants, and was known as the Bell Bearing Hunter.

Bull-Goat Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 11.3. How to acquire: Can be found after killing Patches' assassination target for the Volcano Manor, Great Horned Tragoth. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Great Horned Tragoth's helm, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provides high poise.Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid

Carian Knight Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.6. How to acquire: From the Church of the Cuckoo site of grace, travel to the rotating lift section. On the right side of the gate's entrance, look down as you are hugging the wall to find a platform that you can drop to. Walk on the narrow path and you'll notice a group of Glintstone Zombies worshipping a statue. The entire Carian Knight Set is found at the foot of that statue... Special effect: none. Helm of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

Cerulean Tear Scarab is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: Sellia, Town of Sorcery in Caelid. Found on a corpse on top of a roof in the northeast section of town. Requires platforming across the rooftops. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: Increases the recovery effects of the Flask of Cerulean Tears by 10%, but increases damage taken.. Blue scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of cerulean tears during their labors.Slightly increases the recovery effects of the Flask of Cerulean Tears, but increases damage taken.

Chain Coif is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.8. How to acquire: Can be found at Church of Elleh, purchased from Merchant Kale. It costs 1000 Runes. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Coif made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

Champion Headband is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.7. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Hero Class.Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in south Caelid for 1,000 Runes. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Headband reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

Cleanrot Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 6.4. How to acquire: Dropped by Cleanrot Knights in the Swamp of Aeonia, The Shaded Castle, or Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.. Special effect: none. Winged helm of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles fiercest of all.

Cleanrot Helm (Altered) is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.5. How to acquire: After completing Boc's Questline, you (or Boc) can alter Cleanrot Helm into Cleanrot Helm (Altered).. Special effect: none. Winged helm of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

Commoner's Headband is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.4. How to acquire: The Commoner's Headband is found on a corpse in Mt. Gelmir. After the Temple of Eiglay site of grace, take the elevator up and jump off the outside balcony into the area below. Follow the path past the Abductor Virgin into the window of the manor. Continue until you are on a walkway overlooking the lake the lava lake with Serpent statues on the right side. The Commoner's Headpiece is on a corpse on the head of the second statue. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. A headband that holds cloth in place.Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

Commoner's Headband (Altered) is a piece of helm armor weighing 0.7. How to acquire: Dropped by Commoner enemies found in Stormveil Castle, Leyndell, Royal Capital, and other areas of the map.The non-altered Commoner's Headband is looted from a specific corpse and neither piece can be altered by the player.. Special effect: none. A headband with the cloth removed.Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

Confessor Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.3. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Confessor Class.Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in Mt. Gelmir for 1000 Runes. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Black hood for blending in with the darkness. Worn by church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

Confessor Hood (Altered) is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.7. How to acquire: After completing Boc's Questline, you (or Boc) can alter Confessor Hood into Confessor Hood (Altered).. Special effect: none. Cloth headwrap worn under a church confessor's black hood.Such hoods are made for blending in with the darkness.

Consort's Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.6. How to acquire: Looted from the corpse of Tanith after attacking her and defeating the summoned Tannith's Knight near the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy site of grace in Volcano Manor, Altus Plateau. Mask worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor, in the image of a foreign queen.Increase dexterity.Long ago, when Rykard first set eyes on Tanith, she was working as a dancer in a foreign land. Soon, he made her his consort.She was the only human to remain by his side when he became the serpent of blasphemy.In that moment, Tanith was truly charmed by him.

Crimson Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.7. How to acquire: Stormveil Castle: It is found where the Chrysalids' Memento was initially found after unlocking Spirit Tuning. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: +1 Vigor. A hooded cloak of vivid crimson. Worn by expatriated royalty. Increases vigor. Such cloaks were gifted to those who departed on journeys without specific orders, to faraway lands from which they would never return. In other words, the gift of a cloak made it easier for undesirable to be on their way. Roderika never once saw the guidance of grace.

Crimson Tear Scarab is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: On a rooftop at Volcano Manor, Altus Plateau. Elden Ring Map here. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

Crucible Tree Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 6.6. How to acquire: The whole set is found in a chest within Deeproot Depths behind a Boss: Crucible Knight Siluria. Elden Ring Map here. Cuckoo Knight Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: Dropped from Raya Lucaria Academy Knights, also referred to as Cuckoo Knights. Depraved Perfumer Headscarf is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.1. How to acquire: The Depraved Perfumer Set pieces can be farmed from the Depraved Perfumer enemies located around The Shaded Castle.. Special effect: none. Headscarf worn by depraved perfumers.These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

Diallos's Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.6. How to acquire: Found upon completion of Diallos's questline.Can also be gained by killing Diallos in North Liurnia of the Lakes. Diallos Hoslow had an older brother who was a stern, self-possessed man of a few words. His achievements made him seem out of reach. And so the younger aspired to be like the older. Yearning for the day that he would tell the tale of House Hoslow, in blood. Knowing full well that it would break his brother's heart.

Drake Knight Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.0. How to acquire: The entire Drake Knight Set is found in Crumbling Farum Azula. Black iron helm worn by drake knights.Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion.From birth, drake knights speak not a word. Eccentric's Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.0. How to acquire: The entire Eccentric Set is obtained from choosing to kill Witch-Hunter Jerren at the end of Sorceress Sellen's questline. Envoy Crown is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.8. How to acquire: Miquella's Haligtree. Southeast of the Haligtree Canopy site of grace, on a corpse at the southern tip of the thicker right branch. The soft bundle worn on the head by Oracle Envoys.Densely wrapped in several layers of cloth.Raises the potency of bubble-based skills.No one knows what the cloth hides, but some claim to have heard a faint whimpering from inside. Exile Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.0. How to acquire: Drop from Castle Guard.. Special effect: none. Deep red hood that covers the whole head.Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies, who were required to keep their faces hidden.

Festive Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.7. How to acquire: Dropped from the yellow clothed dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village. Special effect: none. Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.Decorated with many-colored flowers.

Finger Maiden Fillet is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.2. How to acquire: Can be found inside Church of Inhibition directly beside a Grace. Run past NPC invader to touch Grace first. Fingerprint Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.6. How to acquire: Lord Contender's Evergaol: Dropped by Roundtable Knight Vyke upon defeat. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. How to acquire: All pieces of the Old Aristocrat Set are dropped by the Old Aristocrat enemies, often found within larger groups of Aristocrats wandering the roads of most areas. The green cowl makes them easily distinguishable from other Aristocrats.There are a number of Old Aristocrats within the caravan of enemies north of the Agheel Lake South site of grace.Altus Plateau- There are Old Aristocrats to the left of Gold Mask's Bridge.. Special effect: none. Cowl made of soft cloth.Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

Olivinus Glintstone Crown is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: From the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace, turn left and head to the room at the end of the corridor. Attack the empty bookshelf to reveal a hidden passage. Head out, turn left, and then jump up the rocks to find this item on a corpse. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: +3 Intelligence. Reduces HP by 9%.. One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Increases intelligence to the detriment of HP. The lineage of the Olivinus Conspectus began with the sorcerer Lusat, and its adherents continue his study of meteors.

Omen Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 9.9. How to acquire: The Omen set can be found after killing the Dung Eater in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds at the Leyndell Royal Capital. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: Increases damage of Omen Bairn and Regal Omen Bairn by 5%.. Malformed helm resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.Worn by the Dung Eater, their form is a vision of the landscape of his mind, and of his appearance as he wished to see it.The heart of an omen without the body to match; could there be any crueler existence? What does it matter, then, if the curse claims at all?

Omensmirk Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.0. How to acquire: Dropped by Omensmirk and wearing mask outside of Lower Capital Church Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: +2 Strength. Mask with long, hideously twisted horns worn by the Omenkillers.Increases strength. Bears the smirking face of an elder, twisted in wicked delight. This visage is carved in the image of the evil spirits that haunt the Omen in their nightmares.

Page Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.4. How to acquire: Drops from Page enemies.. Special effect: none. Hood worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way. The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen and unknown stature.

Perfumer Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.7. How to acquire: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies encountered in Leyndell, Royal Capital.. Special effect: none. Hood of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.In time past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives.

Preceptor's Big Hat is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.6. How to acquire: Found on Seluvis's body in Seluvis's Rise after reaching the end of Ranni's questline. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: +3 Mind. Reduces max Stamina by 9%.. Large hat with the movements of the stars drawn on the inside of the brim. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals.Increases mind to the detriment of stamina.Glintstone sorcerers are the descendants of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain of aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars.

Prisoner Iron Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 8.6. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Prisoner Class.Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in Ainsel River for 1000 Runes. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Iron mask forced on a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Thick, heavy, and utterly stifling. A foul creation designed to torment the wearer, either slowly fermenting hatred within their heart, or a spiritual fervor that is near indistinguishable from it.

Prophet Blindfold is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.0. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Prophet Class.Can be purchased from Hermit Merchant at Hermit Merchant's Shack for 1,000 Runes. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Blindfold of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Why hesitate, if the path leading to the future is clear? Just close your eyes, and walk.

Pumpkin Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 12.3. How to acquire: Dropped by Pumpkin Head. Can be found in Castle Morne's courtyard, [Elden Ring Map here] or at Waypoint Ruins. [Elden Ring Map here]. Special effect: Reduces damage from headshots and impacts.. An oval helmet large enough to cover any head. Very heavy and very hard.Reduces damage from headshots and impacts.The inside of the helm is pitch black, keeping the crazed warrior within from panicking. Perhaps its rather roomy interior also helps alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

Queen's Crescent Crown is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.2. How to acquire: The Queen's Crescent Crown Helm can be purchased to Enia in Roundtable Hold for 7,000 Need to defeat Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon Bossfight first.. Special effect: +3 Intelligence. A tall crown depicting the moon. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. Increases intelligence. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

Radahn Soldier Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.0. How to acquire: Easily found in large numbers around Fort Gael. Elden Ring Map Here. Special effect: none. Helm worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Its visor is fashioned after a lion's fangs.

Radahn's Redmane Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 7.5. How to acquire: Can be purchased from Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 8,000 runes once Starscourge Radahn has been defeated.. Special effect: none. Helm of the golden lion, with flowing red hair.Worn by General Radahn.Radahn inherited the furious, flaming red hair of his father Radagon, and is fond of its heroic implications."I was born a champion's cub. Now I am the Lord of the Battlefield's lion."

Radiant Gold Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.2. How to acquire: Found on collapsed bridge NW of Writheblood Ruins. Drop down two times heading south and it is on a body. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: Strengthens Golden Order incantations.. A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo.Created and left behind by Lord Goldmask, a staunch pursuer of Golden Order fundamentalism.Strenthens Golden Order incantations.Its striking design represents both the brilliant inspiration that once shone upon him, and the vision of a ring that he will surely find at the end of his pursuit."To you who seek to shine as I do, wear it well!"
Ragged Hat is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.3. How to acquire: Not currently obtainable.. Special effect: none. Helm pieced together from scavenged metal.
Ragged Hat (Altered) is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.0. How to acquire: Not currently obtainable.. Special effect: none. Helm pieced together from scavenged metal.

Raging Wolf Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.4. How to acquire: Leyndell, Royal Capital. After obtaining the second to last letter from Volcano Manor, you will be sent to assist Knight Bernahl with assassinating Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm. On successful invasion, you will receive the full Raging Wolf Set. See it on the Elden Ring Map here.. Special effect: none. A helm worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold. Vargram earned his nickname from the white wolf pelt that adorns this helm.

Raya Lucarian Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.0. How to acquire: The Phantom Raya Lucarian Soldiers in Carian Manor drop all pieces of the Raya Lucarian Soldier Set. They are easily farmed on the ramparts after the Manor Lower Level site of grace.. Special effect: none. Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers.Its brow adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

Redmane Knight Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: Chance to drop from Radahn Knight in Fort Gael. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Helm worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.The red plume is a symbol of Radahn's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son - the mane of the proud Red Lion.

Rotten Duelist Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 6.4. How to acquire: Dropped by a Rotten Duelist in the Consecrated Snowfield. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: Increases likelihood of being targeted by foes.. Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

Royal Knight Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 6.6. How to acquire: Can be brought from Finger Reader Enia, at Roundtable Hold after defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree for 4000.. Special effect: none. Silver helm of Loretta, a Knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.Loretta, once a royal Carian Knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

Royal Remains Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.6. How to acquire: Upon attaining the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right), Ensha of the Royal Remains will invade the players world the next time they travel back to Roundtable Hold. Helm graced with gold human bones.Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.Slowly replenishes HP when HP is reduced.It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord - the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.

Ruler's Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.2. How to acquire: The Ruler's Mask Helm can be found on a corpse laying face-down on a carriage northeast of the Abandoned Coffin site of grace in west Altus Plateau, alongside the Ruler's Robe. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: +1 Faith. Mask in the image of a wizened sage. Customary dress among lords in a smaller nation. Increases faith. Such a mask illustrates the qualities of an ideal lord: chiefly, wise and possessing a certain defanged geniality. One at the center of society often finds these qualities most expedient.

Sacred Crown Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.6. How to acquire: Drops from the ballista soldiers just outside of the Elpheal Inner Wall site of Grace. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: +1 Faith. Flanged iron cap adorned with a crown of unalloyed gold.Increases faith.Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.Who is it that Miquella shall bless, if not the low and the meek?

Sage Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.2. Sanguine Noble Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.4. How to acquire: The entire Sanguine Noble Set is dropped by Sanguine Noble NPC invasion in west Mountaintops of The Giants. Scaled Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 6.8. How to acquire: Can be found after killing the first assassination target for the Volcano Manor, Old Knight Istvan. Elden Ring Map here. Helm worn by Old Knight Istvan.The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

Shining Horned Headband is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.3. How to acquire: Chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shaman, which can be found singing in the Ancestral Woods in Siofra River.The Ancestral Woods area is only available after gaining access to Nokron, Eternal City.. Special effect: Increases the attack power of Ancestral Infant's Head by 20%.. Headband decorated by a pair of shining horns. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.Horns with buds that also shine are ideal ceremonial items for ancestral worship. Strengthens Ancestral Infant's Head.

Silver Tear Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.6. How to acquire: Dropped by the Mimic Tear boss in Nokron, Eternal City. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: +8 Arcane. Reduces physical attack (-5% AR). Mask fashioned from the corpse of a formless Silver Tear, supported by its hardened, shed husk. Greatly increases arcane to the detriment of physical attack power. To imitate the imitator is a cunning play indeed.

Skeletal Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.0. How to acquire: he Sage's Cave, in a chest behind an illusory wall. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Skeletal mask that tightly grips the face.Worn by the assassin's of Ravensmount.This ritual implement relentlessly digs into the wearer's face, preserving one's human instincts while dressed in imitation of the Deathbirds.

Snow Witch Hat is a piece of helm armor weighing 2.2. How to acquire: Found in a chest on the upper floor of Renna's Rise during the progression of Ranni's questline. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: Strengthens cold sorceries by 10%.. Witch's pointed hat, frigid and frozen through. Of a style associated with practitioners of heretical sorcery. Strengthens cold sorcery. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

Spellblade's Pointed Hat is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.5. How to acquire: Roundtable Hold - Drops from Rogier.. Special effect: Strengthens magic and cold weapon skills by 2%.. Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills. Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

Traveler's Hat is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.7. How to acquire: Found in a corpse in one of the corners of the buildings within Street of Sages Ruins, in Caelid's Swamp area, alongside the entire Traveler's Set. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Hat of a traveling perfumer of no renown. An associate of a healer, he is said to be in search of new aromatics and flower gardens, in hopes of treating Misbegotten, Omen and all those seen as impure.

Traveling Maiden Hood is a piece of helm armor weighing 1.6. How to acquire: On a corpse inside the Shack of The Lofty in the northern Mountaintops of the Giants. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

Tree Sentinel Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 8.1. How to acquire: The entire Tree Sentinel Set is obtained by destroying all three chariots in the Auriza Hero's Grave. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Golden helm of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.Very few are permitted to wear a golden wood crest of such size as seen on this helm.

Twinned Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: Earliest location: Limgrave East upon killing D Hunter. Elden Ring Map hereObtained at end of D Hunter's questline.. Special effect: none. Helm depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.The two known as D are inseparable twins.They are of two bodies and two minds, but one single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another.Perhaps this armor longs to find its way to the other D.

Twinsage Glintstone Crown is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: Dropped by a crab in Raya Lucaria Academy. Very close to Azur's Glintstone Staff. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: +6 Intelligence. Reduces max Stamina and max HP by 9%.. One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Vagabond Knight Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 4.0. How to acquire: A Starting Equipment Piece for the Vagabond Class.Sold by the Nomadic Merchant located in eastern Mountaintops of the Giants for 1,000 Runes. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Helm of a knight banished from their motherland.Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey. The visor is broken and can no longer be lowered. Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant damage negation.

Veteran's Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 8.1. How to acquire: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall. Special effect: none. An old helm that has seen many battles.Worn by Niall, the great veteran general of Sol.Nial was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master.This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.

Vulgar Militia Helm is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.6. How to acquire: Can be found by killing Vulgar Militiamen enemies.. Special effect: none. Helm worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen. The upward extension serves to create an appearance of larger size, however slightly.

White Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.2. How to acquire: The entire War Surgeon Set is obtained after defeating all three Nameless White Mask NPC invaders in the blood swamp near the Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum.. Special effect: Slightly raises attack power (10% for 20s) when there is blood loss nearby.. "Bloodstained, faintly grinning mask.Worn by war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers.The Lord of Blood's curse enlivens the wearer when bloodletting occurs. Slightly raises attack power when there is blood loss nearby."

Witch's Glintstone Crown is a piece of helm armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: Obtained by progressing in Sorceress Sellen's Questline. Elden Ring Map here. Zamor Mask is a piece of helm armor weighing 3.8. How to acquire: Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor fought at the Mountaintops of the Giants. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Mask worn by knights of Zamor, hailed as heroes in the War against the Giants. Dryleaf Robe is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: Found under a waterfall in the lower portions under Bonny Village. Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen. The gold necklace found under the breast belongs to a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. This sect rejects dependence on others in all matters of faith, seeking self-discipline and self-sufficiency above all else.

Dryleaf Robe (Altered) is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 4.1. How to acquire: Alter Dryleaf Robe at any site of Grace.. Special effect: none. Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen. The leather satchel hanging from the shoulder is decorated with one of Miquella's emblems, a golden grass motif.

Gaius's Armor is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 20.1. How to acquire: Purchased from the Enia at the Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Gaius.. Special effect: none. Leda's Armor is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 10.6. How to acquire: Found on Needle Knight Leda's body after invading and defeating her. Oathseeker Knight Armor is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 9.2. How to acquire: Found inside a hanging body, just outside the Church of Benediction. These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

Verdigris Armor is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 25.9. How to acquire: Complete Moore's questline. Special effect: none. Chest armor made from an unusual metal known as verdigris. Iron Rivet Armor is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 7.1. How to acquire: Dropped by Red Bear. Red Bear can be found at the Northern Nameless Mausoleum. Thiollier's Garb is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 7.1. How to acquire: Summon Thiollier during the battle at the end of his questline, then loot his body in the boss arena after the fight. Thiollier's Garb (Altered) is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 6.3. How to acquire: Alter Thiollier's Garb at any site of grace.. Special effect: none. The dark attire of those who wield poison in secret.Countless needles are sewn onto the exterior for talismanic effect.

Braided Cord Robe is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 3.4. How to acquire: Complete Hornsent quest. [Video Location]. Dancer's Dress is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 3.2. To see the passion fade is to see the dancer's flame extinguished.

Dancer's Dress (Altered) is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 2.4. How to acquire: Alter Dancer's Dress.. Special effect: Enhances the power of dancing attacks by 2.5%.. Armor of Night is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 7.1. How to acquire: Bonny Gaol: Use the jar lift near the bridge twice to reach the top level of the gaol. [See SOTE Elden Ring DLC Map] [Video Link]. Special effect: none. Bottomless black chest armor, cool to the touch.Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

Igon's Armor is a piece of chest armor armor weighing 8.0. How to acquire: Loot Igon after defeating Bayle the Dread.. Special effect: none.
