On successful invasion, you will receive the full Raging Wolf Set.Elden Ring Interactive Map Link. Special effect: none. Gauntlets worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold. According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean. Vargram aspired to such a state himself.

Raya Lucarian Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 3.5. How to acquire: Can be dropped by Raya Lucaria Knights.Easily farmed from the Phantom Raya Lucarian Soldiers in Carian Manor after the Manor Lower Level site of grace.. Special effect: none. Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

Redmane Knight Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 3.9. How to acquire: Chance to drop from Radahn Knight in Fort Gael.. Special effect: none. Black iron guantlets worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Time has yet to dull their luster.

Ronin's Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 3.1. How to acquire: Acquired by following Yura's questline.Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Gauntlets of the man who calls himself Shabriri.Highly functional and heavily worn.The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart.

Royal Knight Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 5.2. How to acquire: Can be brought from Finger Reader Enia, at Roundtable Hold after defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree for 4000.. Special effect: none. Silver gauntlets of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

Royal Remains Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 3.5. How to acquire: Upon attaining the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right), Ensha of the Royal Remains will invade the players world the next time they travel back to Roundtable Hold. The full Royal Remains Set is acquired after beating him.. Special effect: Slowly replenishes HP when HP is reduced.. Gauntlets graces with gold human bones.Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.Slowly replenishes HP when HP is reduced.It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord - the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.

Scaled Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 5.3. How to acquire: Can be found after killing the first assassination target for the Volcano Manor, Old Knight Istvan.Elden Ring Interactive Map Link. Special effect: none. Gauntlets worn by Old Knight Istvan.The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks.Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survived to this day.

Sorcerer Manchettes is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 1.1. How to acquire: They are dropped by Raya Lucaria Sorcerers in Raya Lucaria Academy.. Special effect: none. Manchettes worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the forearms.

Spellblade's Gloves is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 1.2. How to acquire: Roundtable Hold - Drops from Rogier.. Special effect: Strengthens magic and cold weapon skills by 2%. Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

Traveler's Gloves is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 1.4. How to acquire: Found in a corpse in one of the corners of the buildings within Street of Sages Ruins, in Caelid's Swamp area, alongside the entire Traveler's Set.Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Gloves of a traveling perfumer of no renown. An associate of a healer, he is said to be in search of new aromatics and flower gardens, in hopes of treating Misbegotten, Omen and all those seen as impure.

Traveler's Manchettes is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 1.7. How to acquire: Just before fighting Malenia, at the Haligtree Roots site of grace in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, there is a side room with a large blooming red flower. Melina's Set pieces are looted in front of the flower. Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Light yet sturdy leather manchettes.Worn by young women who set off into the world to confront their fate.

Traveling Maiden Gloves is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 1.6. How to acquire: On a corpse inside the Shack of The Lofty in the northern Mountaintops of the Giants. The rest of the set can also be looted here.Elden Ring Interactive Map Link. Special effect: none. Gloves worn by traveling maidens.Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

Tree Sentinel Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 6.3. How to acquire: See the Tree Sentinel Set page for a guide on how to attain the set.Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Golden gauntlets of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.Imposingly sturdy and nigh unbreakable, the grace of old yet lingers.

Twinned Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 3.9. How to acquire: Earliest location: Limgrave East upon killing D Hunter.Elden Ring Map hereObtained at end of D Hunter's questline.. Special effect: none. Gauntlets depicting entwined twins of gold and silver. The two known as D are inseparable twins.They are of two bodies and two minds, but one single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another.Perhaps this armor longs to find its way to the other D.

Vagabond Knight Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 3.5. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Vagabond Class.Sold by the Nomadic Merchant located in eastern Mountaintops of the Giants for 1,000 Runes.Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Gauntlets of a knight banished form their motherland.Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant damage negation.

Veteran's Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 6.3. How to acquire: Can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after killing Commander Niall at Castle Sol Rooftop.. Special effect: none. Old gauntlets that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol.Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master.This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.

Vulgar Militia Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 2.1. How to acquire: The Vulgar Militia Gauntlets Armor Gauntlets piece can be found by killing Vulgar Militiamen enemies around the Bestial Sanctum and Farum Greatbridge sites of grace.. Special effect: none. Gauntlets worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. This is where the vulgar militia serve, as untiring, unsung watchkeepers.

War Surgeon Gloves is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 2.3. How to acquire: Dropped by killing one of three Nameless White Mask NPC invaders in the Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum area of Siofra River, northwest of the Palace Approach Ledge-Road site of grace, in the blood filled lake. This one can be found adjacent to the Giant Crow enemy near the blood filled lake drop off.. Special effect: none. "Bloodstained white gloves of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers.Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood none were able to tame the accursed blood.None but Varre, that is; though he was an exception."

Warrior Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 2.6. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Warrior Class.Purchasable from Isolated Merchant (Raya Lucaria). Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Gauntlets of a nomadic warrior.Crafted from sturdy leather.

White Reed Gauntlets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 2.8. How to acquire: Spiritcaller's Cave in the Mountaintops of the Giants: Found on a corpse in a long cavern filled with spirit wolves. The White Reed Armor and White Reed Greaves can also be found on this corpse. Elden Ring Interactive Map Link. Special effect: none. Gauntlets of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by the Inabam head disciples of the great swordsman Okina. The Inaba traveled in pursuit of not only the master who abandoned them, but also proper deaths, won honorably through hard-fought combat. To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothingmore than to die by the sword.

Zamor Bracelets is a piece of gauntlets armor weighing 2.8. How to acquire: Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor fought at the Mountaintops of the Giants.Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Bracelets worn by knights of Zamor, hailed as heroes in the War against the Giants. These long-lived warriors, clad in biting, freezing winds, are said to have been the mortal enemies of the Fire Giants since time immemorial.

Dryleaf Cuissardes is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 3.1. How to acquire: Found under a waterfall in the lower portions under Bonny Village. This area can only be accessed by using the ladder in Shadow Keep to get down to a special teleport coffin (this Elden Ring Map location). This will take you to Ruins of Unte and you must follow the cliffs downstream and then carefully drop down to bottom level to reach the area. [Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen. Boots made of sturdy leather.

Gaius's Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 8.9. How to acquire: Dropped by Albinauric Wolfback Archer South-West of the Scadutree Chalice. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. Black iron greaves made for Commander Gaius. A cruel joke, for he could not wear them. Riding atop the boar he called his other half, Gaius was in fact a warrior of albinauric extraction.

Oathseeker Knight Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 6.6. How to acquire: Found inside a hanging body, just outside the Church of Benediction. It contains the whole set: Oathseeker Knight Greaves, Oathseeker Knight Gauntlets, Oathseeker Knight Armor, and Oathseeker Knight Helm. It also contains Pata weapon. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. Oathseeker Knight greaves. Black with gold ornamentation. These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

Verdigris Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 16.0. How to acquire: Complete Moore's questline. Special effect: none. Greaves made from an unusual metal known as verdigris. Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

Iron Rivet Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 5.7. How to acquire: Dropped by Red Bear. Red Bear can be found at the Northern Nameless Mausoleum. The Northern Nameless Mausoleum is located East of the Temple Ruins. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. Greaves of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. Reinforced with iron rivets. After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength. "I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

Thiollier's Trousers is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 4.4. How to acquire: Summon Thiollier during the battle at the end of his questline, then loot his body in the boss arena after the fight.. Special effect: none. The dark trousers of those who wield poison in secret, ever scorned and loathed.

High Priest Undergarments is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 2.5. How to acquire: Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers, who can be found in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr after interacting with the throne, you can only find Count Ymir there after you have defeated Metyr, Mother of Fingers. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. Undergarments of Count Ymir, High Priest. Soft and well-tailored.

Soiled Loincloth is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 1.5. How to acquire: Dropped by Hornsent when invaded close to the Rauh Ancient Ruins site of grace. [Video Location]. Special effect: none. This lightly soiled loincloth of ragged cloth does little more than conceal one's nether regions.

Dancer's Trousers is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 2.0. How to acquire: Dropped by defeating Dancer of Ranah at the Southern Nameless Mausoleum [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. Special effect: Enhances the power of dancing attacks by 2.5%.. Long, black trousers worn underneath the deep crimson dress of the Ranah dancers. Enhances the power of dancing attacks.

Greaves of Night is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 4.4. How to acquire: Bonny Gaol: Use the jar lift near the bridge twice to reach the top level of the gaol. First, hop on the jar, go to the bridge level, and activate the switch. Ride the jar lift for the second time to go to the top level. You can find the Night Set on a corpse laying on top of a table. [See SOTE Elden Ring DLC Map] [Video Link]. Special effect: none. Bottomless greaves, cool to the touch.Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

Igon's Loincloth is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 3.9. How to acquire: Loot Igon after defeating Bayle the Dread. Special effect: none. Loincloth of the broken drake warrior Igon. Stripped from a corpse found in the aftermath of a battle, this scrap of cloth smells utterly foul.

Ansbach's Boots is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 3.1. How to acquire: Complete Sir Ansbach's questline all the way through the end, and side with him when facing Leda, and then Promised Consort Radahn/ Radahn, Consort of Miquella. After the fight is over, Sir Ansbach's body will be near the site of grace, alongside with his equipment and his Incantation. [Map Link]. Special effect: Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills by 3%. Boots of Sir Ansbach. Black leather adorned with gold embroidery. Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills.

Freyja's Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 5.7. How to acquire: Drop by Redmane Freyja.. Special effect: none. Greaves of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights. After witnessing Freyja's valor as a gladiator in his youth, Radahn invited her to join the ranks of his most trusted warriors.

Greaves of Solitude is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 14.8. How to acquire: Can be obtained after defeating the Blackgaol Knight found inside Northern Nameless Mausoleum. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. Steel greaves of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel. The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

Messmer Soldier Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 5.5. How to acquire: Drop by Messmer Soldiers. Special effect: none. Greaves worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler, rusted and crusted in filth from fighting in unending war.

Black Knight Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 8.5. How to acquire: Black Knight Set pieces are dropped from Black Knights, found throughout the Lands of Shadow.. Special effect: none. Greaves worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it. Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.

Rakshasa Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 7.9. How to acquire: Dropped by Rakshasa in Eastern Nameless Mausoleum. This area can only be accessed by using the ladder in Shadow Keep to get down to a special teleport coffin (this Elden Ring Map location). This will take you to Ruins of Unte and you must follow the cliffs downstream and then carefully drop down to bottom level to reach the mausoleum. [Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: Boosts All Damage by 2% but increases damage taken. Greaves of Rakshasa, soaked the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free.Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer.Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.

Fire Knight Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 5.7. How to acquire: Drop by Fire Knights in the Shadow Keep. Special effect: none. Greaves of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command. Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

Leather Leg Wraps is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 4.4. How to acquire: To the northwest of the Ravine North Site of Grace, there is a forest inhabited by runebears. At the center of this forest, you'll find a large stone with several items on it, this whole armor set is at the top of the stone. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. Leg wraps worn by highland warriors, made of sturdy leather and fastened with winding straps. The addition of animal pelt keeps the wearer warm. Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

Death Knight Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 6.6. How to acquire: Darklight Catacombs, on a Death Knight corpse. Special effect: Enhances skills and incantations of the ancient dragon cult by 2%. Golden greaves of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree. Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. These knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogatefor the coming age of the Duskborn.

Ascetic's Ankle Guards is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 2.0. How to acquire: Drop by Curseblade enemies.. Special effect: none. Ankle guards of the tower's ascetics which embody their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control. In order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training.

Messmer's Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 5.1. How to acquire: Purchase from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Messmer the Impaler. Special effect: none. Black greaves of Messmer the Impaler. On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired. "Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone."

Gravebird Anklets is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 2.0. How to acquire: Found in a swamp infested with Gravebirds, below a big archway. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. Stone anklets with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird. Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

Common Soldier Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 5.5. How to acquire: Drop by soldiers in Castle Ensis. Special effect: none. Greaves of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army. A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

Horned Warrior Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 6.6. How to acquire: Drops from Horned Warriors ( Small Private Altar site of grace in Belurat, Tower Settlement). Special effect: none. Greaves of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. Shaped to resemble the unclothed form of a hero from older times.

Divine Bird Warrior Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 7.3. How to acquire: Dropped by Divine Bird Warriors. Special effect: Increases the force generated by kicks by 5%. Greaves of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal. The great, sharp talons increase the force generated by kicks.

Rellana's Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 7.3. How to acquire: The complete set (Rellana's Set) can be bought from Enia in the Roundtable Hold upon defeating Rellana Twin Moon Knight.. Special effect: none. Ornate greaves of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel.

Young Lion's Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 9.3. How to acquire: Purchase from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Promised Consort Radahn / Radahn, Consort of Miquella in Enir-Ilim [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. Special effect: none. The golden greaves worn by Radahn in his younger years. Worn by a fierce lion. When Malenia, Blade of Miquella, let the rotflower blossom in Aeonia, Radahn heard a murmur in his ear "Miquella awaits thee, O promised consort."

Shadow Militiaman Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 4.4. How to acquire: May drop from Shadow Militiaman enemies. Special effect: none. Greaves as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen. Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

All-Knowing Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 6.6. How to acquire: The entire All-Knowing Set is dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing upon defeat. Sir Gideon is encountered as a boss in Leyndell, Capital of Ash, a alternate version of the Royal Capital accessible only after making significant progress in the story.Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Greaves set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear. At the end that should not be.

Alberich's Trousers is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 2.5. How to acquire: Found at the lower level of the Fortified Manor at Leyndell Royal Capital. Elden Ring Interactive Map Link.. Special effect: none. Mad Tongue Alberich's trousers.Alberiches was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

Astrologer Trousers is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 3.9. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Astrologer Class.Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in Liurnia of the Lakes for 1000 Runes.Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Trousers worn inside a robe. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

Bandit Boots is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 4.4. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Bandit Class.Can be purchased from Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold after offering Gostoc's Bell Bearing.. Special effect: none. Leather boots worn by bandits.Light for ease of movement, and supple for masking sound. In this trade, they offer little damage negation.

Banished Knight Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 10.8. How to acquire: Stormveil Castle: Chance for it to be looted off the Banished Knight enemies that you've killed.. Special effect: none. Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. These greaves were worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

Beast Champion Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 10.8. How to acquire: Drops from Knight Bernahl upon death. If not killed before, he will eventually invade you at Crumbling Farum Azula, dropping the entire set with an altered version of the chest piece. Elden Ring Map here.. Special effect: none. Silver greaves engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was.Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

Black Knife Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 5.7. How to acquire: Can be found on a corpse under an archway behind Ordina, Liturgical Town in Consecrated Grounds. Elden Ring Map here.. Special effect: none. Greaves used by the Black Knife Assassins. Crafted with scale armor that makes no sound. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

Blackflame Monk Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 7.3. How to acquire: Drop from Blackflame Monks.. Special effect: none. Black iron greaves featuring a flame motif.Attire of the Blackflame Monks.The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

Bloodhound Knight Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 6.6. How to acquire: Drops in Gelmir Hero's Grave - Mt. Gelmir.. Special effect: none. Metal greaves of the Bloodhound Knights. The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers. Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made the knight stays loyal for life.

Briar Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 7.3. How to acquire: Purchased from the Enia in Roundtable Hold after defeating Elemer of the Briar in The Shaded Castle.. Special effect: none. Battered iron greaves from a foreign land.Worn by Elemer of the Briar. The winding, rusted iron briars are a mark of the guilty and typically indicate a sentence of death. They also cause this armor to deal damage when performing dodge rolls.Elemer murderd numerous instructors and merchants, and was known as the Bell Bearing Hunter.

Bull-Goat Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 16.4. How to acquire: Can be found after killing Patches' assassination target for the Volcano Manor, Great Horned Tragoth. Elden Ring Interactive Map Link. Special effect: none. Great Horned Tragoth's greaves. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise. Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid.

Champion Gaiters is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 3.9. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Hero Class.Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in south Caelid for 1,000 Runes. Elden Ring Interactive Map Link. Special effect: none. Gaiters formed only with leather straps.Common wear in the badlands.

Carian Knight Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 6.6. How to acquire: You can find the Carian Knight Set in Raya Lucaria Academy.Elden Ring Map hereTo find the Carian Knight Set, you will need to fast travel back to the Church of the Cuckoo site and head to the graveyard section, specifically where the large rotating lift is. On the right side of the gate's entrance, look down as you are hugging the wall to find a platform that you can drop to. Walk on the narrow path and you'll notice a group of Glintstone Zombies worshipping a statue, simply kill the enemies and pick up the glowing item next to the statue to receive the set.. Special effect: none. Greaves of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all decorated heroes, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

Chain Leggings is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 5.5. How to acquire: Can be found at Church of Elleh, purchased from Merchant Kale. It costs 1000 Runes. Elden Ring Interactive Map Link.Can be purchased from Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold after giving them Kale's Bell Bearing. Special effect: none. Leggings made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

Cleanrot Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 9.3. How to acquire: Dropped by Cleanrot Knight enemies. Found in places such as: Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs and Miquella's HaligtreeCan be found at Inner Aeonia. Special effect: none. Greaves of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles fiercest of all.

Cloth Trousers is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 2.0. How to acquire: Found at the chest located at the end of Murkwater Cave, alongside Cloth Garb. Elden Ring Interactive Map Link. Special effect: none. Trousers made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

Commoner's Shoes is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 2.0. How to acquire: Can drop from Commoner enemies in Stormveil Castle.. Special effect: none. Modest shoes made of cloth. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

Confessor Boots is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 4.8. How to acquire: Starting Equipment for the Confessor Class.Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in Mt. Gelmir for 1000 Runes. Elden Ring Interactive Map Link. Special effect: none. Leather boots of the church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

Consort's Trousers is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 2.5. How to acquire: Can be purchased from Hermit Merchant at Hermit Merchant's Shack for 1,500 Runes.Elden Ring Map hereLooted from the corpse of Tanith after attacking her and defeating the summoned Tannith's Knight near the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy site of grace in Volcano Manor, Altus Plateau.Elden Ring Map here. Special effect: none. Fine white trousers, perfectly suited for wearing beneath a silk robe.

Crucible Greaves is a piece of leg armor armor weighing 9.6. How to acquire: Dropped by Crucible Knight Ordovis at Auriza Hero's Grave. Elden Ring Interactive Map LinkFound with the Crucible Tree Set in a chest within Deeproot Depths behind a mini-boss: Crucible Knight Siluria.Elden Ring Map here. The despair of sweet betrayal transformed Millicent from a mere bud into a magnificent flower. And one day, she will be reborn - as a beautiful scarlet valkyrie.

Godskin Swaddling Cloth is a talisman weighing 0.9, worth 1000 runes. Effect: Effect Successive attacks restore 30 + 3% HP. Sacred cloth of the Godskin Apostles, made from supple skin sewn together. Successive attacks restore HP. The Gloam-Eyed Queen cradles newborn apostles swaddled in this cloth. Soon they will grow to become the death of the gods.

Kindred of Rot's Exultation is a talisman weighing 0.9, worth 500 runes. Effect: Effect Raises attack power by 20% for 20 seconds when Poisoning or Rot occurs in the vicinity. A talisman depicting the exultation of pests. Raises attack power when poisoning or rot occurs in the vicinity. "Rot for the scarlet goddess. O scarlet blossoms, flourish in distant lands, and return to us, the unwanted children."

Lord of Blood's Exultation is a talisman weighing 0.9, worth 500 runes. Effect: Effect Raises attack power by 20% (12% in PvP) for 20 seconds when Blood Loss occurs in the vicinity. A talisman depicting the exultation of the Lord of Blood. Raises attack power when blood loss occurs in the vicinity. "Render up you offerings of blood to your Lord. Drench my consort's chamber. Slake his cocoon's thirst. His awakening shall herald the dawn of our dynasty"

Taker's Cameo is a talisman weighing 1.0, worth 1000 runes. Effect: Effect Restores 3% + 30 HP upon defeating enemies. A talisman engraved with a stern likeness of Praetor Rykard, master of Volcano Manor. Restores HP upon defeating enemies. When Rykard turned to heresy, taking by force became the rule. The gods themselves were no different, after all.

Ancestral Spirit's Horn is a talisman weighing 1.2, worth 500 runes. Effect: Effect Restores 3 FP upon defeating enemies. Item cut from the horns of the Regal Ancestor Spirit. Restore FP upon defeating enemies. A number of new growths bud from the antler-like horns of the fallen king, each glowing with light. Thus does new life grow from death, and from death, one obtains power.

Gold Scarab is a talisman weighing 1.2, worth 500 runes. Effect: Effect Increases Rune acquisition by 20%. A talisman facsimile of a scarab, the carrier of treasures and precious things. This golden scarab increases the amount of runes obtained from defeating enemies.

Silver Scarab is a talisman weighing 1.2, worth 500 runes. Effect: Effect Raises Item Discovery by 75. A talisman facsimile of a scarab, the carrier of treasures and precious things. This silver scarab enhances item discovery.

Crepus's Vial is a talisman weighing 0.7, worth 500 runes. Effect: Effect Eliminates all sound made by the wearer during movement. Small mysterious bottle with a dark mist sealed within. Eliminates all sound made by the wearer during movement. A ritual implement used by Roundtable Hold assassins. There was a time when Tarnished who had strayed from guidance feared nothing more than utter silence.

Concealing Veil is a talisman weighing 0.9, worth 500 runes. Effect: Effect Conceals wearer while crouching away from foes. Talisman put together from dark cloth with a lustrous sheen. Completely conceals the wearer's presence while crouching at a distance from foes. Part of one of the concealing veils used by the assassins on the Night of Black Knives.

Lacrima features in the fables of Raya Lucaria, in which she is described as a faerie cat who was fond of playing in the great bell tower.

Host's Trick-Mirror is a talisman weighing 0.7, worth 1000 runes. Effect: Effect Take on appearance of a cooperator. A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure. It is said that the man, named Shabriri, had his eyes gouged out as punishment for the crime of slander, and, with time, the blight of the flame of frenzy came to dwell in the empty sockets.

Gelmir..

O, Flame! is a incantation costing 16 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 16, Arc 0. Effect: Momentarily sparks roaring flame from hand. Found at: Purchase from Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving the Fire Monks' Prayerbook for 6,000 Runes..

Order Healing is a incantation costing 15 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 11, Fai 11, Arc 0. Effect: Alleviates death blight buildup. Found at: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found in the Siofra Aqueduct..

Order's Blade is a incantation costing 22 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 13, Fai 13, Arc 0. Effect: Enchants right-hand armament with holy damage. Placidusax's Ruin is a incantation costing 62 FP, using slot 3. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 36, Arc 0. Effect: Spews golden breath of Dragonlord Placidusax. Found at: Trade Remembrance of the Dragonlord with Enia at Roundtable Hold..

Poison Armament is a incantation costing 15 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 10, Arc 0. Effect: Enchants right-hand armament with poison. Found at: Dropped by an invisible scarab beetle on the northeastern shore of the Aeonia Swamp in Caelid, just northwest of Sellia, Town of Sorcery..

Poison Mist is a incantation costing 18 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 12, Arc 0. Effect: Releases poison mist before caster. Found at: Weeping Peninsula: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in a forested area southeast of the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace..

Protection of the Erdtree is a incantation costing 30 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 35, Arc 0. Effect: Increases affinity damage negation for self & allies. Radagon's Rings of Light is a incantation costing 21 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 31, Fai 31, Arc 0. Effect: Creates golden ring of light to attack wide area. Found at: Purchase from Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either the Golden Order Principia for 7,500 Runes..

Rejection is a incantation costing 9 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 12, Arc 0. Effect: Produces a shockwave that pushes away foes.. Found at: Can be purchased from Brother Corhyn at the Roundtable Hold for 1,500 Runes..

Rotten Breath is a incantation costing 36 (4) FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 15, Arc 12. Effect: Channels dragon to spew scarlet rot breath. Found at: Can be purchased at the Dragon Communion Altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion for 1 Dragon Heart.

Scarlet Aeonia is a incantation costing 48 FP, using slot 3. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 35, Arc 0. Effect: Creates a giant flower that explodes with scarlet rot. Found at: Trade Remembrance of the Rot Goddess with Enia at Roundtable Hold..
Scouring Black Flame is a incantation costing 21 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 28, Arc 0. Effect: Sweeps area before caster with black flame. Found at: Dropped by Godskin Apostle..

Shadow Bait is a incantation costing 15 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 13, Arc 0. Effect: Creates shadow that lures the aggression of foes of human build. Found at: Can be found on a corpse at Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, after going through the pipe room to a room with the corpse sitting at the center, next to a not very well hidden Ogre ready to strike..

Smarag's Glintstone Breath is a incantation costing 36 (6) FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 23, Arc 15. Effect: Spews magic breath of Glintstone Dragon Smarag from above. Found at: Can be purchased at the Dragon Communion Altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 2 Dragon Hearts. Glintstone Dragon Smarag must first be defeated in order to unlock this Incantation..

Stone of Gurranq is a incantation costing 15 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 13, Arc 0. Effect: Hurls a boulder before the caster. Found at: Bestial Sanctum: Reward from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman after giving him the sixth Deathroot. Map Link..

Surge, O Flame! is a incantation costing 1 (1) FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 9, Arc 0. Effect: Incinerates area before caster with stream of fire. Found at: Purchase from Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either the Fire Monks' Prayerbook for 5,500 Runes..

Swarm of Flies is a incantation costing 14 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 11, Arc 16. Effect: Releases a swarm of bloodflies before caster. Found at: Found on a corpse along the east wall of the Mohgwyn Palace blood marsh, directly north from the Palace Approach Ledge-Road Site of Grace..

The Flame of Frenzy is a incantation costing 16 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 16, Arc 0. Effect: Emits burst of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes. Found at: Callu Baptismal Church in the Weeping Peninsula. Found on a corpse by a pillar on the left side of the church. [Map Link].
Theodorix's Magma is a incantation costing 45 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 21, Arc 14. Effect: Spews magma breath of Theodorix from above. Found at: Dropped by Great Wyrm Theodorix.

Triple Rings of Light is a incantation costing 23 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 23, Fai 23, Arc 0. Effect: Fire three rings of light before the caster. Found at: Elphael, Brace of The Haligtree: From the Prayer Room grace, head out onto the northeastern walkway and drop down one level by using the roofs on the right. There is a sealed treasure room just under the Prayer Room that requires one Stonesword Key to unlock. The chest containing the spell is inside..

Unendurable Frenzy is a incantation costing 22 (6) FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 31, Arc 0. Effect: Emits violent burst of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes. Found at: Yelough Anix Ruins: Found in a chest in an underground treasure room in the central section of the ruins. Its entrance is in a door-less building that you must jump to from the larger ruined church building..

Urgent Heal is a incantation costing 16 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 8, Arc 0. Effect: Heals a small amount of HP. Found at: Starting equipment for the Confessor ClassPurchased from Brother Corhyn for 1,000 Runes..

Vyke's Dragonbolt is a incantation costing 35 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 23, Arc 0. Effect: Bolsters right-hand armament & body with red lightning. Found at: Received after defeating Vyke, Knight of the roundtable at Lord Contender's Evergaol..

Whirl, O Flame! is a incantation costing 19 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 13, Arc 0. Effect: Sweeps area before caster with stream of fire. Found at: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab on the road between Rotview Balcony and Caelem Ruins next to the wagon..

Wrath of Gold is a incantation costing 40 FP, using slot 1. Requirements: Int 0, Fai 32, Arc 0. Effect: Produces golden shockwave that knocks back foes. Found at: Found at Woodfolk Ruins. Among the enemies, there is a staircase that goes down and leads to a chest that contains this incantation. [Map Link].

Black Knight Commander Andreas is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 108 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Black Knight Commander Andreas. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Andreas, Knight-Commander of the Black Knights. The Black Knights were the primary force of Messmer's army. Their first leader was Andreas, a man endowed with great strength and command over the powers of the Crucible, and whose spirit in these ashes dwells. Though he remained a devout follower of Messmer after his flight from the Erdtree, he would rebel after learning of his liege's serpentine nature. His righteous stand was rewarded with imprisonment in an underground tomb.

Black Knight Captain Huw is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 106 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Black Knight Captain Huw. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Huw, Knight-Captain of the Black Knights. The Black Knights were the primary force of Messmer's army. Second to their first Knight-Commander was Huw, a man with agile command of both twinblade techniques and the powers of the Crucible, and whose spirit in these ashes dwells. Though a champion of the divine beast hunt, he followed his father, Andreas, into rebellion against Messmer, and like his father, he too was imprisoned in an underground tomb. Messmer mourned the loss of a brother-in-arms.

Bigmouth Imp Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 50 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons bigmouth imp spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a large-mouthed imp. The spirit of this old imp, said to be fashioned after a dragon, has a big mouth that serves as a cannon and allows it to fire shells from the rear of the battlefield.

Man-Fly Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 28 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons three man-fly spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three man-flies. Two of the man-flies attack foes from the air, while the third spits poison from the rear. Afflicted hornsent eventually metamorphosed into a fly-like form. It was believed that the moment the transformation took place, they were relieved from their suffering.

Taylew the Golem Smith is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 138 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Taylew the golem smith. The spirit of the stalwart stone golem who launches his own fists as projectiles. Taylew was said to be the runt of the litter and the first to stop moving, but it was he who became the guardian deity of smithery.

Divine Bird Warrior Ornis is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 131 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Divine Bird Warrior Ornis. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Ornis the divine bird warrior. Spirit of the divine bird warrior from whom the horned warriors claim descent. Clad in golden armor, and granted wings and feathers by divine invocation. Ornis succeeded in taming the divine bird and made its wings his own as he soared through the sky. When he finally fell to earth, he lived on as the guardian deity of the temple quarter.

Horned Warrior Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 101 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons horned warrior spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a horned warrior. This heavily-armored guardian spirit of the tower attained inhuman strength through divine invocation, and wields a curved greatsword that brings horns to bear on its foes. In the tower, these warriors and their weapons both are spiritual vessels.

Ancient Dragon Florissax is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 90 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Ancient Dragon Florissax. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Ancient Dragon Florissax. Florissax assumed this spirit form to offer her service to a new lord. Uses her own dragonbolt to increase all damage negation (including physical) for herself and nearby allies. Strikes foes with the Flowerstone Gavel's dragonbolt to reduce enemy lightning damage negation. Long ago, Florissax assumed human form to share Dragon Communion with the world. Now, she has acquired a human heart.

Fingercreeper Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 55 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons Fingercreeper spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Fingercreeper. Devoted to its summoner, this young, diminutive Fingercreeper eagerly restores HP. They are ever so fond of their mothers at this tender age.

Fire Knight Queelign is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 123 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Fire Knight Queelign. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Fire Knight Queelign. Attacks immediately after being summoned. Spirit of a knight granted relief by the Iris of Grace. Wields a spear-like greatsword that impales foes upon fire, keeping the taint of impurity away from fair mother Marika. That grace was his salvation, though it was but a fleeting blessing. And having been saved, all that was left to him was to wage war.

Swordhand of Night Jolan is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 90 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolan. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolan. Spirit of a swordhand granted light by the Iris of Grace. Wields a sword of bottomless black that penetrates the enemy's guard. Though it was not by the shining star that she had longed for, thus was her Night illuminated. But this was an at times blinding light, and threatened to expunge the Night entirely.

Jolan and Anna is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 144 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirits of Jolan and Anna. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of Jolan and Anna. Spirits of two Swordhands of Night, one of them being possessed by Count Ymir's doll Anna. Together, Jolan's sword and Anna's claws are as bottomless black, and penetrate the enemy's guard. Jolan and Anna were born in a cold, dark gaol, where they were raised, deprived of light, to be Swordhands of Night. Thus were they cultivated to become the most terrifying masters of their blades, though the burden of the deed left their hearts frail and pliant.

Wandering Noble Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 28 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons five wandering noble spirits.. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirits of five wandering nobles. The spirits of nobles who, after death, now wander the Lands Between. Surely they were in search of something once - but whatever it was has long been forgotten.

Noble Sorcerer Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 11 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons noble sorcerer spirit.. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of a noble sorcerer.Spirit of a nobleman who once asked to be given a place at Raya Lucaria to learn glintstone sorceries.His talents were insufficient to be worthy of donning the stone crown, however, and he is only capable of using the most rudimentary sorcery.

Nomad Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 61 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons nomad spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a nomad. A member of a tribe that was entombed in the earth so as to bury the maddening disease that followed them. Able to emit the terrible flame of frenzy from his eyes, but has low HP and is frail, unable to take much in the way of punishment.

Putrid Corpse Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 40 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons four putrid corpse spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirits of four putrid corpses. These spirits appear some distance from the summoner. Though their movements are dull and confused, their low moans make them effective at drawing the attention of enemies. True death does not come easily for them.

Skeletal Militiaman Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 44 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons two skeletal militiaman spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirits of two skeletal militiamen. These are the spirits of militiamen who live in Death, and will continue to rise again until properly finished off. This is the grotesque fate of those who come into contact with Deathroot.

Skeletal Bandit Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 22 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons skeletal bandit spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirits of a skeletal bandit. These are the spirits of bandits who live in Death, and will continue to rise again until properly finished off.After the night of the plot, Deathroot appeared in the Lands Between, and Those Who Live in Death soon followed.

Albinauric Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 53 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons two Albinauric spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirits of two Albinaurics. A strapping duo of cartwheeling spirits who wield ripple swords and spew freezing breath.Both are second-generation Albinaurics, with dumpy heads that resemble those of frogs.

Winged Misbegotten Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 37 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons winged misbegotten spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of a winged misbegotten. A spirit with the aspect of wings which takes flight to loose arrows from its bow. The misbegotten are held to be a punishment for making contact with the Crucible, and from birth they are treated as slaves, or worse.

Demi-Human Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 69 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons five demi-human spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirits of five demi-humans. Spirits of demi-humans that are small in stature, but have a Violent, brutish disposition. Though they seem somewhat intelligent, when night falls, their blood boils and they become feral.

Clayman Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 77 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons two clayman spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two claymen. Bowed with age, these spirits are sluggish but hard to stagger. The warped remains of priests who searched for revelation in service of the ancient dynasty, they employ two sorceries that produce smaller and larger bubbles.

Oracle Envoy Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 72 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons four Oracle Envoy spirits. Ashen Remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four Oracle Envoys. Spirits of a monstrous band of musicians who employ sacred arts. It is said that when Oracle Envoys appear, playing their pipes, they do so to herald the arrival of a new god, or age.

Lone Wolf Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 55 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons three lone wolf spirits.. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirits of three lone wolves. Spirits of wolves chased from their pack. They later encountered a nameless Tarnished, who welcomed them as hunting companions. The wolf spirits overwhelm enemies with their agility, aiding the summoner in combat.

Rotten Stray Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 35 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summon rotten stray spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of a rotten stray.Spirit of a stray dog corrupted by the scarlet rot. Though it is only a small creature, it is as violent as it is nimble, and its fangs fester with poisonous rot.

Giant Rat Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 0 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons three giant rat spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three giant rats. Spirits that do not require FP to summon.The rat spirits appear at a distance from the summoner, swarming upon their victim to start the fight.Even as spirits, these vermin seem to multiply endlessly. Enhancing these ashes can increase their numbers.

Warhawk Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 52 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons warhawk spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a warhawk. Spirit of a Stormveil warhawk, the talons of which have been sliced off so that razor-fine swords could be grafted in their place. With its lord vanquished, and its wings wounded, the hawk perished as it solemnly gazed at its former home. The storm is a warhawk's cradle.

Land Squirt Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 0 FP and 240 HP to summon. Effect: Summons three land squirts. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three land squirts Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. These spirits appear some distance from the summoner. The firm, fleshy tubes of the creatures remain rooted to the spot, spraying poisonous liquid over their surroundings.

Spirit Jellyfish Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 31 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit jellyfish.. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit jellyfish. A floating spirit that illuminates its surroundings. Prone to tears, the jellyfish girl searches for her distant home. Will bravely spew poison at foes on her summoner's behalf. It seems her name is Aurelia. "distant home"

Miranda Sprout Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 0 FP and 185 HP to summon. Effect: Summons five miranda sprouts. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five miranda sprouts. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. Spirits of sweet little miranda flowers, carnivorous blossoms that feed upon human flesh. They creep slowly, scattering toxic pollen. Vulnerable to firedo take care of the little darlings.

Fanged Imp Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 50 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons two fanged imp spirits. Ashes remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon two fanged imp spirits. These spirits are well suited to causing a disturbance, moving nimbly like pests and hurling magic pots.The two imps seem fond of each other's company.

Soldjars of Fortune Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 0 FP and 135 HP to summon. Effect: Summons three little living jar spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three little living jars. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. These reckless spirits sacrifice themselves to vanquish their summoner's foes, and explode upon death. Though their bravery is admirable, their explosions can harm friend as well as foe, and they will also immediately explode on contact with fire. "Tell the otherstell them how brightly a fire jar burns."

Archer Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 57 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons three archer spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon three archer spirits. Spirits of archers who belonged to the Fallen Hawks, a band of soldiers that once explored the Eternal City. Their arrows are imbued with cold ghostflame. Though their methods are somewhat crude, they work well as a squadron, firing a hail of arrows in unison at the sound of a war cry.

Greatshield Soldier Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 74 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons five greatshield soldier spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon five greatshield soldier spirits. Spirits of greatshield soldiers who belonged to the Fallen Hawks, a band of soldiers that once explored the Eternal City. Stout defenders with a steady guard. Though their methods are somewhat crude, they work well as a squadron, and will attract the attention of enemies or lob ghostflame from the rearguard.

Page Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 81 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons page spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of a page. Spirit of a page who traveled at the side of the noble he served. Uses a piercing sword and crossbow to defend his master.One becomes a page merely by accident of being born into obscurity; nothing is asked of ability, talent, or volition.

Vulgar Militia Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 70 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons three vulgar militia spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three vulgar militiamen. Spirits of the vulgar militia who wield long-hafted, serrated hatchets. These brutal weapons are particularly effective at causing blood loss to opponents. In the Lands Between, the small were scorned, and so they formed their vulgar militia as a means to make a living, albeit in ignominy.

Marionette Soldier Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 67 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons two marionette soldier spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirits of two marionette soldiers. Spirits of marionette soldiers created to serve a sorcerer.These marionettes are archers, each equipped with a pair of bows. On the verge of falling apart, they are illdisciplined and attack without warning.

Avionette Soldier Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 67 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summon the spirits of two avionette soldiers. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two avionette soldiers. Spirits of marionette soldiers with avian features that were created to serve a sorcerer.Equipped with long-hafted scythes, they also attack from the skies by lobbing fire pots. Can sometimes malfunction when damaged.

Kaiden Sellsword Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 88 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons Kaiden Sellsword spirit.. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of a Kaiden sellsword. Spirit of a mercenary belonging to a horse-riding folk. Skillfully uses a massive blade made for dismounting other riders, and enhances his already considerable strength with war cries.The sellswords of Kaiden made their prowess known on countless battlefields.

Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 110 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head. Spirit of a mad soldier with a large, brawny physique. Though he has stifled his panic within the dark confines of his helmet, he rampages as if driven mad when agitated by bloodshed or the humming of insects. This mad soldier is all that is left of a broken gladiator.

Fire Monk Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 85 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons Fire Monk spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Fire Monk. Spirit of a stout monk who monitored the Giants' Flame. Versed in fire incantations, and himself steeled against fire. Though he was charged with keeping watch over the Flame, after many years of solemn duty, he has succumbed to its allure.

Ancestral Follower Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 63 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons ancestral follower spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of an ancestral follower. A spirit of the horned folk who eschew letters and metalworking. Brawny, and versed in distinctive spiritual arts, this particular tribesman wields a heavy bow.

Azula Beastman Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 102 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons two Azula beastman spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Azula beastmen. Spirits of beastmen from doomed Farum Azula, the slowly crumbling ruins in the skies. These ruins are said to be the remains of a giant mausoleum enshrining an ancient dragon, guarded by chosen beastmen who wield weapons clad in lightning.

Man-Serpent Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 62 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons man-serpent spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a man-serpent. Spirit of a deformed man-serpent that wields a whip of magma. It is said that long ago, the elder serpent that dwelled on Mt. Gelmir devoured a demigod, and the birth of the man-serpents followed.

Crystalian Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 101 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons Crystalian spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Crystalian. Spirit that wields round crystalline blades, both big and small. Its sturdy body, itself hewn from crystal long ago, is hard enough to blunt its opponent's blades, but blows from bludgeoning weapons can shatter it easily.

Kindred of Rot Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 73 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons Kindred of Rot spirit. Kindred of Rot Kindred of Rot Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit of the Kindred of Rot. This spirit takes the form of a crawling pest, its chitinous body making a dry rustling sound. Attacks enemies by secreting sticky threads. The Kindred of Rot are the servants of the Goddess of Rotservants that have been forsaken.

Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 49 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons glintstone sorcerer spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of a glintstone sorcerer. Spirit of a Raya Lucaria sorcerer wearing a stone crown.A scholar of the Olivinus Conspectus, who has mastered the use of the Glintstone Stars sorcery.

Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 89 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons Twinsage sorcerer spirit. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of a Twinsage sorcerer. Spirit of a Raya Lucaria sorcerer wearing a stone crown. Those who study the Twinsage Conspectus are the academy's elite, capable of mastering the Glintstone Cometshard and Crystal Burst sorceries.

Godrick Soldier Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 54 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons two Godrick soldier spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirits of two of Godrick's soldiers. A duo of spirits, consisting of a wielder of devastating charged hammer attacks in the vanguard and a crossbowman bringing up the rear.The soldiers who serve Godrick the Grafted are what remains of the army that fled the royal capital of the Erdtree.

Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 59 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons three Raya Lucaria soldier spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirits of three Raya Lucaria soldiers. A trio of spirits, consisting of two disposable foot soldiers and their superior.The soldiers of Raya Lucaria were also known as the Cuckoos. They were given free rein by the academy to wage war as they pleased, and they were infamous for their rapacious ways.

Leyndell Soldier Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 64 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons two Leyndell soldier spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Leyndell soldiers. Spirits of soldiers each equipped with a spear and greatshield. The soldiers of Leyndell fight their battles defensively. During the Shattering, they were the ramparts that fortified the royal capital.

Radahn Soldier Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 71 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons two Radahn Soldier spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two of Radahn's soldiers. Both spirits wield fiery weapons to perform powerful skills. Such is their valor that they will immediately attack after being summoned. General Radahn's soldiers were all reputed to be masterful warriors, and it was popularly said that the Redmanes knew no weakness.

Haligtree Soldier Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 66 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons four Haligtree soldier spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four Haligtree soldiers. Spirits of common soldiers who carry the sacred light. When weakened, they explode to deliver a last-ditch attack. This was the bitter revelation discovered by the desperate soldiers who awaited the return of their lord to the rotted Haligtree. May the flash of our deaths guide Miquella's return.

Mausoleum Soldier Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 75 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons five mausoleum soldier spirits. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five mausoleum soldiers. Spirits of five headless soldiers who confound foes by disappearing and reappearing at will. The mausoleum is where the bodies of soulless demigods are lain to rest, and these soldiers followed their masters into Death by severing their own heads from their bodies.

Stormhawk Deenh is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 47 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Stormhawk Deenh. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Deenh the Stormhawk. Spirit of a fierce hawk that faithfully rendered lifelong service to the old king of Stormveil long ago, when the true storm raged. Its cries embolden its fellows in battle, and the tempestuous winds that encircle it shred through foes.

Banished Knight Oleg is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 100 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Banished Knight Oleg. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Oleg, the Banished Knight. One of the two knights known as the Wings of the Storm. After his banishment, he attracted the notice of the Grace-Given Lord and later, having slain a hundred traitors as the Lord's hand, Oleg earned the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial.

Banished Knight Engvall is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 100 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Banished Knight Engvall. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Engvall, the Banished Knight. One of the two knights dubbed the Wings of the Storm. Despite his banishment, he rejected the invitation of the Grace-Given Lord, instead keeping watch over a masterless castle for many years, gaining renown as a hero of the fringes.

Bloodhound Knight Floh is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 95 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Bloodhound Knight Floh. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of Floh, the Bloodhound Knight. Spirit of a Bloodhound Knight they called the Rabid Stray. Will attack without pause immediately after being summoned.Floh vowed that there was only one lord he would ever serve: a true king. And so, the Rabid Stray never found a master.

Battlemage Hugues Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 122 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Battlemage Hugues. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Battlemage Hugues. Hugues came from Sellia to study the Haima Conspectus at the academy, where he became a battlemage. Haima scholars seek to quell conflict with cannon fire and the gavel, but Hugues developed a longing for it.

Latenna the Albinauric is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 74 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons the spirit of Latenna the Albinauric. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Latenna the Albinauric. A rare case of one who chose to become a spirit voluntarily. Latenna was renowned as a deft magic archer. But having lost her beloved wolf companion, Lobo, she cannot move from the place where she was summoned.

Perfumer Tricia is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 78 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Perfumer Tricia. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of Tricia, the perfumer. Tricia was once known as a healer who dedicated her efforts to treating Misbegotten, Omen, and all those seen as impure. When her efforts failed, she was their companion as they died, watching over them to ensure that they could pass peacefully, free of pain. A tale akin to the origins of the deathbed companions.

Depraved Perfumer Carmaan Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 124 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Depraved Perfumer Carmaan. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Carmaan, the depraved perfumer. Depraved perfumers practice their art for themselves alone. Carmaan was a notably formidable perfumer whose strength rivaled that of heroes, and it is said that he was in search of a secret physick of revivification.

Omenkiller Rollo is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 113 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Omenkiller Rollo. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of Omenkiller Rollo. Spirit of Rollo, known as the first Omenkiller. Once a famous perfumer, Rollo imbibed a physick to rid himself of emotion, thus enabling him to enact his nightmarish labor, hunting the Omen.

Blackflame Monk Amon Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 115 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Blackflame Monk Amon. Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Amon, the Blackflame Monk. Amon swore fealty to the god-slaying black flame, and so became the first fire monk to turn traitor. Or perhaps it is better said that he fled from the Giants' Flameout of cowardice.

Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 108 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff. Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Kristoff, the Ancient Dragon Knight. Spirit of Kristoff, an honorable knight of Leyndell who was also a devout worshipper of the ancient dragons. His skills strike down foes with thunderbolts, the dragons' weapon of choice. After the First Defense of Leyndell, Kristoff earned the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial for the feat of capturing Godefroy the Grafted.

Redmane Knight Ogha is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 106 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Redmane Knight Ogha. Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Ogha, the Redmane Knight. Spirit of a mighty knight versed in the use of a greatbow. A valiant warrior who will attack immediately after being summoned. The longest-serving member of the Redmane Knights, Ogha studied techniques to manipulate gravity alongside Radahn. May use a rain of gravitational arrows in response to a war cry, but only once.

Lhutel the Headless is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 104 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Lhutel the Headless. Legendary ashen remains.Use to summon the spirit of Lhutel the Headless. Spirit of a headless knight who leads the mausoleum soldiers. Wields a lance enrobed in Death and hurls spectral lances at foes. Lhutel sacrificed her life so that in Death she could continue to protect a soulless demigod until their revival, earning her the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial.

Cleanrot Knight Finlay Ashes is a Spirit Ash of type Spirit Summon, costing 127 FP and 0 HP to summon. Effect: Summons spirit of Cleanrot Knight Finlay. Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of the Cleanrot Knight Finlay. Finlay was one of the few survivors of the Battle of Aeonia, who in an unimaginable act of heroism carried the slumbering demigod Malenia all the way back to the Haligtree. Firebreather is a skill of type Unique, costing 8 FP. Effect: Blow into torch flame, spreading flames in a wide frontward arc. The flames on the ground will continue to burn for a short time.. Found via: Default skill of the Steel-Wire Torch..
Buckler Parry is a skill of type Unique, costing - FP. Effect: Use this Skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.. Found via: Default skill for the Buckler..

Surge of Faith is a skill of type Unique, costing 15 (-15) FP. Effect: Set the flames of Birac's faith ablaze in the cranial vessel, thenraise it aloft to rain down fireballs in all directions.Repeated inputs will continue to raise the armament aloft,continuing the attack.. Found via: Default skill on the Cranial Vessel Candlestand..

Flame Spit is a skill of type Unique, costing 28 FP. Effect: Ready the shield, then launch a fireball from the barrel. The fireball explodes on impact.. Found via: Default skill on the One-Eyed Shield..

Oracular Bubble is a skill of type Unique, costing 6 FP. Effect: Blow on the horn to release a magic bubble. The bubble floats gently through the air towards its target.. Found via: Default skill on the Envoy's Horn..

Bubble Shower is a skill of type Unique, costing 16 FP. Effect: Blow on the horn to release a spume of magic bubbles. The bubbles float gently before raining down on the target.. Found via: Default skill on the Envoy's Long Horn..
