Sea of Magma is a skill of type Unique, costing 5 (-5) FP. Effect: Swing a molten whip overhead to temporarily cover the surrounding area in a sea of magma. Hold to continue swinging the lava whip.. Found via: Default skill on the Magma Whip Candlestick..

Viper Bite is a skill of type Unique, costing 8 FP. Effect: Give the shield a quick shake to temporarily bring the bronze viper to life, inciting it to lash out and bite foes.. Found via: Default skill on the Coil Shield..

Moonlight Greatsword is a skill of type Unique, costing 40 FP. Effect: Raise the sword aloft, bathing it in the light of the dark moon.Temporarily increases magic attack power and imbues blade with frost.Charged attacks release blasts of moonlight.. Found via: Default skill on the Dark Moon Greatsword..

Siluria's Woe is a skill of type Unique, costing 25 FP. Effect: Thrust the treespear in a spiraling motion, surrounding it in a vortex of wind. Charged attacks have the power to blow away enemies and can fire the tornado forwards.. Found via: Default skill on the Siluria's Tree..

Rallying Standard is a skill of type Unique, costing 30 FP. Effect: Hoist the war banner aloft and give a rallying command. Raises attack power and defense for self and nearby allies.. Found via: Default skill on the Commander's Standard..

Bear Witness! is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 FP. Effect: Grant the small dragon a fleeting glimpse of life and thrust it skyward, spewing flames over a wide frontward area.. Found via: Default skill on the Grafted Dragon..

Eochaid's Dancing Blade is a skill of type Unique, costing 15 FP. Effect: Infuse the sword with energy, then fling it forwards in a corkscrew attack. The sword continuously deals damage while violently spinning. Charge the attack to increase reach and duration of the spin.. Found via: Default skill of the Marais Executioner's Sword. Default skill on the Regalia of Eochaid..

Soul Stifler is a skill of type Unique, costing 12 FP. Effect: Raise the greathorn's wings to summon a soul-sapping miasma. Enemies in the affected area will temporarily suffer from reduced defense.. Found via: Default skill on the Winged Greathorn..

Taker's Flames is a skill of type Unique, costing 30 FP. Effect: Raise the sacred sword aloft to set it ablaze with blasphemous flames, then bring it down to fire off a forward blast.The flames steal HP from those they touch.. Found via: Default skill on the Blasphemous Blade..

Shriek of Milos is a skill of type Unique, costing 30 FP. Effect: Lets out a horrific cursed scream that reduces all damage negation and status resistances for nearby foes.While active, strong attacks will change to a combo attack.. Found via: Default skill on the Sword of Milos..

Reduvia Blood Blade is a skill of type Unique, costing 6 FP. Effect: Slash with the wicked dagger, transforming its never-drying bloostains into airborne blood blades that cause hemorrhaging. Can be fired in rapid succession.. Found via: Defaul skill on the Reduvia dagger..

Glintstone Dart is a skill of type Unique, costing 10 FP. Effect: Skill that builds from the Glintstone Pebble sorcery. Charge the skill to upgrade it to Glintstone Dart. Follow up with a strong attack to chain this skill into a lunging thrust.. Found via: Default skill on the Glintstone Kris Dagger..

Night-and-Flame Stance is a skill of type Unique, costing - (19 23) FP. Effect: Hold the sword level and prepare to cast a sorcery. Follow up with a normal attack to cast the Night Comet sorcery, or a strong attack to sweep forward with a burst of flames.. Found via: Default skill on the Sword of Night and Flame..

Wave of Gold is a skill of type Unique, costing 50 FP. Effect: Imbue the sword with bygone golden glory, then fire it at foes.A wide, golden wave fans out forwards, sweeping through all enemies caught in its path.. Found via: Default skill on the Sacred Relic Sword..

Ruinous Ghostflame is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 FP. Effect: Swing the sword to bathe its blade in ghostflame. The ghostflame adds magic damage to attacks, and also has a bitterly cold bite.. Found via: Default skill on the Helphen's Steeple..

Establish Order is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 FP. Effect: Raise the armament in a salute, releasing a golden explosion. Repeated inputs send out waves of golden light.. Found via: Default skill on the Golden Order Greatsword..

Mists of Slumber is a skill of type Unique, costing 30 FP. Effect: Releases a faint purple mist that spreads across a wide frontwards area.This mist inflicts the sleep ailment upon foes.. Found via: Default skill for the Sword of St Trina..

Spearcall Ritual is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 FP. Effect: Thrust the spear high, bearing prayers into the sky to summon a downpour of spectral spears.. Found via: Default skill on the Death Ritual Spear..

Wolf's Assault is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 FP. Effect: Infuse the greatsword with frost, then perform a forward somersault to plunge it into the ground. Then, pull it out to release a cold blast.. Found via: Default skill on the Royal Greatsword..

Thundercloud Form is a skill of type Unique, costing 35 FP. Effect: Temporarily transform into a red thundercloud and fly through the air, then plunge down with a lightning-infused blade. Hold to increase the reach of the thundercloud form.. Found via: Default skill for the Dragon King's Cragblade..

Cursed-Blood Slice is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 (- 20) FP. Effect: Brace, then charge forward to deliver a downward diagonal slice. The bloody trail of the late is followed by a burst of flame. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.. Found via: Default skill on the Morgott's Cursed Sword..

Waterfowl Dance is a skill of type Unique, costing 12 FP. Effect: Perform a series of one-footed leaps in the manner of a waterfowl to unleash a swift yet graceful slashing combo.Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.. Found via: Default skill on the Hand of Malenia..

Gold Breaker is a skill of type Unique, costing 31 FP. Effect: Leap up high and, while suspended in midair, imbue the rune shard with light before smashing it down hard onto the ground.The heroic Radagon's signature attack.. Found via: Default skill on the Marika's Hammer..

I Command Thee, Kneel! is a skill of type Unique, costing 15 FP. Effect: Repeatedly smash the Axe of Godrick into the ground, unleashing two earth-shaking shockwaves.Follow up with an additional input to produce a third shockwave. Found via: This Skill can only be acquired by equipping Axe of Godrick..

Regal Roar is a skill of type Unique, costing 25 FP. Effect: Let loose a mighty war cry, raising attack power, while sending out a shockwave that cannot be guarded against by stomping the ground. While active, strong attack becomes a lunging slash.. Found via: Default skill on the Axe of Godfrey..

Starcaller Cry is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 (-20) FP. Effect: Bring the two swords together and roar into the skies, pulling in enemies with a gravitational wave. Follow up with an additional input to slam down with gravity-infused swords.. Found via: Default skill of the Starscourge Greatsword..

Wave of Destruction is a skill of type Unique, costing 25 FP. Effect: Raise the sword up high, then strike it against the ground to fire off a wave of gravitational force.. Found via: Default skill on the Ruins Greatsword..

Bloodboon Ritual is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 (-20) FP. Effect: Raise the sacred spear and pierce the body of the Formless Mother. Stab up to three times, creating explosions of blood with each thrust.This skill will coat the armament with bloodflame for a while.. Found via: Default skill on the Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear..

Flowing Form is a skill of type Unique, costing 9 FP. Effect: Temporarily transforms armament into its liquid form.Swing the armament like a whip to perform a sweeping slice over a wide area.. Found via: Default skill of the Nox Flowing Sword..

Flowing Form is a skill of type Unique, costing 16 FP. Effect: Temporarily transforms armament into its liquid form.Swing the armament like a whip to strike surroundings before slamming its teardrop-shaped head down.. Found via: Default skill of the Nox Flowing Hammer..

Blade of Death is a skill of type Unique, costing 25 FP. Effect: Unleash the power of the Rune of Death to fire off a blade-like projectile.In addition to dealing immediate damage, the blade reduces the enemy's maximum HP and continues to wear down HP for a while.. Found via: Default skill on the Black Knife..

Blade of Gold is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 FP. Effect: Leap into the air, charging the armament with golden flames that are then shot at the enemy as a single, blade-like projectile. Inflicts holy damage.. Found via: Default skill on the Blade of Calling..

Destined Death is a skill of type Unique, costing 40 FP. Effect: Set free the remnants of Destined Death, plunging the greatsword into the ground to summon a myriad of blades. In addition to dealing immediate damage, this attack reduces the enemy's maximum HP and continues to wear down HP for a short time.. Found via: Default skill on the Maliketh's Black Blade..

Spinning Wheel is a skill of type Unique, costing 3 FP. Effect: Strike the wheel against the ground to set it spinning at top speed. Hold to keep the wheel spinning. Can be used while walking to push the armament into enemies.. Found via: Default skill on the Ghiza's Wheel..

Alabaster Lord's Pull is a skill of type Unique, costing 15 FP. Effect: Thrust the armament into the ground to create a gravity well. In addition to dealing damage, this attack pulls enemies in. Has a greater area of effect than Gravitas.. Found via: Default skill on the Alabaster Lord's Sword..

Onyx Lord's Repulsion is a skill of type Unique, costing 27 FP. Effect: Thrust the armament into the ground to create a gravity well. In addition to dealing damage, this attack sends enemies flying away.. Found via: Default skill on the Onyx Lord's Greatsword..

Oath of Vengeance is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 FP. Effect: Swear an oath upon the greatsword to avenge the clan, temporarily raising all attributes for a certain duration. While the oath's effects are active, poise will also be increased.. Found via: Default skill on the Grafted Blade Greatsword..

Ice Lightning Sword is a skill of type Unique, costing 25 FP. Effect: Call down a bolt of ice lightning into the blade and bring it down upon a foe.The ice lightning effect will persist for a while.. Found via: Default skill on the Dragonscale Blade..

Regal Beastclaw is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 FP. Effect: Slam the hammer into the ground, rending the land asunder with the armament's five bestial claws.. Found via: Default skill on the Beastclaw Greathammer..

Flame Dance is a skill of type Unique, costing 25 FP. Effect: Imbue the red braid with the Giants' Flame and lash out in a wide range with a series of agile swings.. Found via: Default skill for the Giant's Red Braid..

Claw Flick is a skill of type Unique, costing 14 FP. Effect: Cause the finger to swell, then flex to build up strength before giving enemies an almighty flick.. Found via: Default skill on the Ringed Finger..

Nebula is a skill of type Unique, costing 25 FP. Effect: Imbue the Naturalborn's stars with magic to perform a sweeping strike.This attack leaves a dark cloud of stars in its wake that lingers briefly before exploding.. Found via: Default skill on the Bastard's Stars. Defeult skill on the Wing of Astel..

Ghostflame Ignition is a skill of type Unique, costing 15 FP. Effect: Thrust out the barbed rod and set its tip alight with ghostflame.Follow up with a normal attack to set the ground ablaze with ghostflame, or a strong attack to trigger a massive explosion.. Found via: Default skill on the Death's Poker..

Ancient Lightning Spear is a skill of type Unique, costing 35 FP. Effect: Imbue the armament with the ancient dragons' red lightning, then throw it as a spear. Can be charged to increase its power.. Found via: Default skill on the Bolt of Gransax..

Frenzyflame Thrust is a skill of type Unique, costing 22 FP. Effect: Imbue the spear with the flame of frenzy and leap forwards, plunging it into the ground and setting off a maddening explosion. The skill inflicts both the enemy and the user with madness.. Found via: Default skill on Vyke's War Spear..

Miquella's Ring of Light is a skill of type Unique, costing 11 FP. Effect: Summon Miquella's shining halo and fire it forwards. Can be fired in rapid succession.. Found via: Default skill on the Halo Scythe..

Golden Tempering is a skill of type Unique, costing 30 FP. Effect: Cross the two swords to grant their attacks holy essence.While in effect, strong attack performs a dual-wielding combo attack.. Found via: Default skill on the Ornamental Straight Sword..

Last Rites is a skill of type Unique, costing 25 FP. Effect: Raise the epitaph to grant the effect of Sacred Order to yourselfand allies in the vicinity.Particularly effective at laying to rest Those Who Live in Death.. Found via: Default skill on the Golden Epitaph..

Unblockable Blade is a skill of type Unique, costing 25 FP. Effect: Imbue the cipher blade with light, extending its length, then strike with a sudden sweeping attack.This attack cannot be blocked.. Found via: Default skill on the Cipher Pata. Default skill on the Coded Sword..

Corpse Wax Cutter is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 FP. Effect: Lost skill of ancient heroes.Lift the sword up high to release the power of corpse wax and launch it forwards as a blade-like projectile.. Found via: Default skill on the Gargoyle's Blackblade..

Zamor Ice Storm is a skill of type Unique, costing 15 FP. Effect: Plunge the curved sword into the ground, building power before unleashing a freezing storm that batters the surroundings.. Found via: Default skill on the Zamor Curved Sword..

Radahn's Rain is a skill of type Unique, costing - (25 -) FP. Effect: Archery skill performed from a low stance. Ready the bow and fire a sudden flurry of arrows up into the sky. The arrows will pour on foes like rain.. Found via: Default skill of the Lion Greatbow..

The Queen's Black Flame is a skill of type Unique, costing 15 FP. Effect: Set the blade ablaze with the god-slaying black flame before delivering a sweeping slash. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack. The black flames will continue to wear down HP for a while.. Found via: Default skill on the Godslayer Greatsword..

Dynast's Finesse is a skill of type Unique, costing 5 ( -7) FP. Effect: Nimbly avoid an attack, securing some distance from foes. Follow up with strong attack to perform a sudden lunge, and press strong attack again to perform a sweeping slice.. Found via: Default skill on the Bloody Helice..

Magma Shower is a skill of type Unique, costing 12 FP. Effect: Slash at foes in a twirling motion while scattering magma all around.Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.. Found via: Default skill on the Magma Blade..

Death Flare is a skill of type Unique, costing 16 FP. Effect: Set the lusterless sun ablaze with the Prince of Death's flames, inflicting the death ailment upon foes.Follow up with an additional input to bring down the armament, triggering an explosion.. Found via: Default skill on the Eclipse Shotel..

Bloodhound's Finesse is a skill of type Unique, costing 8 ( - 12) FP. Effect: Slash upwards with the Bloodhound's Fang, using the momentum of the strike to perform a backwards somersault and gain some distance from foes. Follow up with a strong attack to perform the Bloodhound's Step attack.. Found via: Default skill on the Bloodhound's Fang..

Magma Guillotine is a skill of type Unique, costing 20 ( - 10) FP. Effect: Grab the scalesword with both hands, as a wyrm would hold it in its mouth, and leap forwards, smashing it into the ground and triggering a blast of magma. Follow up with an additional input to perform a chopping attack.. Found via: Default skill on the Magma Wyrm's Scalesword..

Corpse Piler is a skill of type Unique, costing 17 ( - 9) FP. Effect: Forms a blade of cursed blood for repeated, interweaving successive attacks. Follow up with an additional input for further successive attacks.. Found via: Default skill on the Rivers of Blood..

Transient Moonlight is a skill of type Unique, costing - (15 20) FP. Effect: Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance.Follow up with either a normal or a strong attack to draw the blade at great speed for an instant slash attack. Both attacks fire off a wave of light.. Found via: Default skill on the Moonveil..

Bloodblade Dance is a skill of type Unique, costing 11 FP. Effect: Leap at foe to perform a flurry of tornado-like attacks.Follow up with an additional input to perform an attack that ends in an evasive maneuver.. Found via: Default skill on the Eleonora's Poleblade..

Knowledge Above All is a skill of type Unique, costing 35 FP. Effect: Raise the scepter to manifest the realm of the All-Knowing. Enemy magic and holy damage negation will be reduced for all within the area, including the caster.. Found via: Default skill on the Scepter of the All-Knowing..

Devourer of Worlds is a skill of type Unique, costing 35 FP. Effect: Charge the scepter with magic and strike it against the ground to steal the HP of all nearby enemies.. Found via: Default skill on the Devourer's Scepter..

Familial Rancor is a skill of type Unique, costing 25 FP. Effect: Gently rattle the copper heads to summon vengeful spirits that chase down foes.The anguish of a spouse and children invites accursed wrath.. Found via: Default skill on the Family Heads..

Rosus's Summons is a skill of type Unique, costing 15 FP. Effect: Raise the axe aloft to summon those lost in death.Three skeletons will appear at a distance and attack in tandem before vanishing.. Found via: Default skill on the Rosus' Axe..

Thunderstorm is a skill of type Unique, costing 19 ( - 12) FP. Effect: Imbue the armament's wing-blade with lightning and swing it around to create a tempestuous lightning storm. Follow up with an additional input to perform up to two spinning attacks. The lightning will stay on the blade for a while.. Found via: Default skill on the Stormhawk Axe..

Sacred Phalanx is a skill of type Unique, costing 12 FP. Effect: Release the power of a hidden incantation to erect a palisade of golden spears frontwards.. Found via: Drops from the spear wielding Cleanrot Knights just south of the Heart of Aeonia by Commander O'Neil (very low drop rate). It can also drop from the ghostly Cleanrot Knights in the War-Dead Catacombs. Drops from the spear wielding Cleanrot Knights in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Closest is directly outside the "Prayer Room" Site of Grace (very low drop rate)..

Great-Serpent Hunt is a skill of type Unique, costing 30 FP. Effect: Perform a powerful forward lunge and follow up with an upward thrust via additional input. When fightning a great serpent, a long blade of light will appear, revealing the armament's true power.. Found via: Default skill on the Serpent-Hunter..

Angel's Wings is a skill of type Unique, costing 17 FP. Effect: Jump and imbue the wing-blade of the armament with light, then deliver a slashing attack on the enemy. The white wings impede recovery actions using a flask of tears.. Found via: Default skill on the Winged Scythe..

Storm Kick is a skill of type Unique, costing 10 FP. Effect: Thrust the prosthetic leg blade into the ground, creating a storm.Follow up with a strong attack to perform a lightning-infused jumping attack.. Found via: Default skill for the Veteran's Prosthesis..

Sorcery of the Crozier is a skill of type Unique, costing 15 FP. Effect: Channel magic into the glintstone to activate an ancient sorcery, producing floating magic projectiles that chase enemies automatically.. Found via: Default skill on the Watchdog's Staff..

Erdtree Slam is a skill of type Unique, costing 19 FP. Effect: Jump high up into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends golden shockwaves in all directions. This is the most powerful of all the Ground Slam skills.. Found via: Unique skill of Staff of the Avatar and Rotten Staff..

Gravity Bolt is a skill of type Unique, costing 13 (-13) FP. Effect: Imbue the jaw of fallingstar beast with gravitational lightning, sending a bolt crashing down a short distance away. Can be fired in rapid succession.. Found via: Default skill on the Fallingstar Beast Jaw..

Fires of Slumber is a skill of type Unique, costing 15 FP. Effect: Blow into the candlestick's flame, creating a stream of hazy purple fire to cover the ground ahead.The intoxicating flames inflict the sleep ailment upon foes.. Found via: Default skill on St Trina's Torch..

Golden Retaliation is a skill of type Unique, costing 4 FP. Effect: Ready the shield to unleash its protective incantation.This will dispel sorceries and incantations, retaliating with golden power.. Found via: Unique skill of Erdtree Greatshield..

Contagious Fury is a skill of type Unique, costing 9 FP. Effect: Incite the jellyfish's wrath and allow its fury to flow through you.Raises attack power for a certain duration.. Found via: Default skill on the Jellyfish Shield..

Ordovis's Vortex is a skill of type Unique, costing 15 FP. Effect: Channel the power of the crucible to spin the entire sword in midair, building momentum before slamming the blade down onto the ground.This skill can be charged to increase its power.. Found via: Default skill on the Ordovis's Greatsword..

text: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy is a boss with 89,613 HP, fought at Volcano Manor (drops: 130.000, Rykard's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Blasphemous). Join the Serpent King, as family... Together, we will devour the very gods!
Mohg, Lord of Blood is a boss with 18,389 HP, fought at Mohgwyn Palace (drops: 420,000, Mohg's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Blood Lord). Welcome, honored guest. To the birthplace of our Dynasty!

Malenia, Blade of Miquella is a boss with 33,251 HP, fought at Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree (drops: 480,000 Malenia's Great Rune Remembrance of the Rot Goddess). ...Heed my words. I am Malenia. Blade of Miquella. And I have never known defeat.

Lichdragon Fortissax is a boss with 12,903 HP, fought at Deeproot Depths (drops: 90,000, Remembrance of the Lichdragon). After Godwyn the Golden became the Prince of Death, the ancient dragon fought long and hard against the Death within its companion. Alas, victory was never achieved and its only reward was corruption.
Maliketh, The Black Blade is a boss with 10,620 HP, fought at Crumbling Farum Azula (drops: 220,000, Remembrance of the Black Blade). Cower before Maliketh, Marika’s Black Blade.

Astel, Naturalborn of the Void is a boss with 11,170 HP, fought at Grand Cloister (drops: 80,000, Remembrance of the Naturalborn). A malformed star born in the lightless void far away. Once destroyed an Eternal City and took away their sky. A falling star of ill omen.

Regal Ancestor Spirit is a boss with 6,301 HP, fought at Nokron, Eternal City (drops: 24,000, Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor). Ancestral spirits exist as a phenomenon beyond the purview of the Erdtree. Life sprouts from death, as it does from birth. Such is the way of the living.

Radagon of the Golden Order is a boss with ≈ 13,339 (GOD) HP, fought at Stone Platform (drops: Elden Throne :, N/A). As the husband of Rennala of Caria, the red-haired Radagon studied sorcery, and as the husband of Queen Marika, he studied incantations. Thus did the hero aspire to be complete.
Godfrey, First Elden Lord is a boss with 21,903 HP, fought at Leyndell, Ashen Capital (drops: 300,000, Remembrance of Hoarah Loux).

Fire Giant is a boss with 42,363 HP, fought at Flame Peak (drops: 180,000, Remembrance of the Fire Giant). The Fire Giant is a survivor of the War against the Giants. Upon realizing the flames of their forge would never die, Queen Marika marked him with a curse.

Dragonlord Placidusax is a boss with 26,651 HP, fought at Crumbling Farum Azula (drops: 280,000, Remembrance of the Dragonlord). The Dragonlord whose seat lies at the heart of the storm beyond time is said to have been Elden Lord in the age before the Erdtree. Once his god was fled, the lord continued to await its return.

Godwyn the Golden is an NPC with the role: First Demigod to die. Found at: Deeproot Depths. Godwyn the Golden was a demigod and son of Queen Marika the Eternal and Godfrey the First Elden Lord. In the "Night of the Black Knives" he was assassinated by assassins from the land of the Numen with the use of daggers imbued with the Rune of Death. Godwyn the Golden was the firstborn son of Queen Marika the Eternal and her consort Godfrey, the First Elden Lord. Godwyn was a scion of the so-called "Golden Line", of which Godrick the Grafted was the final descendant. Early in his mother's divine reign, the Erdtree came under assault by the Dragons, who had ruled the world before Marika's ascent. The forces of the Erdtree managed to triumph against the dragons, with Godwyn prevailing against the dreaded Fortissax, earning the mighty dragon's friendship in the process. Godwyn would eventually meet his end during the Night of Black Knives. Seeking to be free from her fate as a pawn of the Greater Will, Godwyn's step-sister Lunar Princess Ranni stole a fragment of the rune of death from Maliketh, imbuing the weapons of Numen assassins with the rune. Ranni wished to shed her Empyrean body but preserve her spirit, which meant that someone else's spirit would need to die. Nevertheless, when the assassins fell upon the Royal Capital and murdered Godwyn, his soul was destroyed and left only his soulless body behind. He was the first demigod in history to die since the ascension of Marika to the throne of the Lands Between. Godwyn's death would be the catalyst for the Shattering of the Elden Ring, plunging the kingdom into chaos without the guidance of the Greater Will. Due to Ranni's ritual, Godwyn's flesh was branded with half of the cursemark of death and he became the first of Those Who Live in Death. His body was laid to rest deep in the roots of the Erdtree, but it would eventually corrupt it, leading Deathroot to sprout across the Lands Between, causing others to also rise in undeath. These undead worshipped Godwyn as the Prince of Death, believing he would eventually return and lead them. An aspect of Godwyn's corpse appeared in the depths of Stormveil Castle and is responsible for the loss of Rogier's legs. Many figures, including his half-brother Miquella and his companion Fortissax, tried to cure him of his condition and allow him a proper death, but to no avail. The deathbed companion Fia would become a leading figure among Those Who Live in Death, eventually making her way to Godwyn's corpse. Having received the other half of the cursemark from Ranni's discarded body with help from a Tarnished champion, Fia lay with Godwyn to grant him a second life as the Prince of Death. As a result of their union, Fia conceived a rune, which a champion seeking to become Elden Lord might use to mend the Elden Ring, reimbuing the principle of death within the Golden Order.

Millicent's Sisters is an NPC with the role: Ending of Millicent questline. Found at: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Millicent's Sisters is a NPC collective in Elden Ring. They are group of female warriors associated with Gowry.

Miquella is an NPC with the role: unspecified. Found at: Land of Shadow. Miquella, also known as Miquella the Kind, is a background character in Elden Ring and a central character in Shadow of the Erdtree. One of the Empyrean children of Queen Marika, he is the twin brother of Malenia, Blade of Miquella, together known as the Twin Prodigies. It is revealed that Miquella has stripped himself of his flesh and Empyrean lineage in the Land of Shadow, a place obscured by the Erdtree and purged in an unsung war.

Miriel, Pastor of Vows is an NPC with the role: Merchant. Found at: Church of Vows. Miriel, Pastor of Vows is an NPC in Elden Ring. Miriel, Pastor of Vows is the Liurna Church of Vow's steward, a huge silver tortoise wearing a mitre. He first interacts with you when arriving at the Church of Vows. Miriel, Pastor of Vows welcomes you and offers to share their knowledge of Sorceries and Incantations, as well as lore on certain characters.

Moore is an NPC with the role: Merchant. Found at: Outside Belurat, Tower Settlement. Moore is an NPC in Elden Ring. Moore is one of the followers of Miquella. A gentle giant that also acts as a Merchant. Moore is an NPC exclusive to the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC and does not appear in the base game.
Morne Spirit is an NPC with the role: Benevolent. Found at: Castle Morne. The Morne Spirit is an NPC in Elden Ring. He can be found locked inside a cage behind the castle.

Needle Knight Leda is an NPC with the role: Miquella's Followers Leader. Found at: Moghwyn Palace. Needle Knight Leda is an NPC in Elden Ring. Needle Knight Leda is the leader of Miquella's band of followers in the Realm of Shadow. She is an NPC exclusive to Shadow of the Erdtree and does not appear in the base game.

Nepheli Loux, Warrior is an NPC with the role: Quest NPC and Summon. Found at: Stormveil Castle. Nepheli Loux, Warrior is an NPC in Elden Ring. Nepheli Loux is a warrior and fellow tarnished who was ordered by decree from her adoptive father to kill and dethrone Godrick. She wears clothing similar to the starting Hero class, and she can help you in the battle against Godrick the Grafted if summoned. Her summoning sign is golden and is just outside the boss fog. Other NPC Summon opportunities include boss fights against Godfrey, First Elden Lord and Omenkiller (in Village of the Albinaurics). Progress in her questline to have her summon sign available for these encounters.

Patches the Untethered is a Merchant, NPC, and Field Boss in Elden Ring. Patches is a recurring character in From Software games, usually playing the part of a trickster. He can be found in Murkwater Cave. This is an optional boss as players do not need to defeat him to advance.
Pidia, Carian Servant is an NPC with the role: Merchant. Found at: Caria Manor. Pidia, Carian Servant is an NPC in Elden Ring, found in Caria Manor. He sells high end goods.

Preceptor Seluvis is an NPC with the role: Quest NPC and Merchant. Found at: Seluvis's Rise, Three Sisters. Preceptor Seluvis is an NPC in Elden Ring. Seluvis is a pompous sorcerer in service to Ranni the Witch. Seluvis Questline is important for players looking to make Magic Builds, so make sure to read all the Seluvis Questline steps below including a potential lockout due to your choices. Seluvis is first encountered in spectral form at Ranni's Rise in the Three Sisters sub-region of Liurnia of the Lakes.

Primeval Sorcerer Azur is an NPC with the role: unspecified. Found at: Hermit Village. Primeval Sorcerer Azur is an NPC in Elden Ring. Azur can be found near the cliffs north of the Hermit Village in Mt. Gelmir.

Queen Marika the Eternal is an NPC with the role: Ruler of The Lands Between. Found at: Within the Erdtree. Queen Marika the Eternal is a background character in Elden Ring and Shadow of the Erdtree. She is the current ruler of the Lands Between, and the one who shattered the Elden Ring. She has many powerful Demigod offspring, who seek the Elden Ring's remaining power (see Elden Ring Timeline).
Ranni Witch Carian Lunar Princess is an NPC with the role: Main NPC - Affects Endings. Found at: Ranni's Rise, Three Sisters.

text: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon is an NPC with the role: Last Carian Queen. Found at: Academy of Raya Lucaria. Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon is an NPC in Elden Ring. Rennala gives access to the Rebirth function, allowing the player to reallocate their stats by using a Larval Tear (also called respeccing). She can also be used to change the player's appearance.

text: Roderika is an NPC with the role: Spirit-Tuner. Found at: Stormhill ShackRoundtable Hold. Roderika is an NPC in Elden Ring. Roderika is a spirit-tuner that you will encounter at Stormhill Shack on the trail to Stormveil. She will later move to the Roundtable Hold if you progress her quest.
Rya is an NPC with the role: Scout. Found at: Volcano Manor. Rya is an NPC in Elden Ring. Rya acts as a scout for the Volcano Manor, and is the adopted daughter of Tanith.

Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy is an NPC with the role: unspecified. Found at: Volcano Manor. God-Devouring Serpent and Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy is a two-phase Demigod Boss in Elden Ring. The God-Devouring Serpent is a massive coiled serpent found at the Volcano Manor in Mt. Gelmir, and Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy is its true form that's revealed after the first phase is defeated. When Rykard offered himself up to the serpent in a pursuit of immortality, most of his followers turned on him and sought to bring him down with the Serpent-Hunter.

Sanguine Noble (NPC) is an NPC with the role: unspecified. Found at: Consecrated Snowfield. Sanguine Noble is an NPC enemy invader located in the Consecrated Snowfields. By heading West of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield grace, and just North of the Yelough Anix Ruins towards the cliff edge.

Shabriri is an NPC with the role: NPC and Summonable Cooperator. Found at: Mountaintops of the Giants. Shabriri is an NPC in Elden Ring. Shabriri can be found at the Mountaintops of the Giants and looks exactly the same as Bloody Finger Hunter Yura, as he implies the hunter died and he has been given his body. Shabriri can become available as an NPC Summon against Godfrey, First Elden Lord depending on questline progress and ending route.

He will upgrade your Weapons beyond the +3 level, as well as duplicating Ashes of War for a fee, provided you have the proper Materials.

She can be found inside the Waypoint Ruins, far east from where you first arrive in Limgrave. She can teach you Sorceries. She can also be made available as an NPC Summon for specific battles.

St. Trina is an NPC with the role: NPC Quest Related. Found at: Garden of Deep Purple (Stone Coffin Fissure). St. Trina is an NPC in Elden Ring. St. Trina was first mentioned in the base game in various items like St. Trina's Torch and resembles Miquella.

If you decide to join her quest, you will receive particular missions as well as access to some new Npcs.

The Two Fingers is an NPC with the role: Messenger of The Greater Will. Found at: Roundtable Hold. The Two Fingers are an PC in Elden Ring. They are large, shriveled hands with only two fingers that are said to deliver messages of The Greater Will that only the finger readers can interpret.

Jerren has the opportunity to fight alongside players as an NPC Summon.

Long ago, this was employed by the ascetics who strove to become tutelary deities as a ritualistic object in their self-flagellating dances. Their movements are almost dance-like, blending both elegance and lethality as they deliver their attacks. Their flashy combat style will leave their opponents disoriented and overwhelmed.

According to legend, Gravebirds were created to be kindred spirits to the Deathbirds, sharing a mysterious and sinister origin. Their primary purpose is to guard spiritgraves, the sacred resting places built to collect and contain the souls of all who have met their end.

However, the recent emergence of these gigantic Spider Scorpions has been traced back to the Church of the Bud.
