Owl is a creature found at: All across the Lands Between and Lands of Shadow. Drops: 4 - 16 Runes Slumbering Egg Beast Horn Nectarblood Burgeon Spirit Calculus. Nocturnal creatures, owls can often be seen perched on cliffsides, looking for preys.

Miranda Sprout is a creature found at: Across the Lands Between. Drops: 14 - 778 Runes, Poisonbloom, Miranda Powder, Miquella's Lily. Sweet little carnivorous blossoms that feed upon human flesh. They creep slowly, scattering toxic pollen. They are vulnerable to fire.

Land Squirt is a creature found at: Dragon-Burnt Ruins, Shores of Limgrave, Liurnia of the Lakes, Capital Outskirts, Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs. Drops: 13 - 215 Runes, Golden Runes, Strip of White Flesh, Poisonbloom. The firm, fleshy tubes of the creatures remain rooted to the spot, spraying poisonous liquid over their surroundings.

Giant Rat is a creature found at: Limgrave Tunnels, Ailing Village, Tombsward Cave, Altus Plateau. Drops: 13 - 514 Runes (Small) 94 - 2008 Runes (Large), Rune Arc, Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [3]. [They] swarm upon their victims... These vermin seem to multiply incessantly.

Springhare is a creature found at: Across the Lands Between and Lands of Shadow. Drops: 4 - 27 Runes, Thin Animal Bones, Sliver of Meat, Beast Liver, Beast Horn, Dragon's Calorbloom, Nectarblood Burgeon, Spirit Calculus.

Sheep is a creature found at: Pastures throughout The Lands Between and Lands of Shadow. Drops: 4 - 54 Runes, Thin Beast Bones, Budding Horn, Fulgurbloom, Sliver of Meat, Beast Liver, Yellow Fulgurbloom, Beast Horn, Empyrean-Blood Burgeon, Dragon's Calorbloom, Nectarblood Burgeon, Spirit Calculus. The wild sheep of the Lands Between have been roaming the wilds ever since The Shattering. They are timid and will often run away when spotted, with some even balling up and rolling away.

Skeletal Slime is a creature found at: Limgrave, Weeping Peninsula, Tombsward Cave, Redmane Castle, Writheblood Ruins, Wyndham Catacombs, Seethewater Cave, Minor Erdtree Catacombs, Consecrated Snowfield. Drops: 16 - 613 Runes Glass Shard Thin Beast Bones Hefty Beast Bone.

Spirit Jellyfish is a creature found at: All across the Lands Between. Drops: 14 - 569 Runes Grave Gloveworts Golden Rune [3] Trina's Lily. Ethereal beings usually found near places of rest, acting as protectors. They are usually peaceful, but if angered, they attack with deadly poison fired from a distance.

Teardrop Scarabs is a creature found at: All across the Lands Between and Lands of Shadow. Drops: Varied drops. These scarabs often roll clumps of valuable ashes of war during their labors, along with crimson and cerulean tears. They are very skittish, and will often flee when spotted.

Turtle is a creature found at: Limgrave, Liurnia of the Lakes, Altus Plateau, Gravesite Plain, Scadu Altus. Drops: 4 - 21 Runes, Turtle Neck Meat, Strip of White Flesh, Beast Horn, Nectarblood Burgeon, Spirit Calculus. Turtles are known as a nutritious ingredient, symbolic of inexhaustible power. However, those who hold turtles to be wise creatures consider the practice of eating their meat to be barbarous.

Lone Wolf is a creature found at: Limgrave, Liurnia of The Lakes, Groveside Cave, Consecrated Snowfield, Rivermouth Cave, Scadu Altus. Drops: 55 - 1470 Runes (Grey Variant), 97 - 2077 Runes (White Variant), Thin Animal Bones, Lump of Flesh. Lone Wolves roam the Lands Between in packs, overwhelming targets with their agility

Stray is a creature found at: All across the Lands Between and Lands of Shadow. Drops: 52 - 1829 Runes Ruin Fragment Thin Beast Bones Beast Blood Sanctuary Stone Sacramental Bud. ...Stray dog. ...Though it is only a small creature, it is as violent as it is nimble.

Bloody Finger Nerijus is a creature found at: Invades on the ravine leading north-east from Agheel Lake, toward Murkwater Catacombs. Drops: 1294 Runes (NG ) 431 Runes (NG, Co-op) Other Drops:, Reduvia. If it isn't Nerijus, The Bloody Finger. The end is nigh. For you, and your cessblood. - Yura

Exile Soldier is a creature found at: Fringefolk Hero's Grave, Stormveil Castle, Castle Sol. Drops: 39 - 938 Runes, Exile Set, Torchpole, Spear, Crescent Moon Axe Soldier's Crossbow Smithing Stones Stormhawk Feather Smoldering Butterfly Mushroom. ...Soldiers sent to the penal colonies, who were required to keep their faces hidden.

Demi-Human is a creature found at: Limgrave, Weeping Peninsula, Liurnia of the Lakes, Caelid, Mt Gelmir, Altus Plateau, Mountaintops of the Giants. Drops: 42 - 561 Runes, Rickety Shield, Falchion, Spiked Club, Great Knife, Bloodstained Dagger, String, Glowstone, Rainbow Stone, Ruin Fragment. Demi-Humans are small in stature, but they have a violent, brutish disposition. Though they seem somewhat intelligent, when night falls, their blood boils and they become feral.

Golem is a creature found at: Stormhill, Castle Morne, Ainsel River Well, Leyndell, Royal Capital, Mountaintops of the Giants. Drops: 844 - 3927 Runes Golem's Halberd Golem Greatbow Great Arrow Golem's Great Arrow Golem's Magic Arrow Smithing Stones.

Imp is a creature found at: Many Catacombs, Many Heroes' Graves, Auriza Side Tomb, The rooftops of Leyndell Royal Capital, The pipes of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. Drops: 40 - 1784 Runes, Imp Head (Cat), Imp Head (Wolf), Imp Head (Fanged), Imp Head (Long-Tongued), Forked Hatchet, Forked Greatsword, Smithing Stones, Smoldering Butterfly, Glintstone Firefly, Fulgurbloom, Mushroom. These spirits are well suited to causing a disturbance, moving nimbly like pests and hurling magic pots.

Miner is a creature found at: Limgrave Tunnels, Sealed Tunnel, Liurnia of the Lakes, Ruin-Strewn Precipice, Morne Tunnel, Gael Tunnel, Old Altus Tunnel, Yelough Anix Tunnel. Drops: 92 - 1961 Runes, Pickaxe, Explosive Stone, Explosive Stone Clump, Poisoned Stone, Poisoned Stone Clump, Smithing Stones, Gravel Stone, Cracked Crystal.

Troll is a creature found at: Throughout the Lands Between. Drops: 1000 - 7800 Runes, Eye of Yelough, Arteria Leaf, Troll Knight’s Sword. The lesser giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago. Though the giants have lost their minds, they stay inseparable from their swords that are in sad shape—such that the gold plating had flaked away.

Kaiden Sellsword is a creature found at: Limgrave, Weeping Peninsula, Consecrated Snowfield. Drops: 282 - 4399 Runes Kaiden Set Dismounter, Rowa Raisin Sweet Raisin Frozen Raisin. These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the mountaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

Godrick Soldier is a creature found at: Limgrave, Gatefront Ruins, Castle Morne, Stormgate, Tower of Return. Drops: 38 - 70 Runes, Godrick Soldier Set, Lordsworn's Straight Sword, Warpick, Heavy Crossbow, Lordsworn's Shield, Brass Shield, Bolt, Lordsworn's Bolt, Smithing Stone [1]. The soldiers who serve Godrick the Grafted are what remains of the army that fled the royal capital of the Erdtree.
Godrick Foot Soldier is a creature found at: Limgrave. Drops: 56 - 59 Runes, Godrick Foot Soldier Set, Dagger, Short Sword, Short Spear, Soldier's Crossbow, Bolt, Smoldering Butterfly, Mushroom.

Skeletal Militiaman is a creature found at: In the beaches and graveyards of the Lands Between. Drops: 35 - 682 Runes, Human Bone Shard. Militiamen who live in Death, and will continue to rise again until properly finished off. This is the grotesque fate of those who come into contact with Deathroot.

Skeletal Bandit is a creature found at: Dungeons and graveyards of the Lands Between. Drops: 35 - 682 Runes, Bandit's Curved Sword Human Bone Shard. The remains of former bandits that will continue to rise again until properly finished off. After the night of the plot, Deathroot appeared in the Lands Between, and Those Who Live in Death soon followed.
Skeleton Mage is a creature found at: Typically found in graveyards across the Lands Between. Drops: 108 - 682 Runes, Grave Scythe, Human Bone Shard.

Living Jar is a creature found at: Multiple Locations. Drops: 50 - 518 Runes (Small), 353 - 1831 Runes (Large), Living Jar Shard, Raw Meat Dumpling (Large). Though the jars are brought to life by human flesh and blood, they are all rather kindly folk. Perhaps they were made to be better than their innards. Their fragments command a high price due to the magical power locked within. This leaves the living jars unfortunate targets for poachers.

Lesser Alabaster Lord is a creature found at: Seaside Ruins, Yelough Anix Tunnel, Ailing Village. Drops: 311 - 4852 Runes, Alabaster Lord’s Sword, Ash of War: Gravitas. A race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.

Misbegotten is a creature found at: Castle Morne, Mt. Gelmir, Miquella’s Haligtree, Leyndell, Royal Capital. Drops: 58 - 6810 Runes, Iron Cleaver, Misbegotten Shortbow, Longhaft Axe, Iron Greatsword, Old Fang. The misbegotten are held to be a punishment for making contact with the Crucible, and from birth they are treated as slaves, or worse.

Wandering Nobles is a creature found at: Most Main Roadways, Near or around ruins that have fallen from the sky, Volcano Manor, Gelmir Hero's Grave. Drops: 11 - 743 Runes, Aristocrat Set, Old Aristocrat Set, Aristocrat Hat, Glintstone Staff, Noble's Estoc, Noble's Slender Sword, Ruin Fragment, Rowa Fruit, Herba, Erdleaf Flower, Golden Sunflower, Fire Blossom, Rimed Crystal Bud, Ruin Fragment. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead beings are the pitiful product of unending life. They are most commonly found struggling to maintain balance while roaming the fields of The Lands Between. Surely they were in search of something once - but whatever it was has long been forgotten.

Noble Sorcerer is a creature found at: Various. Drops: Glintstone Staff, Aristocrat Headband, Aristocrat Garb, Aristocrat Boots, Rowa Fruit, Ruin Fragment, Erdleaf Flower. Noble Sorcerers are frail old men wearing tattered garbs and a dirty yellow cape. They use a standard glintstone staff as both a sorcery catalyst and walking stick.

School of Graven Mages is a creature found at: Weeping Peninsula, Liurnia of the Lakes, Caelid, Consecrated Snowfield, Various Towers across The Lands Between. Drops: 50 - 1285 Runes. The primeval current is a forbidden tradition of glintstone sorcery. To those who cleave to its teachings, the act of collecting sorcerers to fashion them into the seeds of stars is but another path of scientific inquiry.

Recusant Henricus is a creature found at: East of Stormhill Shack. Drops: 338 Runes (NG+), Hammer Talisman. An invader serving the Volcano Manor, tasked with hunting down fellow Tarnished. His large mace can make quick of any unfortunate targets.
Mounted Knight is a creature found at: North-east region of Limgrave. Drops: Ash of War: Golden Vow.
Lookout Stones is a creature found at: Found near Evergaols, cemeteries, and specific points of interest.. Drops: 23 - 499 Runes, Ruin Fragment, Sanctuary Stone, Volcanic Stone.
Wild Mouflon is a creature found at: Stormhill. Drops: None. Wild Mouflons become hostile when threatened and fight their aggressors by charging forward and striking them with their large horns.
Godrick Knight is a creature found at: Limgrave. Drops: 260 - 273 Runes, Godrick Knight Set, Knight's Greatsword, Partisan, Gilded Greatshield.
Chanting Winged Dame is a creature found at: Weeping Peninsula, Stillwater Cave, Ruin-Strewn Precipice, Caelid, Fort Faroth. Drops: 110 - 1518 Runes, Golden Runes.
Lesser Runebear is a creature found at: Open field areas, forests, and caves. Drops: 1196 - 9329 Runes, Beast Blood, Gold-tinged Excrement, Hefty Beast Bone, Lump of Flesh.

Commoner is a creature found at: Stormveil Castle, Ailing Village, Black Knife Catacombs, Frenzied Flame Village, Redmane Castle, Altus Plateau, Volcano Manor, Capital Outskirts, Leyndell Royal Capital, Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, Yelough Anix Ruins. Drops: 40 - 1020 Runes, Commoner's Set, Weathered Straight Sword, Glass Shard, Yellow Ember. The boards that hang from their necks depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. A self imposed shackle, that displayed their allegiance to the Erdtree. ...Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

Banished Knight is a creature found at: Stormveil Castle, Cathedral of Dragon Communion, Castle Sol, Crumbling Farum Azula. Drops: 168 - 3091 Runes, Banished Knight Set, Banished Knight's Greatsword, Banished Knight's Halberd, Banished Knight's Shield. Many knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

Omen is a creature found at: Stormveil Castle, Cliffbottom Catacombs, Unsightly Catacombs, Altus Plateau, Auriza Hero's Grave, Leyndell Catacombs, Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. Drops: 451 - 2520 Runes, Omen Cleaver, Warped Axe.
Burning Slug is a creature found at: Stormhill, Liurnia of The Lakes, Mt Gelmir, Capital Outskirts, Mountaintops of the Giants, Consecrated Snowfield. Drops: 12 - 474 Runes, Smoldering Butterfly.

Flame Chariot is a creature found at: Liurnia of The Lakes, Fort Laiedd, Fort Gael. Drops: 1270 - 2328 Runes, Smoldering Butterfly, Fire Blossom, Smithing Stones. Beware the Fire Monks' chariots bearing the faces of giants. - Note: Flame Chariots

Fire Monk is a creature found at: Liurnia of the Lakes, Fort Laiedd, Mountaintops of the Giants. Drops: 205 - 1076 Runes, Fire Monk Set, Monk's Flamemace, Monk's Flameblade, Smoldering Butterfly, Fire Blossom. The Fire Monks are guardians of the flame of ruin, forbidden by the Erdtree and said to be kept high in the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.

Leyndell Knight is a creature found at: Liurnia of The Lakes, Altus Plateau, Mt Gelmir, Leyndell, Royal Capital. Drops: 620 - 1310 Runes, Leyndell Knight Set, Knight's Greatsword, Partisan, Greatbow, Golden Greatshield, Great Arrow. Knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. The golden canopy atop their helmets represent the honor of standing among the tree's defenders.

Marionette Soldier is a creature found at: Witchbane Ruins, Liurnia of the Lakes, Raya Lucaria Academy, Academy Gate Town, Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, Mt Gelmir, Caelid, Heretical Rise, Scadu Altus. Drops: 60 - 695 Runes, Marionette Soldier Set, Spiked Spear, Shortbow, Arrow, Cuckoo Glintstone. Marionette soldiers were created to serve a sorcerer. On the verge of falling apart, they are ill—disciplined and attack without warning.

Glintstone Sorcerer is a creature found at: Raya Lucaria Academy, Sellia, Town of Sorcery, Hermit Village. Drops: 121 - 363 Runes, Raya Lucarian Sorcerer Set, Academy Glintstone Staff. Glintstone sorcerers are the descendants of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars

Lazuli Sorcerer is a creature found at: Caria Manor, Raya Lucaria Academy, Academy Crystal Cave, Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Drops: 128 - 201 Runes, Lazuli Sorcerer Set, Lazuli Glintstone Sword. Scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus study Carian sorceries - a heterodox pursuit that views the moon as equal to the stars.

Twinsage Sorcerer is a creature found at: Raya Lucaria Academy, Academy Crystal Cave, Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Drops: 133 - 212 Runes, Raya Lucarian Sorcerer Set, Academy Glintstone Staff. Raya Lucaria sorcerers who wear a stone crown. T hose who study the Twinsage Conspectus are the academy's elite, capable of mastering the Glintstone Cometshard and Crystal Burst sorcereries.

Ancestral Follower is a creature found at: Siofra River, Consecrated Snowfield, Minor Erdtree (Liurnia Northeast), Nokron, Eternal City. Drops: 182 - 2311 Runes, Thin Beast Bones, Budding Horn, Dwelling Arrow, Fur Leggings. Horned folk who eschew letters and metalworking. The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

Clayman is a creature found at: Siofra River , Ainsel River. Drops: 117 - 553 Runes, Clayman's Harpoon, Silver Firefly. The warped remains of priests who searched for revelation in service of the ancient dynasty, they employ two sorceries that produce smaller and larger bubbles.
Skeletal Snail is a creature found at: Capital Outskirts, Sage's Cave, Mountaintops of the Giants. Drops: 148 - 317 Runes, Serpent Arrow.

Vulgar Militiamen is a creature found at: Ruin-Strewn Precipice, Liurnia of the Lakes, Forbidden Lands, Near the Bestial Sanctum, Gaol Cave. Drops: 112 - 1559 Runes, Vulgar Militia Set, Vulgar Militia Saw, Vulgar Militia Shotel, Kukri. In the Lands Between, the small were scorned, and so they formed their vulgar militia as a means to make a living, albeit in ignominy. Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. This is where the vulgar militia serve, as untiring, unsung watchkeepers.

Silver Tear is a creature found at: Nokron, Eternal City, Nokstella, Eternal City. Drops: 246 - 472 Runes, Silver Tear Husk, Gravel Stone, Golden Rune (7). The Silver Tear makes mockery of life, reborn again and again into imitation. Perhaps, one day, it will be reborn a lord...

Fallen Hawks Soldier is a creature found at: Nokron, Eternal City, Siofra Aqueduct. Drops: 246 Runes, Spiritflame Arrow, Iron Spear, Inverted Hawk Towershield, Dewkissed Herba. When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity.
Crucible Knights is a creature found at: All across the Lands Between and Lands of Shadow. Drops: Varied drops.
Giant Ant is a creature found at: Ainsel River, Nokstella, Eternal City, Deeproot Depths, Miquella's Haligtree. Drops: 122 - 2268 Runes, Formic Rock, Rune Arc, Numen's Rune.

Nox Swordstress is a creature found at: Nokron, Eternal City, Nokstella, Eternal City. Drops: 391 - 635 Runes, Nox Swordstress Set. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

Baleful Shadow is a creature found at: Ainsel River Main. Drops: 8561 Runes. I turned my back on the Two Fingers and we each have been cursing the other since. The Baleful Shadows... are their assassins. - Miniature Ranni
Malformed Star is a creature found at: Ainsel River, Altus Tunnel / Perfumer's Grotto. Drops: 3844 - 7995 Runes.

Mausoleum Knight is a creature found at: Bellum Highway, Consecrated Snowfield, Deeproot Depths. Drops: 406 - 4056 Runes, Mausoleum Knight Set, Knight's Greatsword, Partisan, Greatbow, Eclipse Crest Greatshield. A self-inflicted curse ties the spirits of these loyal knights to the land, having willingly beheaded themselves so that they may serve their masters in death.

Basilisk is a creature found at: The Shaded Castle, Mt Gelmir, Auriza Hero's Grave, Deeproot Depths, Volcano Manor, Ainsel River, Lake of Rot, Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. Drops: 130 - 819 Runes, Aeonian Butterfly.

Highwayman is a creature found at: Murkwater Cave. Drops: 59 Runes, Highwayman Set, Short Sword, Dagger, Bolt, Smoldering Butterfly, Mushroom. Former foot soldiers who have since turned to banditry. They ambush any who approach, wishing to take their valuables for themselves.

Azula Beastman is a creature found at: Crumbling Farum Azula. Drops: 1284 - 1584 Runes, Beastman's Cleaver, Beastman's Curved Sword, Beastman's Jar-Shield, Gravel Stone, Sanctuary Stone. Beastmen from doomed Farum Azula, the slowly crumbling ruins in the skies. These ruins are said to be the remains of a giant mausoleum enshrining an ancient dragon, guarded by chosen beastmen who wield weapons clad in lightning.

Farum Azula Dragon is a creature found at: Crumbling Farum Azula. Drops: Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone (Greater Farum Azula Dragons only) Gravel Stone x3 (respawning Lesser Farum Azula Dragon only) Runes (32,400, 21,600, or 14,400 depending on type). Ancestors of the modern dragons, the ancient dragons had scales of Gravel Stone and wielded lightning as their weapon. It is said that they once attacked Leyndell, the Royal Capital. Spoken of in legend, red lightning is the weapon wielded by the ancient dragons.
Lesser Wormface is a creature found at: Altus Plateau, Crumbling Farum Azula. Drops: 541 - 6812 Runes, Gold-Tinged Excrement, Sacrificial Twig.

Lesser Red Wolf of Radagon is a creature found at: Liurnia of The Lakes Consecrated Snowfield Nokron, Eternal City. Drops: 1,386 - 8,190 Runes. Extremely large wolves with scarlet fur, often found as the alpha of their pack. It is capable of casting Magic Glintblades, using them along with their blistering speed.

Mausoleum Soldier is a creature found at: Consecrated Snowfield, Liurnia of the Lakes, Weeping Peninsula, Deeproot Depths. Drops: 67 - 1701 Runes, Mausoleum Soldier Set, Lordsworn's Straight Sword, Warpick, Heavy Crossbow, Lordsworn's Shield, Brass Shield, Lordsworn's Bolt, Bolt, Smithing Stones. ...Soldiers who confound foes by disappearing and reappearing at will. The mausoleum is where the bodies of soulless demigods are lain to rest, and these soldiers followed their masters into Death by severing their own heads from their bodies.

Battlemage is a creature found at: Academy Crystal Cave, Sellia Hideaway (outside), West Windmill Pasture, Miquella's Haligtree. Drops: 417 - 5682 Runes, Battlemage Set, Stone Club, Somber Smithing Stones. Whenever war broke out and the academy sealed its gates, only Haima's scholars dared venture outside. Seclusion is no way to foster discovery; it is only a convenient form of escape. Scholars of the Haima Conspectus sought the power to quell conflict, and to this end studied the sorceries of cannon fire and the gavel.

Celebrant is a creature found at: Dominula, Windmill Village. Drops: 279 Runes, Festive Set, Blue Festive Set, Celebrant's Cleaver, Celebrant's Rib-Rake, Celebrant's Sickle, Human Bone Shard, Golden Rune [3]. Dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Crystal Snail is a creature found at: Altus Tunnel, Liurnia of the Lakes, Consecrated Snowfield, Sellia Crystal Tunnel, Lakeside Crystal Cave, Moonlight Altar. Drops: 42 - 727 Runes, Glintstone Firefly. Snails with crystals growing from their shell. Normally found curled up within their shells blending in to their surroundings, will attack if provoked.

Glintstone Miner is a creature found at: Altus Tunnel, Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, Sellia Crystal Tunnel. Drops: 155 - 569 Runes, Digger's Staff, Glintstone Scrap, Large Glintstone Scrap, Somber Smithing Stones. The ever-working miners of the tunnels, tasked with harvesting crystals from deep beneath. Their staff allows them to summon a drill to shatter rock and enemies alike.

Avionette Soldier is a creature found at: Raya Lucaria Academy, Mt Gelmir, Altus Tunnel, Caelid, Heretical Rise. Drops: 163 - 695 Runes, Marionette Soldier Birdhelm, Cuckoo Glintstone. Marionette soldiers with avian features that were created to serve a sorcerer. Equipped with long-hafted scythes and swords, they also attack from the skies by lobbing fire pots. Can sometimes malfunction when damaged
Demi-Human Queen is a creature found at: Demi-Human Forest Ruins, Gravesite Plain, Cerulean Coast, Charo's Hidden Grave. Drops: 1013 Runes, Demi-Human Queen's Staff, Crystal Burst.

Wraith Caller is a creature found at: Liurnia of the Lakes, Altus Plateau, The Shaded Castle, Sainted Hero's Grave, Lunar Estate Ruins, Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. Drops: 72 - 477 Runes, Grave Violet.

Albinauric is a creature found at: Liurnia of the Lakes, Village of the Albinaurics, Caria Manor, Volcano Manor, Leyndell Royal Capital, Castle Sol, Consecrated Snowfield, Ordina Liturgical Town, Mohgwyn Palace. Drops: 66 - 4711 Runes, Blue Silver Set, Black Dumpling, Dirty Chainmail, Curved Club, Curved Great Club, Ripple Crescent Halberd, Albinauric Bow, Albinauric Shield, St. Trina's Arrow, Arrow, Glintstone Firefly, Albinauric Bloodclot. Albinaurics are lifeforms made by human hands. Thus, many believe them to live impure lives, untouched by the Erdtree's grace.
Chariot is a creature found at: Fringefolk Hero's Grave, Auriza Hero's Grave, Gelmir Hero's Grave. Drops: Erdtree Greatbow, Tree Sentinel Set, Ash of War: Holy Ground.

Revenant is a creature found at: Laskyar Ruins, Sainted Hero's Grave, The Shaded Castle, Sellia Hideaway, Lunar Estate Ruins, Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Drops: 1368 - 12121 Runes, Sacrificial Twig, Ghost Gloveworts. A grotesque amalgamation of limbs, the Revenant is a creature with the body structure of an arachnid and the face of a human. Much like a spider, it possesses many limbs that seem to have been grafted onto its body, taken from diseased humans. The Revenant is capable of traveling through portals it creates with a peculiar form of magic, swiftly emerging behind a foe to catch them off guard.

Lesser Mad Pumpkin Head is a creature found at: Limgrave, Castle Morne, Raya Lucaria Academy, Fort Haight, Redmane Castle, Altus Plateau, Mt Gelmir. Drops: 273 - 1032 Runes, Pumpkin Helm, Chainlink Flail, Smithing Stone [1], Sanctuary Stone. Though he has stifled his panic within the dark confines of his helmet, he rampages as if driven mad when agitated by bloodshed or the humming of insects. This mad soldier is all that is left of a broken gladiator.
Grafted Scion is a creature found at: All across the Lands Between and Lands of Shadow. Drops: Varied drops.

Perfumer is a creature found at: Perfumer's Ruins, Perfumer's Grotto, Leyndell Royal Capital. Drops: 370 - 563 Runes, Perfumer Set, Perfumer's Shield, Miranda Powder, Budding Cave Moss, Altus Bloom. In time past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives

Blackflame Monk is a creature found at: Divine Tower of Caelid, Volcano Manor. Drops: 830 - 1764 Runes, Blackflame Monk Set, Smoldering Butterfly, Fire Blossom. The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.
Broken Statue is a creature found at: Leyndell Royal Capital, Deeproot Depths. Drops: 3332 - 3517 Runes.
Chief Guardian Arghanthy is a creature found at: Guardian's Garrison , in Mountaintops of the Giants. Drops: 5,040 Runes, One-Eyed Shield.
Abductor Virgin is a creature found at: Raya Lucaria Academy, Caria Manor, Caelid, Mt. Gelmir, Volcano Manor. Drops: 1312 - 3181 Runes.
Flame Guardian is a creature found at: Guardians' Garrison. Drops: 2415 Runes.

Frenzied Villager is a creature found at: Ailing Village, Frenzied Flame Village, Frenzy-Flaming Tower, Yelough Anix Ruins. Drops: 48 - 1020 Runes, Weathered Straight Sword, Glass Shard, Yellow Ember, Eye of Yelough.

Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater is a creature found at: Smoldering Church , Limgrave, Corpse-Stench Shack , Mt. Gelmir, Consecrated Snowfield. Drops: none recorded. The knife-wielding Ogress Anastasia, known to have eaten countless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden.

Great Horned Tragoth is a creature found at: Ruin-Strewn Precipice. Drops: 158 Runes, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Rune Arc, Bull-Goat Helm, Bull-Goat Armor, Bull-Goat Gauntlets, Bull-Goat Greaves. Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid.

Guardian is a creature found at: Minor Erdtrees across the Lands Between. Drops: 63 - 1609 Runes, Guardian Set, Guardian's Swordspear, Tarnished Golden Sunflower. In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths lead not to destruction, but instead to renewed. eternal life as guardians.

Lesser Black Knife Assassin is a creature found at: Leyndell, Royal Capital, Ordina Liturgical Town. Drops: Ghost Glovewort (9). The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

Page is a creature found at: Tombsward Ruins, Caria Manor, Redmane Castle, The Shaded Castle, Leyndell Royal Capital, Gelmir Hero's Grave, Consecrated Snowfield. Drops: 257 - 3813 Runes, Page Set, Red Branch Shortbow, Perfumer's Bolt. ...Pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way. Uses a piercing sword and crossbow to defend [their] master.

Lesser Bloodhound Knight is a creature found at: Raya Lucaria Academy, Swamp Lookout Tower, Gelmir Hero’s Grave, Volcano Manor. Drops: 491 - 1764 Runes. The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers. Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.

Moongrum, Carian Knight is a creature found at: Raya Lucaria Academy. Drops: 1831. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, their power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle

Lesser Kindred of Rot (Pests) is a creature found at: Sellia Crystal Tunnel, Caelid Waypoint Ruins, Grand Cloister, Seethewater Cave. Drops: 612 - 6270 Runes, Pest's Glaive, Aeonian Butterfly, Faded Erdleaf Flower. Pale pests who crawl through the lands afflicted by scarlet rot; the abandoned children of the goddess. "Rot for the scarlet goddess. O scarlet blossoms, flourish in distant lands, and return to us, the unwanted children."
Servant of Rot is a creature found at: Tombsward Cave, Stillwater Cave, Seethewater Cave, Caelid Waypoint Ruins, Abandoned Cave, Swamp of Aeonia. Drops: 56 - 311 Runes, Serpent Arrow, Toxic Mushroom.
Glintstone Dragon is a creature found at: Moonlight Altar ,, Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops: Dragon Heart.
Godrick Foot Soldier is a creature found at: Limgrave. Drops: 56 - 59 Runes, Godrick Foot Soldier Set, Dagger, Short Sword, Short Spear, Soldier's Crossbow, Bolt, Smoldering Butterfly, Mushroom.

Raya Lucaria Foot Soldier is a creature found at: Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops: 108 Runes, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldier Set, Dagger, Short Sword, Soldier's Crossbow, Bolt, Smoldering Butterfly. Foot Soldiers usually guarding camps and ruins with their fellow Soldiers, they wander around the Raya Lucaria Academy located within Liurnia of the Lakes.

Leyndell Foot Soldier is a creature found at: Altus Plateau, Leyndell Royal Capital. Drops: 305 - 683 Runes, Leyndell Foot Soldier Set, Dagger, Short Sword, Short Spear, Soldier's Crossbow, Bolt, Smoldering Butterfly, Fulgurbloom. ...Foot Soldiers protecting the royal capital of Leyndell.

Radahn Foot Soldier is a creature found at: Caelid. Drops: 172 - 1055 Runes, Radahn Foot Soldier Set, Dagger, Short Sword, Short Spear, Bolt, Smoldering Butterfly, Mushroom. Base level soldiers, serving General Radahn's army.
Mausoleum Foot Soldier is a creature found at: Consecrated Snowfield. Drops: 1502 Runes, Bloodsoaked Tabard. ...Headless foot soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

Haligtree Foot Soldier is a creature found at: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Drops: 2238 Runes, Haligtree Foot Soldier Set, Dagger, Bolt, Smoldering Butterfly. ...Common soldiers who carry the sacred light. When weakened, they explode to deliver a last-ditch attack. This was the bitter revelation discovered by the desperate soldiers who awaited the return of their lord to the rotted Haligtree. May the flash of our deaths guide Miquella's return.

Starcaller is a creature found at: Weeping Peninsula, Ainsel River, Altus Plateau. Drops: 57 - 512 Runes, Gravity Stone Fan, Gravity Stone Chunk. Scavengers desperately digging around craters found in the wake of meteorite strikes, they dub themselves Starcallers.

Thorn Sorcerer is a creature found at: Liurnia of the Lakes, Fort Laiedd, Mountaintops of the Giants. Drops: 104 - 661 Runes, Staff of the Guilty, Smoldering Butterfly. The guilty, their eyes gouged by thorns, lived in eternal darkness. There, they discovered the blood star.

Giant Crayfish is a creature found at: Liurnia of the Lakes, Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, Mountaintops of the Giants, Cerulean Coast, Gravesite Plain, Scadu Altus. Drops: 500 - 2374 Runes, Strip of White Flesh, Crab Eggs, Rimed Crystal Bud, Smithing Stones.
Giant Land Squirt is a creature found at: Liurnia of the Lakes, Swamp of Aeonia, Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs. Drops: 367 - 1678 Runes, Golden Runes, Poisonbloom, Strip of White Flesh.
Monstrous Dog is a creature found at: Caelid, Dragonbarrow, Mountaintops of the Giants. Drops: 313 - 1808 Runes, Hefty Beast Bone, Beast Blood.
Monstrous Crow is a creature found at: Caelid, Flame Peak, Mohgwyn Palace. Drops: 1009 - 11038 Runes, Hefty Beast Bone, Beast Blood, Golden Rune [5], Blood-Tainted Excrement.

Bear is a creature found at: Mistwood, Weeping Peninsula, Liurnia of the Lakes, Moonlight Altar, Altus Plateau, Mt Gelmir, Capital Outskirts, Dragonbarrow, Consecrated Snowfield. Drops: 15 - 101 Runes, Lump of Flesh, Hefty Beast Bone, Beast Blood.

Oracle Envoy is a creature found at: Leyndell Royal Capital, Miquella's Haligtree. Drops: 368 - 1653 Runes, Envoy's Horn, Strip of White Flesh. Monstrous band of musicians who employ sacred arts. It is said that when Oracle Envoys appear playing their pipes, they do so to herald the arrival of a new god, or age.

Putrid Corpse is a creature found at: Various. Drops: 25 - 1266 Runes, Mushroom, Melted Mushroom, Toxic Mushroom, Bloodrose. Their movements are dull and confused... True death does not come easily for them.

Haligtree Knight is a creature found at: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Drops: 5928 Runes, Haligtree Knight Set, Knight's Greatsword, Greatbow, Haligtree Crest Greatshield, Great Arrow, Miquella's Lily. Knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. They are skilled in using both magical and holy skills, loyally protecting the rotted Haligtree to the very end.

Haligtree Soldier is a creature found at: Miquella's Haligtree, Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Drops: 2534 Runes, Haligtree Soldier Set, Lordsworn's Straight Sword, Warpick, Heavy Crossbow, Lordsworn's Shield, Brass Shield, Lordsworn's Bolt, Bolt, Smithing Stones, Miquella's Lily. Loyal Soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. While rather unimpressive on their own, they are often found in large groups, using numbers to their advantage.

Leyndell Soldier is a creature found at: Leyndell Royal Capital, Altus Plateau, Mt Gelmir. Drops: 345 - 773 Runes, Leyndell Soldier Set, Lordsworn's Straight Sword, Warpick, Heavy Crossbow, Lordsworn's Shield, Brass Shield, Lordsworn's Bolt, Bolt, Smithing Stones. The soldiers of Leyndell fight their battles defensively. During the Shattering, they were the ramparts that fortified the royal capital.

Radahn Soldier is a creature found at: Caelid. Drops: 194 - 1194 Runes, Radahn Soldier Set, Lordsworn's Straight Sword, Warpick, Heavy Crossbow, Lordsworn's Shield, Brass Shield, Lordsworn's Bolt, Bolt, Smithing Stones, Smoldering Butterfly, Mushroom. General Radahn's soldiers were all reputed to be masterful warriors, and it was popularly said that the Redmanes knew no weakness.

Redmane Knight is a creature found at: Caelid. Drops: 578 - 2882 Runes, Redmane Knight Set, Knight's Greatsword, Partisan, Greatbow, Redmane Greatshield, Great Arrow. Knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Their red plumes is a symbol of Radahn's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son - the mane of the proud Red Lion.
Rotten Duelist is a creature found at: Consecrated Snowfield. Drops: Rotten Duelist Armor Set, Rotten Greataxe, Rotten Battle Hammer.

Albinauric Archer is a creature found at: Consecrated Snowfield, Ordina Liturgical Town. Drops: 4243 - 4711 Runes, Blue Silver Set, Albinauric Bow, St. Trina's Arrow, Arrow, Albinauric Bloodclot. These warrior Albinaurics have weak legs, which makes them unable to walk. Thus, they rely on their archery to take down opponents. Those found riding Direwolves are a force to be reckoned with.

Ancestral Follower Shaman is a creature found at: Ancestral Woods, Consecrated Snowfield. Drops: 1049 - 4508 Runes, Shaman Set, Budding Horn, Nascent Butterfly, Thin Beast Bones. The ancestral followers live a distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.
Colossal Fingercreeper is a creature found at: Flame Peak, Scaduview. Drops: 4627 Runes.

Cuckoo Knight is a creature found at: Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops: 406 - ? Runes, Partisan, Knight's Greatsword, Cuckoo Greatshield, Cuckoo Knight Set. Knights, named for the cuckoo feather on their helmets, who faithfully serve the Academy of Raya Lucaria, and were given free rein to wage war as they please. Like their masters, they use various sorceries for combat, but they are more skilled in melee combat.

Depraved Perfumer is a creature found at: Village of the Albinaurics, Shaded Castle. Drops: 385 - 880 Runes, Depraved Perfumer Set, Perfumer's Shield, Miranda Powder, Budding Cave Moss, Altus Bloom. These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.
Direwolf is a creature found at: Caria Manor, Consecrated Snowfield. Drops: 371 - 3650 Runes, Thin Animal Bones, Lump of Flesh.

Duelist is a creature found at: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Drops: Duelist Set, Duelist Greataxe, Battle Hammer. Former gladitorial fighters who were exiled from the colloseum. They wield chain axes and hammers, and attack with a frenzied fervor.

Edgar the Revenger is a creature found at: Revenger's Shack , Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops: 316 Runes, 12000 Runes (NG+), Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Shabriri Grape, Banished Knight's Halberd (+8), Raw Meat Dumpling x 5. ...Ahh the poor fellow... Gone perfectly mad. Love... Revenge....the frenzied flame melts it all away... - Spirit

Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm is a creature found at: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Drops: Nothing. A silent seeker of sorcery, who had gone so far as to make contact with the primeval current, Wilhelm was led by guidance into confrontation with his friend Vargram, and it is said that he was then taken prisoner in Roundtable Hold.
Festering Fingerprint Vyke is a creature found at: Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops: Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Fingerprint Grape, Vyke's War Spear.

Fingercreeper is a creature found at: Caria Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes, Mt. Gelmir Leyndell Royal Capital (Sewers), Mountaintops of the Giants, Finger Ruins of Rhia, Scadu Altus, Scaduview, Charo's Hidden Grave, Foot of the Jagged Peak. Drops: 418 - 1911 Runes, Somber Smithing Stones.

Fire Prelate is a creature found at: Fort Laiedd, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, Guardians' Garrison, near entrance of Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs. Drops: 1309 - 2499 Runes, Fire Prelate Set, Prelate's Inferno Crozier, Thorned Whip. The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity."
Oracle Envoy Giant is a creature found at: Miquella's Haligtree. Drops: 5230 Runes, Envoy's Greathorn, Strip of White Flesh.
Giant Skeletal Slime is a creature found at: Writheblood Ruins, Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum. Drops: 370 - 2400 Runes, Beast Blood, Sacramental Bud, Thin Beast Bones, Hefty Beast Bone.

High Page is a creature found at: Raya Lucaria Academy, Leyndell Royal Capital. Drops: 508 - 1232 Runes, High Page Set, Red Branch Shortbow, Perfumer's Bolt. Strong and dexterous servants of the Nobility, commited to keep them out of harm's way. Specially compared with their common counterparts.
Inquisitor Ghiza is a creature found at: Volcano Manor. Drops: 6,858 Runes, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Ghiza's Wheel. A menacing agent of the Volcano Manor, wielding a colossal weapon of torture.

Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood is a creature found at: Mountaintops of the Giants. Drops: 158 Runes, Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Hoslow's Petal Whip, Hoslow's Helm, Hoslow's Armor, Hoslow's Gauntlets, Hoslow's Greaves. Juno Hoslow had a younger brother who was all talk and no trousers. His inability to commit to action was such that Juno inherited the Hoslow legacy without resistance, granting him the freedom to shower his little brother with adoration.

Knight of Zamor is a creature found at: Zamor Ruins. Drops: 5039 Runes. These long-lived warriors, clad in biting, freezing winds, are said to have been the mortal enemies of the Fire Giants since time immemorial.

Lesser Burial Watchdog is a creature found at: Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs. Drops: 3712 - 7956 Runes, Watchdog's Greatsword. The Watchdogs, battered and broken over their lengthy tenure, rule the catacombs and are even said to command the imps
Lesser Fingercreeper is a creature found at: Caria Manor Liurnia of the Lakes, Leyndell Royal Capital (Sewers), Mountaintops of the Giants. Drops: 26 - 198 Runes, Somber Smithing Stones.
Lesser Spirit-Caller Snail is a creature found at: Leyndell Catacombs, Spiritcaller's Cave, Miquella's Haligtree. Drops: 317 - 969 Runes, Grave Gloveworts.
Lion Guardian is a creature found at: Stormveil Castle, Fort Gael (Caelid), Redmane Castle, Castle Sol, Leyndell, Royal Capital. Drops: Varied drops.

Mad Tongue Alberich is a creature found at: Roundtable Hold. Drops: 1,562 Runes, Taunter's Tongue, Furlcalling Finger Remedy. Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan is a creature found at: Fields west of The Shaded Castle. Drops: 4,800 Runes, Antspur Rapier, Marais Mask, Marais Robe. The sons of House Marais are all sickly born. Little wonder that Maleigh Marais would be so beguiled by the beautiful and fierce goddess who was born into rot.

Man-Serpent is a creature found at: Volcano Manor. Drops: 728 - 741 Runes, Gelmir Glintstone Staff, Magma Blade, Man-Serpent's Shield, Volcanic Stone. It is said that long ago, the elder serpent that dwelled on Mt. Gelmir devoured a demigod, and the birth of the man-serpents followed.

Nameless White Mask is a creature found at: Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum. Drops: Furlcalling Finger Remedy, War Surgeon Set. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood, none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varre, that is; but he was an exception.

Night Maiden is a creature found at: Nokron, Eternal City, Nokstella, Eternal City. Drops: 391 - 635 Runes, Night Maiden Set. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

Nomad is a creature found at: Cathedral of the Forsaken. Drops: 493 Runes. A member of a tribe that was entombed in the earth so as to bury the maddening disease that followed them. Able to emit the terrible flame of frenzy from his eyes, but has low HP and is frail, unable to take much in the way of punishment.

Nox Monk is a creature found at: Nokstella, Eternal City. Drops: 635 Runes, Nox Monk Set. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

Nox Swordstress is a creature found at: Nokron, Eternal City, Nokstella, Eternal City. Drops: 391 - 635 Runes, Nox Swordstress Set. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

Old Knight Istvan is a creature found at: Stormhill. Drops: 1828 Runes, Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Scaled Helm, Scaled Armor, Scaled Gauntlets, Scaled Greaves. Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

Preceptor Miriam is a creature found at: Carian Study Hall. Drops: Carian Study Hall:, 5,000 Runes, Magic Downpour Carian Study Hall (Inverted):, 5,000 Runes, Lucidity. One of the magic preceptors that served the Carian royals

Raya Lucaria Soldier is a creature found at: Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops: 122 - 540 Runes, Raya Lucarian Soldier Set, Lordsworn's Straight Sword, Warpick, Heavy Crossbow, Lordsworn's Shield, Brass Shield, Lordsworn's Bolt, Bolt, Cuckoo Glintstone, Smithing Stones. The soldiers of Raya Lucaria were also known as the Cuckoos. They were given free rein by the academy to wage war as they pleased, and they were infamous for their rapacious ways.

Rileigh the Idle is a creature found at: Altus Plateau. Drops: 1828 Runes, Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Crepus's Vial, Black-Key Bolt x20. There was a time when Tarnished who had strayed from guidance feared nothing more than utter silence.
Serpent Snail is a creature found at: Volcano Manor, Nokstella, Eternal City. Drops: 205 - 210 Runes, Serpent Arrow.

Troll Knight is a creature found at: Caria Manor, The Four Belfries, Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops: 1320 - 1342 Runes, Troll Knight's Sword. Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.

Vargram the Raging Wolf is a creature found at: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Drops: Raging Wolf Helm, Raging Wolf Armor, Raging Wolf Gauntlets, Raging Wolf Greaves. One of the first Tarnished to arrive at the Roundtable, Vargram was named after the white wolf pelt on his helm. According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean. Vargram aspired to such a state himself.

Lesser Crystalian is a creature found at: Liurnia of the Lakes, Miquella's Haligtree, Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Drops: 190 - 5563 Runes, Rotten Crystal Spear, Rotten Crystal Staff. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit is a creature found at: Stormveil Castle, Leyndell, Royal Capital, Grand Cloister, Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, Leyndell, Ashen Capital, Leyndell, Capital Outskirts. Drops: 4,736 ~ 26,460 Runes, Golden Seed.
Lesser Cemetery Shade is a creature found at: Gelmir Hero's Grave. Drops: 935 - 935 Runes, Mantis Blade. Insect-ridden grave keepers.

Lesser Dragon is a creature found at: Dragonbarrow. Drops: 3470 Runes. The dragons that escaped the scarlet rot and made nest of the plateau to Caelid's north. Thus it was named "Dragonbarrow," and none dare to enter.

Lesser Cleanrot Knight is a creature found at: Swamp of Aeonia, War-Dead Catacombs, The Shaded Castle, Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs, Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Drops: 618 - 6332 Runes, Cleanrot Knight's Sword, Cleanrot Spear, Halo Scythe, Cleanrot Helm, Cleanrot Armor, Cleanrot Gauntlets, Cleanrot Greaves, Trina's Lily, Miquella's Lily. The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles fiercest of all.

Lesser Demi-Human Chief is a creature found at: Weeping Peninsula, Liurnia of the Lakes, Lakeside Crystal Cave, Lux Ruins, Volcano Cave, Mountaintops of the Giants, Gravesite Plain, Cerulean Coast, Charo's Hidden Grave. Drops: Bloodstained Dagger, String, Glass Shard, Ruin Fragment, Rainbow Stone, Glowstone, Spiritgrave Stone, Polter Stone.
Magnus the Beast Claw is a creature found at: Writheblood Ruins. Drops: Runes, Furlcalling Finger Remedy Rune Arc Great Stars Somber Smithing Stone (6).
Large Oracle Envoy is a creature found at: Leyndell Royal Capital, Miquella's Haligtree. Drops: 606 - 2997 Runes, Envoy's Long Horn, Strip of White Flesh.

Piquebone Arrow (Fletched). type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is soaked in putrescence. Releases a white smoke at the point of impact, luring in foes of human build who are not in combat, and drawing their aggression. Effective on demi-humans even if they are already in a combat state. Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.

Piquebone Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is soaked in putrescence. Releases a white smoke at the point of impact, luring in foes of human build who are not in combat, and drawing their aggression. Effective on demi-humans even if they are already in a combat state. Craftable item.

Igon's Harpoon. type: Greatarrow. description: Great arrow that bristles with sharp gravel stone pieces. Has an anti-dragon effect. The broken drake warrior Igon made these one by one in the midst of his agonyso that Bayle the Dread himself would know fear.

Piquebone Bolt. type: Bolt. description: Bolt whittled from animal bones. The tip is soaked in putrescence. Releases a white smoke at the point of impact, luring in foes of human build who are not in combat, and drawing their aggression. Effective on demi-humans even if they are already in a combat state. Craftable item.

Rabbath's Greatbolt. type: Greatbolt. description: Greatbolt tipped with a clump of glintstone shards. One of Spellmachinist Rabbath's innovative designs. Detonates a large explosion on impact, dealing magic damage.
Firebone Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is set alight before firing. Deals fire damage. Craftable item.

Firebone Arrow (Fletched). type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is set alight before firing. Deals fire damage. Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.
Bone Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from thin animal bones. Craftable item. Though the arrowhead is sharp indeed, it doesn't fly particularly true.
Bone Arrow (Fletched). type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from thin animal bones. Craftable item. The feather fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.
Poisonbone Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with venom. Afflicts targets with poison. Craftable item.

Poisonbone Arrow (Fletched). type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with venom. Afflicts targets with poison. Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.

St. Trina's Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow carved to resemble a withered water lily. Afflicts targetswith a powerful sleep effect. Priests of St. Trina use these arrows to spread their teachings. The sweet oblivion of sleep can become quite the habit.

Sleepbone Arrow (Fletched). type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with a water lily tincture. Afflicts targets with sleep. Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.
Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrows used with small and long bows. Unremarkable in any way, shape or form.
Sleepbone Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with a water lily tincture. Afflicts targets with sleep. Craftable item.
Bone Bolt. type: Bolt. description: Bolt carved from a thin animal bone. Craftable item. Though the tip is certainly sharp, it does not fly particularly true.
Firebone Bolt. type: Bolt. description: Bolt carved from animal bone. The tip is set alight before firing. Deals fire damage. Craftable item.
Lordsworn's Bolt. type: Bolt. description: Well-crafted bolt with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Deals more damage by its commonplace cousin.
Ballista Bolt. type: Greatbolt. description: Greatbolt as large as a spear for use with Hand Ballista.
Fire Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow with the tip set alight. Deals fire damage.
Perfumer's Bolt. type: Bolt. description: Bolt created with perfumer techniques. Used by nobles' guards and the like. The point of impact explodes with sparks, dealing fire damage.
Flaming Bolt. type: Bolt. description: Bolt with a fiercely burned tip. Deals powerful fire damage. Used by survivors of Radahn's army to stave off the scarlet rot.

Radahn's Spear. type: Greatarrow. description: Greatarrows used by the General Radahns during the festival of combat. These are in fact the many spears with which he was stabbed by the Cleanrot Knights. Imbued with Radahn's gravitational power.
Great Arrow. type: Greatarrow. description: A greatarrow as large as a spear for use with greatbows. Used by archers of monstrous strength employed by a lord's army.
Dwelling Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow in which the spirits of small animals are thought to dwell. Deals magic damage.

Black-Key Bolt. type: Bolt. description: Bolts used in Crepus' Black-Key Crossbow, an assassin's tool of exquisite craftmanship. The intricate spiral tip bores deep, injecting scarlet rot far into the flesh of its target.

Meteor Bolt. type: Bolt. description: Enchanted work of craft made in tandem with Full Moon Crossbow. The tip is embedded with glintstone. Like a shooting star, these bolts leave a beautiful trail when fired. Deals magic damage.
Explosive Greatbolt. type: Greatbolt. description: Greatbolt tipped with a clump of Explosive Stone shards. Detonates a large explosion on impact, dealing fire damage.

Serpent Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow carved to resemble a flying snake. Used in tandem with the Serpent Bow. Loyal minions of the Formless Serpents, their fangs are daubed with deadly poison.
Lightning Greatbolt. type: Greatbolt. description: Greatbolt tipped with a clump of Gravel Stone shards. Deals powerful lightning damage.
Rainbow Stone Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones tipped with chips of Rainbow Stone. Colored light shines at the point of impact. Craftable item.

Shattershard Arrow (Fletched). type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones tipped with a shard of crystal. Creates a resonating noise at the point of impact. Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.
Explosive Bolt. type: Bolt. description: Bolt tipped with a shard of Explosive Stone. Explodes on impact, dealing fire damage.

Burred Bolt. type: Bolt. description: Bolt covered in thorns. One of the most horrific weapons used in the Shattering. Afflicts with blood loss. Diffcult to remove once buried in flesh, causes appalling damage to the body

Spiritflame Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow set alight with ghostflame before firing. Deals magic damage while also afflicting foes with frost. Used by the Company of the Fallen Hawk, once ordered to explore the Eternal City.
Magicbone Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with a glintstone tincture. Deals magic damage. Craftable item.

Magicbone Arrow (Fletched). type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with a glintstone tincture. Deals magic damage. Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.
Lightningbone Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones with a lightning-infused tip. Deals lightning damage. Craftable item.

Lightningbone Arrow (Fletched). type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones with a lightning-infused tip. Deals lightning damage. Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.
Bloodbone Arrow. type: Arrow. description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with a blood tincture. Afflicts targets with blood loss. Craftable item.

Hefty Fire Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to inflict severe fire damage. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A goodly amount of materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to inflict severe fire damage.

Hefty Rock Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to inflict heavy damage. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. Filled to the brim with crushed rocksnothing clever about it. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy damage.

Hefty Lightning Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to inflict severe lightning damage. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A goodly amount of materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to inflict severe lightning damage.

Hefty Fetid Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to cause a large buildup of deadly poison. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A heaping mass of effluents is sealed inside. As the mixture ferments, toxins are produced alongside a putrid stench that seeps out once ripe. Throw at enemies to cause a large buildup of deadly poison. Beware though; those who carry these pots will slowly accumulate poison in their own bodies. Push someone in a privy; expect to get dung on your hands.

Hefty Fly Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to release a large swarm of bloodflies. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A heaping mass of effluents is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to set a large swarm of bloodflies upon them. The vile swarm deals damage and greatly builds up onset of blood loss. The cacophony of their wings assails the sanity of berserkers. The maggots found in waste feed on blood and turn into vicious flies that are pitiably short-lived.

Hefty Freezing Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to cause a large buildup of frost. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A goodly amount of materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to cause a large buildup of frost.

Hefty Poison Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to cause a large buildup of poison. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A goodly amount of materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to cause a large buildup of poison.

Hefty Oil Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to soak them in a heavy coat of oil. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A goodly amount of materials is sealed inside.Throw at enemies to soak them in a heavy coat of oil, making them acutely susceptible to fire damage.

Hefty Volcano Pot. effect: Creates heat cloud, causing continuous heavy fire damage. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A goodly amount of materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to disperse a searing cloud of heat, dealing continuous heavy damage to those caught inside for a short duration.

Hefty Frenzied Flame Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to cause a large buildup of madness. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A goodly amount of materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to cause a large buildup of madness. The flame of frenzy burns the eyes, but tranquility follows in its wake. May this pot bring salvation to those it strikes.

Hefty Rancor Pot. effect: Uses FP. Throw to spawn a throng of vengeful spirits.. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. Enchanted by the ancient death hex. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to spawn a throng of vengeful spirits that chase down foes. In times of old, the dead were burned with ghostflame, and from those cinders arose vengeful spirits.

Hefty Magic Pot. effect: Throw to inflict severe magic damage. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A goodly amount of materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to inflict severe magic damage.

Hefty Rot Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to cause a large buildup of scarlet rot. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A goodly amount of materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to cause a large buildup of scarlet rot. Rot is one of the divine elements of the outer gods, and eats away at life like a vicious plague.

Hefty Furnace Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to create a whirlwind of flame. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. Imbued with a hex of the furnace. Throw at an enemy to create a whirlwind of flame. The furnace's flame burns away both body and soul. When impurity is thus expunged, one calls it cleansing.

Hefty Red Lightning Pot. effect: Inflict heavy lightning damage that links to nearby enemies. description: Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A goodly amount of materials is sealed inside. Throw at an enemy to inflict heavy lightning damage that links to surrounding enemies. The ancient dragons who betrayed their lord to side with a tyrant were known for wielding branching red lightning.

Red Lightning Pot. effect: Inflict lightning damage that links to nearby enemies. description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. A cocktail of materials is sealed inside. Throw at an enemy to inflict lightning damage that links to surrounding enemies. The ancient dragons who betrayed their lord to side with a tyrant were known for wielding branching red lightning.

Frenzied Flame Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of madness. description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of madness. The flame of frenzy burns the eyes, but tranquility follows in its wake. May this pot bring salvation to those it strikes.

Eternal Sleep Pot. effect: Uses FP. Throw to cause buildup of eternal sleep.. description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Enchanted by the incantations of St. Trina. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of eternal sleep. The weak are powerless to resist this velvety sleep, and will never be roused again.

Roped Frenzied Flame Pot. effect: Throw behind to cause buildup of madness. description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of materials is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to cause buildup of madness. The flame of frenzy burns the eyes, but tranquility follows in its wake. May this pot bring salvation to those it strikes.

Spirit Raisin. effect: Spectral steed pushes back enemies when breaking into gallop. description: Preparation of dried Rada fruit. Craftable item. Feed to Torrent while riding to enable the spectral steed to push back enemies when breaking into a gallop. The effect ends after a short time. A bitter medicine traditionally claimed to enhance one's spirituality, but Torrent seems to have a taste for it.

Blessing of Marika. effect: Completely restores HP and heals all ailments. description: A special physick blessed by Marika, the queen of the Erdtree. Completely restores HP and heals all ailments. Marika once created several of these physicks for Messmer's sake. But never again.

Lulling Branch. effect: Slowly builds up sleep while gradually restoring FP. description: Tree branch blessed with a velvety purple incantation. Craftable item. Pierce oneself, causing a gentle buildup of sleep. FP gradually recovers during this time. When this sleep reaches the threshold of causing temporary fogginess, no FP loss is incurred. In the midst of drowsiness, there is the will to awaken. Feelings that rise from the depths of one's heart.

Dragon Communion Flesh. effect: Boosts vigor, stamina, strength, and dexterity at the cost of gradual HP loss. description: A lump of animal flesh with a heat that never cools. Craftable item. Boosts vigor, stamina, strength, and dexterity at the cost of gradual HP loss. An imitation of dragonscale flesh created by human hands, used to sate the hunger of drake warriorsif only briefly.

Dragonscale Flesh. effect: Boosts vigor, stamina, strength, and dexterity at the cost of gradual HP loss. description: A lump of hot flesh carved from beneath the inverted scales said to grow on aged dragons. When ingested as-is, boosts vigor, stamina, strength, and dexterity at the cost of gradual HP loss. To the drake warriors, there is no more intoxicating liquor than the heat of dragons.

Fingerprint Nostrum. effect: Boosts mind, intelligence, faith, and arcane at cost of gradual HP loss. description: Bolus engraved with whorl-like lines. Craftable item. Boosts mind, intelligence, faith, and arcane at the cost of gradual HP loss. A secret medicine of those who attempt to turn their human bodies into fingers. Ingesting causes something to wriggle within.

Spellproof Pickled Liver. effect: Temporarily grants large boost to magic damage negation. description: Animal liver pickled in a blue medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily grants large boost to magic damage negation, greatly improving damage mitigation against attacks imbued with magic. The effects of the forager brood's pickled delights are enhanced by the fermentation, or rotting, of the ingredients. Though this results in a pungent odor, some come to find the aroma irresistible.

Fireproof Pickled Liver. effect: Temporarily grants large boost to fire damage negation. description: Animal liver pickled in a red medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily grants large boost to fire damage negation, greatly improving damage mitigation against attacks imbued with fire. The effects of the forager brood's pickled delights are enhanced by the fermentation, or rotting, of the ingredients. Though this results in a pungent odor, some come to find the aroma irresistible.

Lightningproof Pickled Liver. effect: Temporarily grants large boost to lightning damage negation. description: Animal liver pickled in a yellow medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily grants large boost to lightning damage negation, greatly improving damage mitigation against attacks imbued with lightning. The effects of the forager brood's pickled delights are enhanced by the fermentation, or rotting, of the ingredients. Though this results in a pungent odor, some come to find the aroma irresistible.

Holyproof Pickled Liver. effect: Temporarily grants large boost to holy damage negation. description: Animal liver pickled in a gold medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily grants large boost to holy damage negation, greatly improving damage mitigation against attacks imbued with holiness. The effects of the forager brood's pickled delights are enhanced by the fermentation, or rotting, of the ingredients. Though this results in a pungent odor, some come to find the aroma irresistible.

Opaline Pickled Liver. effect: Temporarily grants large boost to non-physical damage negation. description: Animal liver pickled in an opaline medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily grants large boost to non-physical damage negation, greatly improving mitigation of damage imbued with non-physical attributes. The effects of the forager brood's pickled delights are enhanced by the fermentation, or rotting, of the ingredients. Though this results in a pungent odor, some come to find the aroma irresistible.

Well-Pickled Turtle Neck. effect: Temporarily grants large boost to stamina recovery speed. description: Turtle neck meat that has been thoroughly pickled in a bitter solution. Temporarily grants large boost to stamina recovery speed. The effects of the forager brood's pickled delights are enhanced by the fermentation, or rotting, of the ingredients. Though this results in a pungent odor, some come to find the aroma irresistible.

Scorpion Stew. effect: Boosts physical damage negation temporarily and gradually restores HP. description: Scorpion simmered in a black soup. Traditional meal of the hornsent. Boosts physical damage negation temporarily and gradually restores HP. Once made with love by a certain elderly woman for the family table. Having long gone cold, this soup gives off a rank, sour smell.

Gourmet Scorpion Stew. effect: Boosts physical damage negation temporarily and gradually restores a great amount of HP. description: Scorpion simmered in a black soup. An exquisite dish chock-full of mouth-watering scorpion claws. Boosts physical damage negation temporarily and gradually restores a great amount of HP. The thoughts and feelings of the cook melt and blend into the stew, but those who can distinguish the taste of love are few and far between. "Partake, partake, until thou art sated."

Scorpion Stew (2). effect: Boosts physical damage negation temporarily and gradually restores HP. description: Scorpion simmered in a black soup. Traditional meal of the hornsent. Boosts physical damage negation temporarily and gradually restores HP. Having long gone cold, this soup gives off a rank, sour smell.
