An exquisite dish chock-full of mouth-watering scorpion claws. Boosts physical damage negation temporarily and gradually restores a great amount of HP. The thoughts and feelings of the cook melt and blend into the stew, but those who can distinguish the taste of love are few and far between.

Sacred Bloody Flesh. effect: Boosts physical attack power and arcane once. Attack power boosted further when blood loss occurs.. description: Raw meat soaked with blood. A delicacy of the bloodfiends. Temporarily boosts physical attack power and arcane. When blood loss occurs nearby, further boosts attack power. The blood is said to have fallen from the Formless Mother's wound. Never will it dry, never will it rot.

Silver Horn Tender. effect: Temporarily boosts item discovery. description: Old currency used by hornsent made by coating spiral horns with silver. Temporarily boosts item discovery. Can also be sold for a high price. These trinkets were once symbolic of society's upper echelons.

Golden Horn Tender. effect: Boosts rune acquisition for a time. description: Old currency used by hornsent made by coating spiral horns with gold. Boosts the amount of runes obtained from defeating enemies for a certain duration. Can also be sold for a high price. Once bestowed upon inquisitors as an honor.

Messmerfire Grease. effect: Coats armament, inflicting heavy fire damage. description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of incendiary materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding heavy fire damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time. Fire was a symbol of the crusade, and even Messmer's rank-and-file soldiers would wield it.

Dragonbolt Grease. effect: Coats armament, inflicting heavy lightning damage. description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of fulminating materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding heavy lightning damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time. Said to have been a favored tool of the dragon-cult knights who once served the prince of gold.

Royal Magic Grease. effect: Coats armament, inflicting heavy magic damage. description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding heavy magic damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time. Believed to have once been bestowed upon low-ranking Carian knights in lieu of the fellowship's characteristic swords.

Golden Grease. effect: Coats armament, inflicting heavy holy damage. description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of holy resonant materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding heavy holy damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time. Enchanted with an ancient Erdtree incantation. Such ministrations are all but a lost art in the realm of shadow.

Eternal Sleep Grease. effect: Coats armament, inflicting eternal sleep. description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of deep-purple materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, inflicting eternal sleep. The effect lasts only for a short time. The weak are powerless to resist this velvety sleep, and will never be roused again.

Dragon Communion Grease. effect: Coats armament, granting potent anti-dragon effect. description: Solidified knotgrease made from a sharp gravel-stone mixture. Craftable item. Coats armament, granting a potent anti-dragon effect. The effect lasts only for a short time. A tool of the old Dragon Communion warriors, who were the agents of the ancient dragons' hatred for their lowborn descendants.

Drawstring Messmerfire Grease. effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting heavy fire damage. description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of incendiary materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, adding heavy fire damage to attacks, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size. Fire was a symbol of the crusade, and even Messmer's rank-and-file soldiers would wield it.

Drawstring Dragonbolt Grease. effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting heavy lightning damage. description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of fulminating materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, adding heavy lightning damage to attacks, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size. Said to have been a favored tool of the dragon-cult knights who once served the prince of gold.

Drawstring Royal Magic Grease. effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting heavy magic damage. description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, adding heavy magic damage to attacks, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size. Believed to have once been bestowed upon low-ranking Carian knights in lieu of the fellowship's characteristic swords.

Drawstring Golden Grease. effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting heavy holy damage. description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of holy resonant materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, adding heavy holy damage to attacks, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size. Enchanted with an ancient Erdtree incantation. Such ministrations are all but a lost art in the realm of shadow.

Drawstring Eternal Sleep Grease. effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting eternal sleep. description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of deep-purple materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, inflicting eternal sleep, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size. The weak are powerless to resist this velvety sleep, and will never be roused again.

Festive Grease. effect: Coats armament, granting wielder trace amount of runes on landing attacks. description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of bone shards. Craftable item. Coats armament, imparting a festive incantation that grants the wielder a scant few runes on landing attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time. The delightful festival is an old tradition; one old enough for the Erdtree to tacitly tolerate its endurance.

Innard Meat. effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage. description: Scraps of flesh for filling great jars. Rancorous spirits cling to the pinkish-red, ******ing meat. Throw at enemies to inflict damage. This is what becomes of the condemned, who get sliced up and stuffed into jars to become saints instead.

Dragon Communion Harpoon. effect: Throw to inflict damage with anti-dragon effect. description: Harpoon bristling with sharp gravel stones. Craftable item. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy damage. Has an anti-dragon effect. A tool of the old Dragon Communion warriors, who were the agents of the ancient dragons' hatred for their lowborn descendants.

Polter Stone. effect: Makes a noise imitative of human presence. description: Contrivance of the grave keepers made from spiritgrave stone. Craftable item. Creates noises imitative of human presence where it lands when thrown. Said to have been used by the solitary grave keepers to distract themselves from their longing for company.

Rock Heart. effect: Turns human frame into ancient dragon and boosts Dragon Communion incantations by 20% for 60 seconds.. description: Heart consumed in the ancient, original form of Dragon Communion. Use while disrobed to turn one's human flesh into an ancient dragon. The change cannot be undone except by death. Using this heart while already transformed temporarily boosts Dragon Communion incantations. The last thing the partaker saw with human eyes was a sunset, its colors faded and tarnisheda remote thing from eternity.

Priestess Heart. effect: Turns human frame into ancient dragon and boosts Dragon Cult incantations. description: The stone heart of a Dragon Communion priestess. Use while disrobed to turn one's human flesh into an ancient dragon. The change cannot be undone except by death. Using this heart while already transformed temporarily boosts incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The priestess was once an ancient dragon herself, but sacrificed that form for feeble flesh to aid in the destruction of Bayle the Dread.

Lamenter's Mask. effect: Transforms wearer into a lamenter and causes head to swell in size. description: A stone mask twisted into an expression of rapturous grief. Use while disrobed to transform into a lamenter. The change cannot be undone except by death. Using this mask while already transformed causes the head to swell in size. This transformation tallies with the state of a denizen of paradise, but the people of the tower denied and hid it from the world. In their foolishness, they viewed true bliss with deep fear.

Ancient Dragon's Blessing. effect: Uses FP to increase all damage negation. description: Favor bestowed by the Dragon Communion priestess in the name of the dragon lord Placidusax. Consume FP to increase all forms of damage negation (including physical). This also increases damage negation while guarding as an additional effect. Each night, the priestess offers her own sleep to her lord, and in turn receives the power of His favor.

Iris of Grace. effect: Place on the eye of another to grant the light of grace as a fleeing blessing. description: An iris blessed with an incantation of the Erdtree. Place on the eye of another to grant them the light of grace as a fleeing blessing. Can also be used to receive the blessing of an equipped Great Rune. In the realm of shadow, this artifice was employed by the priests of the Erdtree to quell the fears of their flock to magnificent effect.

Iris of Occultation. effect: Place on the eye of another to deny light in all its forms. description: An iris that is as dark as night. Place on the eye of another to deny them light in all its forms. Can also be used to receive the blessing of an equipped Great Rune, at the cost of all runes currently held. In the realm of shadow, this artifice was employed by the priests of the Erdtree to intensify the fears of their flock to magnificent effect.

Thiollier's Concoction. effect: Causes immediate death if imbibed by an ordinary human. description: An ebony-black concoction mixed by Thiollier. A condensed, somniferous elixir, purported to be capable of putting even an ancient dragon to sleep. For an ordinary mortal, a single sip would assuredly result in swift and certain death. Thiollier thought of St. Trina's sleep when he created this, but the ebony sleep he concocted had not the sweetness of nectar nor the gentleness of rest's embrace.

Flask of Crimson Tears. effect: Restores HP. description: A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of life. Filled with crimson tears, this flask restores HP with use. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. The one washed up on the gravesite was sure to die, until this flaskoffered its gift of rejuvenation. To seek the Elden Ring. Flask Add charge to flask

Flask of Cerulean Tears. effect: Restores FP. description: A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of life. Filled with cerulean tears, this flask restores FP with use. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. The one washed up on the gravesite was sure to die, until this flask offered its gift of rejuvenation. To seek the Elden Ring.

Sleep Pot. effect: Uses FP. Throw to cause buildup of Sleep. description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Enchanted by the incantations of St. Trina. Consumes FP. Throw enemies to cause buildup of sleep. Like a lullaby, or a quagmire, its light-purple haze irresistibly draws its victims down into sleep. Sweet dreams.

Dappled White Cured Meat. effect: Temporarily boosts immunity, robustness, and focus. description: A white sliced meat, dried out after pickling in a dappled medicinal solution.Craftable item. Temporarily boosts immunity, robustness, and focus. Lasts longer than traditional cured meat, but with reduced effectiveness.

Holy Water Pot. effect: Uses FP. Throw at enemies to inflict Holy Damage. description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Enchanted by incantations of the Golden Order. Consumes FP. Throw at enemy to inflict holy damage. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death, even preventing them from rising again.The Golden Order has no mercy for those who trespass beyond life's bounds.

Scriptstone. effect: Reveals more messages from other worlds. description: Ruin Fragment with a cipher inscription. Craftable item. Uses FP to reveal more messages from other worlds. Words are gregarious things, drawn to one another much as people are.

Rainbow Stone. effect: Shines with colored light when placed, serving as a guide. description: Ruin Fragment that has undergone some simple processing. Craftable item. Stones such as these shine with the colors of the rainbow, making them useful markers when placed on the ground. Can also be dropped to gauge the distance of a fall. The higher the pitch of the sound, the higher the likelihood of the fall being fatal. Once used to entertain children on the fringes of the Lands Between.

Rowa Raisin. effect: On horseback, feed to Torrent to restore HP. description: Preparation of dried Rowa fruit. Craftable item. Feed to Torrent, the spectral steed, while riding to restore his HP. Humans are unable to digest Rowa fruit, but Torrent seems to have a taste for it.

Roped Fire Pot. effect: Throw behind to inflict Fire Damage.. description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of incendiary materials is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to inflict fire damage.

Glowstone. effect: Emits a faint light from the location it is placed. description: Polished Ruin Fragment that shines brighter than Rainbow Stone. Craftable item. Emits light from the location it is placed, illuminating surroundings. However, the effect is short-lived, and it lacks the diverse colors of rainbow stones. May serve some benefit in dark places, or at night.

Flask of Wondrous Physick. effect: Bestows various special effects. description: A relic of the physick chemists, priests of the Erdtree. Harnesses the powers of crystal tears, which only form after the passage of many moons. Various special effects are bestowed upon the drinker, dependent on the specific mixture of crystal tears. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. Basins are placed at the feet of Minor Erdtrees throughout the Lands Between in order to collect their crystallized tears.

Pauper's Rune. effect: Use to gain a few runes. description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of The Lands Between; the lingering residue of gold. Use to gain a few runes. For all that they may be feeble things, these runes will act as nourishment for the development of any Tarnished. Provided a Finger Maiden can be found...

Immunizing Cured Meat. effect: Temporarily boosts Immunity. description: Cured strip of meat, dried out after pickling in a green medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily boosts immunity. Higher immunity helps to mitigate the buildup of various poisons and scarlet rot.

Heavy Meteorite Fragment. effect: Consumes FP. Throw at the ground to create a gravitational shockwave.. description: Shard of rock found in the wake of a meteorite strike. It is imbued with a particularly weighty magic. Consumes FP. Throw at the ground to create a gravitational shockwave. The desperate ones who scavenge for these shards dub themselves "starcallers".

Pickled Turtle Neck. effect: Temporarily boosts Stamina recovery. description: Turtle neck meat, pickled in a bitter medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily boosts stamina recovery. The nutrients churn through the body, practically boiling out endless power.

Drawstring Fire Grease. effect: Quickly coats weapon, inflicting fire damage. description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of incendiary materials. Craftable item.A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, inflicting fire damage, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size.

Fireproof Dried Liver. effect: Temporarily boosts fire damage negation. description: Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in a red medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily boosts fire damage negation, improving damage mitigation against attacks imbued with fire.

Fire Pot. effect: Throw at enemies to inflict Fire Damage. description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of incendiary materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to inflict fire damage.

Fire Grease. effect: Coats weapon, inflicting fire damage. description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of incendiary materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding fire damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time.

Fire Grease. effect: Coats weapon, inflicting fire damage. description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of incendiary materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding fire damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time.

Bloodboil Aromatic. effect: Uses FP to enter a temporary state of fervor.. description: Forbidden art of depraved perfumers. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to enter a temporary state of fervor, raising maximum attack power and stamina while also increasing damage received. "Even upon the battlefield, do you fear being wounded? Take a good look. Your limbs are frozen stiff."

Stanching Boluses. effect: Alleviates impending blood loss.. description: Red boluses made from cave moss. Craftable item. Alleviates impending blood loss. Blood loss escalates gradually, causing great damage once the threshold is reached. Take one of these in timely fashion to avoid such an event.

Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot. effect: Boosts rune acquisition for a time (30%). description: Four-toed foot of a fowl, pickled in a golden medicinal solution. Craftable item. Boosts the amount of runes obtained from defeating enemies for a certain duration. Since old times, the needy would scrape the meat clean even from a fowl's claw.

Dragon Heart. effect: Gain power of the dragon at the Dragon Communion altar.. description: Dragon heart seized by a dragon tracker. Riddled with Gravel Stone, this grotesque organ continues to beat vivaciously. An offering used in the Dragon Communion. Consume a dragon's heart at the altar to make its power yours. While a terrible and savage-looking thing, the heart has a peculiar beauty to it.

Neutralizing Boluses. effect: Alleviates poison buildup and cures poison. description: Green boluses made from cave moss. Craftable item. Alleviates poison buildup and cures poison ailment. Poison accumulates gradually, coming into effect once the threshold is reached. Poison ailment lowers HP in steady increments for a period.

Exalted Flesh. effect: Temporarily boosts physical attack (30s). description: A lump of animal flesh pickled in a medicinal solution mixed with fiery spices. Craftable item. Temporarily boosts physical attack. Considered a delicacy in the badlands, this invigorating repast was for the exclusive benefit of those who they deem heroes.

Throwing Dagger. effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage. description: Short dagger for throwing. It has no handguard. The blade is polished, and its weight is expertly balanced. Throw at enemies to deal damage. This auxiliary weapon, used primarily to constrain an enemy's movements, can still be deadly in the right hands.

Stimulating Boluses. effect: Alleviates buildup of sleep.. description: Light-purple boluses made from cave moss. Craftable item. Alleviates buildup of sleep. Sleep accumulates gradually, causing sudden fogginess and loss of FP once the threshold is reached, even if it does not force the afflicted into true slumber. Take one of these in a timely fashion to avoid such events.

Lands Between Rune. effect: Use to gain many runes. description: Grace said to have once dwelled in the eyes of the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering residue of gold. Use to gain 3000 runes. No grace resides in the eyes of the Tarnished; if it ever did, it is now lost.

Golden Seed. effect: Increases Sacred Flask's number of uses. description: A golden seed, found at the base of an illusory tree. Increases a Sacred Flask's number of uses.(Can be used after resting at a site of grace.) When the Elden Ring was shattered, these seeds flew from the Erdtree, scattering across the various lands, as if life itself knew that its end has come.

Bewitching Branch. effect: Uses FP to charm pierced enemy. description: Tree branch blessed with an incantation of unalloyed gold. Craftable item. Pierce a foe, using FP to turn them into a temporary ally. The Empyrean Miquella is loved by many people. Indeed, he has learned very well how to compel such affection.

Boiled Prawn. effect: Boosts physical damage negation for a time. description: Boiled prawn meat.A prime specimen of plump and moist meat.True connoisseurs know how to keep from over-salting. Boosts physical damage negation for a certain duration, The meat actually looks to have come from a crayfish. Not that it matters, it's delicious all the same.

Golden Rune [1]. effect: Use to gain 200 runes. description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between, the lingering trace of gold. Use to gain 200 runes. Runes are nourishment for the development of any Tarnished. Provided a Finger Maiden can be found... West Sarcophagi West Liurnia of the Lakes North Sarcophagi North Liurnia of the Lakes North-East Sarcophagi northeast sarcophagi

Golden Rune [2]. effect: Use to gain 400 runes. description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between, the lingering trace of gold. Use to gain 400 runes. Runes are nourishment for the development of any Tarnished. Provided a Finger Maiden can be found... North Sarcophagi West Sarcophagi West Liurnia of the Lakes North-East Sarcophagi North-East Liurnia of the Lakes

Golden Rune [3]. effect: Use to gain 800 runes. description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering trace of gold. Use to gain 800 runes. Even now, runes are still imbued with the power of life itself. Do you see the Erdtree towering o'er? Northeastern Sarcophag Liurnia of the Lakes' northeastern sarcophagi. North Creek North Sarcophagi West Sarcophagi: West Liurnia of the Lakes

Baldachin's Blessing. effect: Uses FP to temporarilty boost poise. description: Favor bestowed by a deathbed companion. Protection of a hidden temple in the guise of a bedchamber. Uses FP to temporarily boost poise. The favor allows one to forget any aches and pains. In Death, there is only peace, for in Death, there can be no sensation.

Blood Grease. effect: Coats armament, inflicting blood loss. description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of blood-red materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, inflicting blood loss. The effect lasts only for a short time.

Fan Daggers. effect: Thrown fanned-out knives at enemies to inflict damage. description: A set of five throwing knives bundled together. A concealed weapon cherished by the raptor assassins. The thin knives fan out when thrown, dealing damage to the target. Each knife deals paltry damage, but the wide range makes it suitable for constraining enemies.

Frozen Raisin. effect: On horseback, feed to Torrent to vastly restore HP. description: Preparation of dried Rimed Rowa. Craftable item. Feed to Torrent, the spectral steed, while riding to vastly restore his HP. Torrent seems to enjoy the sensation of chewing this frozen, dried seed. vastly

Glass Shard. effect: Shard of filthy glass. Worthless rubbish.. description: Glass shard covered in dirt. Because it sparkles in the light, it might be mistaken for an object of value when seen from afar. It cannot produce light by itself. Essentially worthless.

Golden Rune [6]. effect: Use to gain 2000 runes. description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering residue of gold. Use to gain 2000 runes. Those born at the foot of the Erdtree are blessed. At least, that is the enduring belief of the people of the plateau. Minor Erdtree

Grace Mimic. effect: Light shows the path, but without order. description: A fetish indicating the guidance of grace. Craftable item. Similar to grace, this fetish draws rays guiding the way, only without any sense of order. Useful as a last resort for those who have lost their way, or for use by those who believe that unrefined guidance will lead to truer encounters.

Roped Holy Water Pot. effect: Uses FP. Throw behind to inflict Holy Damage. description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot.Enchanted by incantations of the Golden Order, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Consumes FP. Throw at rearward enemies to inflict holy damage. Highly effective against Thos Who Live in Death, even preventing them from rising again.The Golden Order has no mercy for those who trespass beyond life's bounds.
Bone Dart. effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage. description: Animal bone sharpened into a knife for throwing. Craftable item. Throw at enemies to inflict damage.

Gravity Stone Chunk. effect: Uses FP to cause a gravitational explosion. description: Shard of rock found in the wake of a meteorite strike. It is imbued with a particularly weighty magic. Throw at enemies, using FP to cause a gravitational explosion. The desperate ones who scavenge for these shards dub themselves "starcallers."

Gravity Stone Fan. effect: Uses FP to emit fan-shaped gravitational shockwave. description: Shard of rock found in the wake of a meteorite strike. It is imbued with a particularly weighty magic. Uses FP to emit gravitational shockwave. The desperate ones which scavenge for these shards dub themselves "starcallers."

Invigorating Cured Meat. effect: Temporarily boosts Robustness. description: Cured strip of meat, dried out after pickling in a red medicinal solution.Craftable item. Temporarily boosts robustness. Higher robustness helps to mitigate the buildup of frost and blood loss.

Kukri. effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage and build up onset of blood loss. description: A large knife used for throwing. Its curved blade is sharp enough to slice flesh cleanly. Throw at enemies to inflict damage and build up onset of blood loss. This heavy throwing weapon is unsuitable for swift attacks, but is able to inflict heavy damage.

Large Glintstone Scrap. effect: Break gem and use FP to produce many magic bolts. description: Large piece of glintstone tinged with unstable magic. Found in crystal tunnels. Break gem, using FP to produce a magic bolt. Poor quality and thereby easily broken, a sorcerer wouldn't give it a second look.

Magic Grease. effect: Coats armament, inflicting magic damage. description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding magic damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time.

Rot Grease. effect: Coats armament, inflicting scarlet rot. description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of rotten materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, inflicting scarlet rot. The effect lasts only for a short time.

Rune Arc. effect: Grants the blessing of an equipped Great Rune upon use. description: A shard of the shattered Elden Ring. Grants the blessing of an equipped Great Rune upon use. Even if no Great Rune is equipped, it will slightly increase maximum HP upon use. The lower arc of the Elden Ring is held to be the basin in which its blessings pool. Perhaps this shard originates from that very arc.

Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot. effect: Temporarily boosts item discovery (+50). description: Four-toed foot of a fowl, pickled in a silvery medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily boosts item discovery. Since old times, the needy would scrape the meat clean even from a fowl's claw.

Spellproof Dried Liver. effect: Temporarily boosts magic damage negation. description: Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in a blue medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily boosts magic damage negation, improving damage mitigation against attacks imbued with magic.

Warming Stone. effect: Uses FP to continuously heal nearby allies. description: Ruin Fragment blessed with an incantation of the Two Fingers. Craftable item. Uses FP to generate warmth, continuously restoring the HP of those nearby. It's said that the Erdtree was once as warm as the gentle sun, and would gradually heal all who bathed in its rays.

Sacred Tear. effect: Improves Sacred Flask's potency. description: Blessing of the Erdtree, worshipped in the churches of all lands; this is but a faint vestige. Increases the potency of a Sacred Flask's restorative effects. (Can be used after resting at a site of grace.) During the age of the Erdtree, these tears were used to spread the faith, for theirs was once a certain blessing.

Furled Finger's Trick-Mirror. effect: Take on appearance of a Host of Fingers. description: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure. Makes the bearer take on the appearance of a Host of Fingers One of the ritual implements created by the Tarnished to deceive invaders.

Bloodsucking Cracked Tear. effect: Enhances attacks at the cost of HP in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages, where the scattered sap of the Scadutree pools deep within the furnace golems. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily increases attack power but drains HP over time.

Glovewort Crystal Tear. effect: Enhances attacks of spirits in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages, where the scattered sap of the Scadutree pools deep within the furnace golems. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily increases the attack power of spirits.

Deflecting Hardtear. effect: Enhances spontaneous guard in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages, where the scattered sap of the Scadutree pools deep within the furnace golems. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily enhances spontaneous guard. Damage negation and guard poise will be heightened in the moment immediately after assuming a guarding stance. Successfully executing a spontaneous guard will also strengthen guard counters.

Ruptured Crystal Tear. effect: Causes concoction to explode in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.Causes concoction to explode. A defective crystal tear which possesses absolutely no medicinal qualities. A lesson said to be learned the hard way for some; faith can be a volatile matter, after all.

Greenspill Crystal Tear. effect: Temporarily boosts stamina in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily raises one's maximum stamina.

Cerulean Crystal Tear. effect: Restores half of total FP in mixed physick.. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction restores half of one's maximum FP.

Crimson Crystal Tear. effect: Restores half of total HP in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.The resulting concoction restores half of one's maximum HP.

Crimsonburst Crystal Tear. effect: Steadily restores HP for a time in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction gradually restores one's HP over time.

Faith-knot Crystal Tear. effect: Temporarily boosts faith in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily boosts one's faith.

Opaline Bubbletear. effect: Significantly negates damage in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Provides significant damage negation. However, this effect only occurs once, and will expire after a certain duration.

Strength-knot Crystal Tear. effect: Temporarily boosts strength in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily boosts one's strength.

Spiked Cracked Tear. effect: Enhances charged attacks for a time in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction increases the power of charged attacks for a certain duration.

Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear. effect: Temporarily boosts dexterity in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily boosts one's dexterity.

Winged Crystal Tear. effect: Temporarily reduces equip load in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.Temporarily reduces equipment load.

Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear. effect: Temporarily boosts magic attacks in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.The resulting concoction temporarily boosts the power of one's magic attacks.

Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear. effect: Temporarily boosts lightning attacks in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.The resulting concoction temporarily boosts the power of one's lightning attacks.

Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear. effect: Temporarily boosts holy attacks in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.The resulting concoction temporarily boosts the power of one's holy attacks.

Twiggy Cracked Tear. effect: Briefly stop rune loss on death in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.The resulting concoction prevents one's runes from being lost upon death. However, the effect lasts only for a short time.

Leaden Hardtear. effect: Temporarily boosts poise in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.The resulting conconction temporarily boosts one's poise.

Crimsonspill Crystal Tear. effect: Temporarily boosts max HP in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.The resulting concoction temporarily raises one's maximum HP.

Greenburst Crystal Tear. effect: Temporarily boosts stamina recovery speed in mixed physick.. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.The resulting concoction temporarily boosts stamina recovery speed.

Speckled Hardtear. effect: Boosts resistance and heals status in mixed physick.. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily raises all resistances and heals all status ailments.

Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear. effect: Temporarily boosts the power of one's fire attacks.. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.The resulting concoction temporarily boosts the power of one's fire attacks.

Crimson Bubbletear. effect: Restores HP when near death in mixed physick.. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction automatically heals one's HP in the moment before death. However, this effect only occurs once, and will expire after a certain duration.

Crimsonwhorl Bubbletear. effect: Converts damage received into HP in mixed physick.. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction converts incoming damage into recovered HP instead. However, physical damage cannot be converted. This effect is only brief and will quickly expire.

Thorny Cracked Tear. effect: Makes consecutive attacks grow stronger in mixed physick.. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction makes consecutive attacks grow stronger the longer they continue. However, the effect lasts only for a short time.

CERULEAN HIDDEN TEAR. effect: Eliminates all FP consumption in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction removes all FP consumption. However, this effect is only brief and will quickly expire.

Stonebarb Cracked Tear. effect: Make attacks more likely to break enemy stances in a mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction make one's attacks more likely to break an enemy's stance. However, the effect lasts only for a short time.

Windy Crystal Tear. effect: Enhances dodge rolls for a time in mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.The resulting concoction increases the effectiveness of dodgerolls for a certain duration. However, damage taken is also increased during the concoction's effect.

Opaline Hardtear. effect: Temporarily boosts all damage negations in physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick.The resulting concoction temporarily boosts all forms of damage negation.

INTELLIGENCE-KNOTCRYSTAL TEAR. effect: Temporarily boosts intelligence in mixed physick.. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction boosts one's intelligence for a certain duration.

Purifying Crystal Tear. effect: Purifies the Lord of Blood's curse in a mixed physick. description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the age where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.Can be mixed in the Flask of Wonderous Physick.The resulting concoction purifies the curse from Mohg, Lord of Blood's terrifying rite of blood.

Miquella's Great Rune. type: Great Rune. effect: Retains naught but the power to resist charms. location: Scadutree Base. description: A Great Rune relinquished by Miquella. Broken and bereft of its bounty, it retains naught but the power to resist charms. Miquella set off for the tower enshrouded by shadow, abandoning everything—his golden flesh, his blinding strength, even his fate. All in an effort to bury the original sin. To embrace the whole of it, and be reborn as a new god.. boss: Scadutree Avatar

Godrick's Great Rune. type: Great Rune. effect: Raises all attributes by +5. location: Stormveil Castle - Limgrave. description: A Great Rune of the shardbearer Godrick. Its blessing raises all attributes This Great Rune is known as the anchor ring, found in the center of the Elden Ring. The first demigods were The Elden Lord Godfrey and his offspring, the golden lineage.. boss: Godrick the Grafted

Rykard's Great Rune. type: Great Rune. effect: Restores HP upon defeating enemies. location: Volcano Manor - Mt. Gelmir. description: A Great Rune of the shardbearer Rykard. Its blessing restores HP on attacking enemies. Rykard was amongst the children of Rennala and Radagon, who became demigod stepchildren after Radagon's union with Queen Marika. But Rykard fed himself to the blasphemous serpent, Great Rune and all.. boss: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy

Radahn's Great Rune. type: Great Rune. effect: Raises maximum HP, FP and Stamina by 15%. location: Redmane Castle - Caelid. Map Link.. description: A Great Rune of the shardbearer Radahn. Its blessing raises maximum HP, FP and Stamina. Radahn was amongst the children of Rennala and Radagon, who became demigod stepchildren after Radagon's union with Queen Marika. The Great Rune burns, to resist the encroachment of the scarlet rot.. boss: Starscourge Radahn

Morgott's Great Rune. type: Great Rune. effect: Raises maximum HP by 25%. location: Leyndell, Royal Capital. description: A Great Rune of the shardbearer Morgott.Its blessing greatly raises maximum HP. This Great Rune is the anchor ring that houses the base, and proves two things: That the Omen King was born of the golden lineage, and that he was indeed the Lord of Leyndell.. boss: Morgott, the Omen King

Mohg's Great Rune. type: Great Rune. effect: Grants a blessing of blood to phantoms. location: Mohgwyn Palace. description: A Great Rune of the shardbearer Mohg.Its blessing grants a blessing of blood to summoned phantoms, and imparts a Phantom Great Rune upon successful invasion. Mohg and Morgott are twin brothers, and their Great Runes are naturally similar. But Mohg's rune is soaked in accursed blood, from his devout love for the wretched mire that he was born into far below the earth. inflicted. boss: Mohg, Lord of Blood

Malenia's Great Rune. type: Great Rune. effect: Attacks recover HP for a short time after taking damage. location: Miquella's Haligtree - Elphael. description: A Great Rune of the shardbearer Malenia.The blessing of this half-rotted rune reduces the healing power of Flask of Crimson Tears. And yet, due to the infusion of Malenia's spirit of resistance. attacks made immediately after receiving damage will partially recover HP. Malenia is daughter to Queen Marika and Radagon, and her Great Rune should have been the most sacred of all.. boss: Malenia, Blade of Miquella

Great Rune of the Unborn. type: Great Rune. effect: No active effect. Unlocks character respeccing. location: Raya Lucaria Academy - Liurnia of the Lakes. description: Amber egg clutched by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.Great Rune of unborn demigods. Perfects those who have been born anew. Children born anew by Rennala are all frail and short-lived.Imperfect beings, each and all. boss: Rennala Queen of the Full Moon

Phantom Great Rune. type: Great Rune. effect: Give blessing of blood to enemies in invaded world. description: Item for online play. Obtained after using the Mohg's Great Rune and invading another world. Consumed upon use. Enemies inside the invaded world receive a blessing of blood, which boosts their attack power when blood loss occurs nearby. Also, your HP recovers when blessed enemies defeat a player.

Cracked Pot. type: Container. usage: Container required for crafting cracked pot items. A maximum of 20 can be held.. location: See Cracked Pot for a full list of locations. description: This empty pot somehow mends itself when broken. Essential vessel for crafting cracked pot items. The materials and magics sealed within deploy their effects when the pot is thrown.

Ritual Pot. type: Container. usage: Container required for crafting ritual pot items. A maximum of 10 can be held.. location: See Ritual Pot for a full list of locations. description: This empty pot somehow mends itself when broken. Special item with greater durability than a cracked pot. Essential vessel for crafting ritual pot items. The materials and magics sealed within deploy their effects when the pot is thrown.

Perfume Bottle. type: Container. usage: Container required for crafting perfume items. A maximum of 10 can be held.. location: See Perfume Bottle for a full list of locations. description: Glass bottles used by perfumers. Used to seal various scent compounds. Essential vessel for crafting perfume items. The art of perfuming was once jealously guarded in the capital, but after the perfumers were drafted into service during the Shattering, the art became widely practiced throughout the Lands Between.

Memory Stone. type: Slot Increase. usage: Increases Memory Slots. A maximum of 8 can be held.. location: See Memory Stone for a full list of locations. description: A black, lightly beguiling stone. Prized by the sorcerers who produce them. Increases memory slots. Said to be a fragment of the black moon that once hung above the Eternal City.

Talisman Pouch. type: Slot Increase. usage: Increases Talisman equip slots. A maximum of 3 can be held.. location: Upon defeating Margit, the Fell Omen in Stormhill [Map Link]or Morgott, the Omen King in Leyndell, Royal Capital[Map Link] After speaking to Finger Reader Enia, after acquiring two Great Runes.or found in the Twin Maiden Husks' shop, if missed from Enia Upon defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord in Leyndell, Royal Capital[Map Link]. description: Small, withered bag, knitted by hand. Bestowed upon the ruling lord, or those attempting to become lord, by the elderly Finger Reader. Increases talisman equip slot. As the voices of the Two Fingers, Finger Readers are said to live lives eternal, and one is even supposed to have served as a wetnurse to royalty. or or omamori

Heart of Bayle. type: Exchange. usage: Gain power of Bayle at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. location: Dropped by Bayle the Dread. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: The biatrial heart of Bayle the Dread. Dotted with horn-like gravel stones and glistening with deep-red liquor. Gorge upon this at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion to absorb Bayle's power. The purest form of Communion, in the words of its priestess.

Larval Tear. type: Exchange. usage: Material needed by Rennala to grant rebirth. location: Prospect Town: Can be found on an area of illuminated graves. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]Can be found southeast of Scorched Ruins. It's possible that this can only be found at night as it's encompassed by glowing gravestones. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: An exceptionally rare creature that burgeons from spiritgraves and lives only a fleeting existence.Neither flesh nor spirit, but something in between. Material required by the amber egg cradled by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, to birth people anew. Being born anew allows the reallocation of attributes boosted by leveling up. An exceptionally rare creature that burgeons from spiritgraves and lives only a fleeting existence. Neither flesh nor spirit, but something in between. Material required by the amber egg cradled by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, to birth people anew. Being born anew allows the reallocation of attributes boosted by leveling up.

Well Depths Key. type: Exploration. usage: Opens the iron grating at the bottom of the well in Belurat. location: Belurat Tower Settlement: From the bridge, enter the room with two enemies and you will find the Well Depths Key there. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: A crude, corroded key. Opens the iron grating at the bottom of the well in Belurat, the tower settlement.

Gaol Upper Level Key. type: Exploration. usage: Opens the iron grating on the upper level of the Lamenter's Gaol. location: Can be found within Lamenter's Gaol. When you enter, proceed until you reach a fork in the path. Take the left turn, and after a short walk, enter the room on your right. Inside, you'll find a chest containing the Gaol Upper Level Key. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: A frozen iron key. Opens the iron grating on the upper level of the Lamenter's Gaol.

Gaol Lower Level Key. type: Exploration. usage: Opens the iron grating on the lower level of the Lamenter's Gaol. location: Can be found in the lower level of the Lamenter's Gaol. After using the Gaol Upper Level Key and descending the ladder, follow the path until you can climb a rocky ledge on your right. Take the left door, go ahead, jump down, and follow the wooden path. At the first entrance, take a left and continue straight. Climb down the rocks where you'll find a chest with the Gaol Lower Level Key inside. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: A frozen iron key. Opens the iron grating on the lower level of the Lamenter's Gaol.

Storeroom Key. type: Exploration. usage: Use to open the storeroom on the second floor of Belurat. location: Belurat Tower Settlement: From the top of the waterfall, you will find a room with a ladder, enter the room and climb the ladder. At the top, you will find a corpse with the Storeroom Key. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: A key with a spiral engraving. Opens the door to the storeroom on the second floor of Belurat, the tower settlement.

Stonesword Key. type: Exploration. usage: Use to break one imp statue seal. location: See Stonesword Key for a full list of locations. description: A sword-shaped stone key. Breaks the seal on imp statues, but remains embedded in the statue after use, meaning it can only be used once as an item. Think well before using one.

Keep Wall Key. type: Exploration. usage: Opens the wooden door on the west wall of the keep. location: Location goes here.... description: Iron key with an engraved crest. Opens the wooden door beside the great gate on the shadow keep's west wall.

Prayer Room Key. type: Exploration. usage: Opens prayer room door in the house of worship found in the church district. location: Church of the Crusade: Acquired as a drop upon defeating the NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: Iron key with an engraved crest. Opens the door to the prayer room in the house of worship found in the church district of the shadow keep.

Igon's Furled Finger. type: Exploration / Quest. usage: Summons Drake Warrior Igon from his sign. location: Will be given by Igon by interacting with him after defeating the Jagged Peak Drake in the area. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: Furled finger of Igon, the broken drake warrior. Gnarled and knotty, and deeply discolored on the inside. When facing Bayle the Dread, this summons Drake Warrior Igon from his sign. "My soul yet lies on the mountain."

Black Syrup. type: Exploration / Quest. usage: Something Moore asked to be delivered to Thiollier. location: Talk to Moore outside Belurat, Tower Settlement to receive the Black Syrup item. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: An ebony-black syrup held in an unglazed jar. Moore asked that this be delivered to Thiollier. An unknown liquid apparently gathered and aged by the forager brood.

Messmer's Kindling. type: Exploration / Quest. usage: Burns the sealing tree. location: Dropped by Messmer the Impaler. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: The kindling that burned inside Messmer the Impaler. A dark thing, eaten away at by a wicked serpent. Burns the sealing tree said to be found at the old Rauh ruins. Messmer, much like his younger sister, bore a vision of fire.

Hole-Laden Necklace. type: Exploration/ Quest. usage: Use at a hallowed ruin to sound a hanging bell. location: Cathedral of Manus Metyr: Given by Count Ymir when first interacted. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: A pale-blue necklace made from a thin, elongated stone hollowed out from the inside. Use at a hallowed ruin to sound a hanging bell. It was a teaching of Count Ymir. The fate of the one who sounds the hanging bell will be guided by the stars.

Imbued Sword Key. type: Exploration. usage: Unseals sending gate, but disappears upon use. location: Castle Ensis: The Imbued Sword Key item can be found inside a treasure chest. The chest is located inside a tower's armor room. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map] The Four Belfries, Liurnia. Found in a chest at the topmost belfry[Map Link] Raya Lucaria Academy, Liurnia Looted from a corpse found on the east side of the rooftops[Map Link] Sellia, Town of Sorcery, Caelid Found in a barricaded, small building in the northeast section of town. Dispel the barrier by lighting the brazier atop the southwest tower[Map Link]. description: Stone key shaped like a sword.A special item, imbued with rich blue magic. Breaks the seal on the imp statues guarding the sending gates enshrined in each belfry, but remains embedded in the statue after use, meaning it can only be used once as an item. Think well before using one.

Rusty Key. type: Exploration. usage: Opens a locked door in Stormveil Castle. location: Stormveil Castle, Limgrave Found in the dark room guarded by the Banished Knight[Map Link]. description: Rusted iron key. Opens a locked door in Stormveil Castle

Drawing-Room Key. type: Exploration. usage: Key to the Volcano Manor drawing room. location: Volcano Manor, Mt Gelmir Received from Tanith after pledging your service to the Volcano Manor.[Map Link] Alternatively, if Rykard is killed before pledging your services, Tanith will disappear from the Manor, the key will be left in her chair. description: Key to Volcano Manor's drawing room. The door can be found in the westward corridor, upon the left hand side.

Sewer-Gaol Key. type: Exploration. usage: Unlocks sewer-gaol door beneath Leyndell.. location: Roundtable Hold Received from Dung Eater after acquiring at least one Seedbed Curse. description: Filthy key received from the Dung Eater. Unlocks sewer-gaol door said to lie beneath Leyndell, the Royal Capital.

Discarded Palace Key. type: Exploration. usage: Opens a treasure chest passed down to Carian Princesses.. location: Received from Miniature Ranni after defeating the Baleful Shadow. description: A key discarded by Lunar Princess Ranni alongside her very flesh. Opens a treasure chest passed down to Carian Princesses. It is said to be found in the Grand Library of Raya Lucaria with her mother Rennala.

Academy Glintstone Key. type: Exploration/ Quest. usage: Key to open the academy's two sealed gates. location: West of the Academy, Liurnia Found on a sorcerer's corpse behind Glintstone Dragon Smarag[Map Link] Raya Lucaria Academy, Liurnia Looted off a corpse hanging from the Church of the Cuckoo's chandelier. To reach the ceiling, you need to maneuver the rooftop section of the Academy[Map Link]. description: Key to the seals binding both gates to the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Activates warp magic bound within the seals. A glintstone key will remember its user, meaning once used it can never be passed on to another. The academy does not welcome the indolent.

Sellian Sealbreaker. type: Quest. usage: Can release Master Lusat from his confinement.. location: Obtained during Sorceress Sellen's questline. After finding Comet Azur on the body of Primeval Sorcerer Azur, speak with Sellen to further her quest. She will have an additional dialogue option, 'I have a favor to ask' that will give the player the Sellian Sealbreaker.. description: Glintstone key received from the sorceress Sellen. Capable of breaking the seal that keeps Master Lusat confined. Sellia, Town of Sorcerery can be found in Caelid. This key was said to have been found in the possession of a Sellian sorcerer.

Carian Inverted Statue. type: Quest. usage: Key revealing the hidden form of Carian Study Hall.. location: Given by Ranni in Ranni's Rise after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade.[Map Link]. description: Statuette of a scholar, with ground and sky inverted. Reveals the hidden form of the Carian Study Hall, which connects to the divine tower. To unveil the secret, affix it to the pedestal of the celestial globe.

Dectus Medallion (Left). type: Exploration. usage: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Dectus.. location: Fort Haight, Limgrave Found atop the tower, accessible via ladder[Map Link]. description: Left half of a split medallion depicting the Erdtree. Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Life of Dectus, connecting the Altus Plateau to Liurnia. The right half is said to reside in Fort Faroth in the Dragonbarrow, far to the east.

Dectus Medallion (Right). type: Exploration. usage: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Dectus.. location: Fort Faroth, Caelid Found atop the eastern tower, accessible via ladder[Map Link]. description: Right half of a split medallion depicting the Erdtree. Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Dectus, connecting the Altus Plateau to Liurnia. The left half is said to reside in the coastal Fort Haight to the far west.

Rold Medallion. type: Exploration. usage: Activates the Grand Lift of Rold, connecting Leyndell to the Mountaintops of the Giants.. location: Received from Melina after defeating Morgott, The Omen King[Map Link]. description: Conjoined split medallion depicting the Flame Peak. Brandishing the medallion activates the Grand Lift of Rold, connecting Leyndell to the Mountaintops of the Giants. The forge of the flame of ruin is said to be found upon their peaks, and it is here Melina wishes to travel in resuming your journey together.

Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left). type: Exploration/ Quest. usage: Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path.. location: Castle Sol, Mountaintops of the Giants Found on the roof of the tower in the northeast, accessible after defeating Commander Niall[Map Link]. description: Left half of a split medallion depicting the Haligtree. Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path. In other words, this secret medallion will guide the bearer to the land of Miquella's Haligtree.

Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right). type: Exploration/ Quest. usage: Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path.. location: Village of the Albinaurics, Liurnia Received from Albus after unveiling his disguise. Found at the top of the hill, past the Depraved Perfumer[Map Link]. description: Right half of a split medallion depicting the Haligtree. Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path. In other words, this secret medallion will guide the bearer to the land of Miquella's Haligtree.

Chrysalids' Memento. type: Quest. usage: Broach wrapped in red velvet.. location: Found in Stormveil Castle, atop a pile of corpses in a room adjacent to a Grafted Scion mini-boss[Map Link]. description: Memento left by the chrysalids sacrificed for grafting. A brooch wrapped in red velvet. Traces of blood are visible. Faintly visible spirits try to convey something, but their voices cannot be heard.

The Stormhawk King. type: Quest. usage: Ashes of a hawk which heeds no summons.. location: Chapel of Anticipation Upon returning to this location later in the game, head towards the roof of the southern wing of the chapel[Map Link]. description: Ashes of a hawk revered by all others as sovereign back in the days when Stormveil's winds still raged like no other. This ancient monarch is proud however, refusing to answer anyone's summons.

Irina's Letter. type: Quest. usage: Letter addressed to the commander of Castle Morne. location: Weeping Peninsula, Limgrave Received from Irina just near the Bridge of Sacrifice Site of Grace[Map Link]. description: Letter given by Irina, addressed to her father, the commander of Castle Morne. Gorgeous silken handkerchief, lightly stained with blood. Words can be made out within.

Shabriri Grape. type: Quest. usage: Yellow, oozing eyeball of the infirm.. location: One can be found near a spirit NPC at Godrick's throne room at Stormveil Castle, You do not have to defeat Godrick in order to obtain it, you can enter from the back by going around the castle using the broken bridge route.[Map Link] Can be found on the lower level of the Purified Ruins. The entrance to this area is blocked by a large plank of wood that can be destroyed with rolls or attacks.[Map Link] One is dropped by Edgar the Revenger, an NPC invader found at the Revenger's Shack in western Liurnia[Map Link]. description: A yellowing, oozing eyeball of the infirm. The surface is shriveled, and the inside is squishy, not unlike a large, overly-ripe grape. Give to the blind maiden to guide her to the distant light.

Fingerprint Grape. type: Quest. usage: Eyeball of the knight Vyke, inflamed yellow. location: Dropped by Festering Fingerprint Vyke[Map Link]. description: Eyeball of the knight Vyke, inflamed yellow. Seared with a repulsive fingerprint burn akin to those that marred his entire body. If offered to the blind maiden, it will lead her to the source of the distant light, allowing her to become a Finger Maiden.

Rya's Necklace. type: Quest. usage: Rya's necklace, stolen by a blackguard.. location: After speaking with Rya (Map Link]), you will get a quest to receive this stolen necklace. The necklace can be found at Blackguard Big Boggart's shack just a bit to the northwest. It can be bought for 1000 or by killing Blackguard.. description: Necklace stolen from Rya by the blackguard. Features a relief of a dignified looking woman from a foreign country. It appears to hold great significance for Rya.

Serpent's Amnion. type: Quest. usage: Amnion from a womb that bore unintended offspring.. location: Volcano Manor, Mt Gelmir Found on the altar after defeating the Godskin Noble[Map Link]. description: Amnion from the mother's womb which cradled the poor unwanted offspring of a repellant birthing ritual. It will never dry out, remaining damp indefinitely.

Tonic of Forgetfulness. type: Quest. usage: Tonic that banishes distress and bitter memories.. location: Received from Tanith after giving the Serpent's Amnion to Rya and returning to the Volcano Manor. description: Tonic in a small brass vial. Banishes distress and bitter memories. A gift bestowed by Rykard, sworn to blasphemy, to Lady Tanith, who unfortunately had no use for it. "My Lord, there could be no greater distress than to forget you."

Dancer's Castanets. type: Quest. usage: Castanets used by dancers from distant lands.. location: Given by Patches in Shaded Castle, before the boss room, after killing Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy and talking to him in Volcano Manor. description: Castanets used by dancers from foreign lands. Received from Patches. The passionate dance comprises no seductiveness, but merely a dignified beauty.

Unalloyed Gold Needle. type: Quest. usage: An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold.Removed by Millicent from her flesh. Bears no trace of befouled blood, but is faintly moist with dew.. location: Found upon Millicent's corpse after the end of her questline (if you sided with her). description: An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold. Once snapped in half, it has been repaired by Sage Gowry. A ritual implement crafted to ward away the meddling of outer gods, it is thought capable of forestalling the incurable rotting sickness. "Now, all you need to do is deliver the needle to Millicent, convalescing in the church atop the cliff just beyond Sellia." An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold. Removed by Millicent from her flesh. Bears no trace of befouled blood, but is faintly moist with dew. "There is something I must return to Malenia. The dignity, the sense of self, that allowed her to resist the call of the scarlet rot."

Unalloyed Gold Needle. type: Quest. usage: Snapped intricate needle of unalloyed gold.. location: Swamp of Aeonia, Caelid Dropped by Commander O’Neil[Map Link]. description: An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold. Once snapped in half, it has been repaired by Sage Gowry. A ritual implement crafted to ward away the meddling of outer gods, it is thought capable of forestalling the incurable rotting sickness. "Now, all you need to do is deliver the needle to Millicent, convalescing in the church atop the cliff just beyond Sellia." An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold. Removed by Millicent from her flesh. Bears no trace of befouled blood, but is faintly moist with dew. "There is something I must return to Malenia. The dignity, the sense of self, that allowed her to resist the call of the scarlet rot."

Unalloyed Gold Needle. type: Quest. usage: An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold. Once snapped in half, it has been repaired by Sage Gowry.. location: Repaired by Sage Gowry after delivering him the original Unalloyed Gold Needle.. description: An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold. Once snapped in half, it has been repaired by Sage Gowry. A ritual implement crafted to ward away the meddling of outer gods, it is thought capable of forestalling the incurable rotting sickness. "Now, all you need to do is deliver the needle to Millicent, convalescing in the church atop the cliff just beyond Sellia." An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold. Removed by Millicent from her flesh. Bears no trace of befouled blood, but is faintly moist with dew. "There is something I must return to Malenia. The dignity, the sense of self, that allowed her to resist the call of the scarlet rot."

Valkyrie's Prosthesis. type: Quest. usage: Golden prosthesis used by the one-armed Valkyrie. location: Found in a chest in the room guarded by a single Cleanrot Knight on the North Western edge of The Shaded Castle.[Map Link]. description: Golden prosthesis once used by the one-armed valkyrie. A masterwork of craftsmanship, with practice and skill it can be used as proficiently as a real arm. When Maleigh Marais, Lord of the Shaded Castle, embraced this prosthesis, he claimed to feel the presence of his personal goddess.

Alexander's innards. type: Quest. usage: A keepsake of the warrior jar Alexander. Found at the core of the dead flesh that once filled the great jar.. location: Crumbling Farum Azula After enough progress through Iron Fist Alexander's questline, he can be found past the crumbling tower where he will request a duel. Upon victory the player will receive this along with a Warrior Jar Shard and a Shard of Alexander.[Map Link]. description: A keepsake of the warrior jar Alexander. Found at the core of the dead flesh that once filled the great jar. The jars contain dregs inherited from those who came before. Thus are warriors passed from jar to jar, carrying dreams of greatness.

Lord of Blood's Favor. type: Quest. usage: Pure white oath-cloth given by Varré.. location: Reward for completing White Mask Varré's task. description: Before soaking: Pure white oath-cloth given by Varré. The final trial to be anointed a Knight of Mohg, Lord of Blood. "Soak the cloth with a maiden's blood... The blood of anyone's maiden will do. You are maidenless, after all." After soaking: Fully reddened oath-cloth, dyed in a maiden's blood. The final trial is complete. Luminary Mohg is sure to welcome you into his service, as a knight who will lay the foundations for his dynasty.

Lord of Blood's Favor. type: Quest. usage: Fully reddened oath-cloth, dyed in a maiden's blood.. location: Obtained after soaking the white cloth with a maiden's blood. description: Before soaking: Pure white oath-cloth given by Varré. The final trial to be anointed a Knight of Mohg, Lord of Blood. "Soak the cloth with a maiden's blood... The blood of anyone's maiden will do. You are maidenless, after all." After soaking: Fully reddened oath-cloth, dyed in a maiden's blood. The final trial is complete. Luminary Mohg is sure to welcome you into his service, as a knight who will lay the foundations for his dynasty.

Weathered Dagger. type: Quest. usage: Dagger received from Fia, Deathbed Companion. location: Roundtable Hold Obtained from Fia after reaching Altus Plateau.. description: Dagger received from Fia, the Deathbed Companion. She wishes for it to be returned to its rightful owner. It was once a special weapon of gold and silver intertwined, but is now worn down and marred by a black gash.

Black Knifeprint. type: Quest. usage: Mark of the Night of the Black Knives ritual. location: Drops from Black Knife Assassin in Black Knife Catacombs[Map Link]. description: On the Night of the Black Knives, someone stole a fragment of Death from Maliketh, the Black Blade, and imbued its power into the assassins' daggers. This mark is evidence of the ritual, and hides the truth of the conspiracy.

Cursemark of Death. type: Quest. usage: Cursemark carved into Lunar Princess Ranni's discarded flesh.. location: Found on a body lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia[Map Link]. description: Cursemark carved into the discarded flesh of Ranni the Witch. Also known as the half-wheel wound of the centipede. This cursemark was carved at the moment of Death of the first demigod, and should have taken the shape of a circle. However, two demigods perished at the same time, breaking the cursemark into two half-wheels. Ranni was the first of the demigods whose flesh perished, while the Prince of Death perished in soul alone.

Seedbed Curse. type: Quest. usage: Curse grown on a body defiled by the Dung Eater.. location: See Seedbed Curse for a full list of locations. description: Curse grown on a corpse killed and defiled by the Dung Eater. A tender pox afflicted with omen horns. The Dung Eater cultivates the seedbed curse on corpses. By doing so he prevents dead souls returning to the Erdtree, leaving them forever cursed. One of the most loathsome things found in the Lands Between.

Sellen's Primal Glintstone. type: Quest. usage: Glintstone from within Sellen's body.. location: Found beneath Witchbane Ruins. description: Glintstone from within the sorceress Sellen's body.Seemingly half-alive, blood vessels are visible within.In essence, a primal glintstone is a sorcerer's soul.If transplanted into a compatible new body after their original body dies, the sorcerer will rise again."My apprentice, do you think it distasteful?"

Seluvis's Potion. type: Quest. usage: Small flask received from Preceptor Seluvis. location: Acquired from Seluvis at Seluvis's Rise after being asked by Ranni the Witch to speak with him[Map Link]. description: Small flask received from Preceptor Seluvis containing a cloudy tonic of bluish black. "Find Nepheli, and ensure she drinks it."

Seluvis's Introduction. type: Quest. usage: Letter of introduction addressed to Sellen. location: Seluvis's Rise, Liurnia Given by Preceptor Seluvis. description: Scroll bearing a royal coat of arms. A letter of introduction written by Preceptor Seluvis. Addressed to a glintstone sorceress by the name of Sellen. The contents of the scroll cannot be discerned.

Amber Starlight. type: Quest. usage: Used in the preparation of a peculiar drought.. location: Altus Plateau Found through a cave north-east of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace[Map Link]. description: An ephemeral sliver that gives off a pale amber glow. What remains of a passing flash of starlight. If the stars command our fates, then amber-hued stars must command the fates of the gods. Such is the belief that inspired the use of these shards to prepare a most special draught. Cannot be consumed by mere humans.

Amber Draught. type: Quest. usage: Given by Preceptor Seluvis during his questline, when choosing to betray Ranni the Witch.. location: Received from Preceptor Seluvis after handing over the Amber Starlight. description: Small flask received from Preceptor Seluvis containing a gleaming amber draught for use in a scheme. "Give it to Ranni and ensure she drinks it. And we'll be in a position to claim the very finest puppet ever crafted."

Fingerslayer Blade. type: Quest. usage: Hidden treasure of the Eternal City of Nokron.. location: Found in a chest under the massive skeleton statue in Night's Sacred Ground[Map Link]. description: The hidden treasure of the Eternal City of Nokron; a blade said to have been born of a corpse. This blood-drenched fetish is proof of the high treason committed by the Eternal City and symbolizes its downfall. Cannot be wielded by those without a fate, but is said to be able to harm the Greater Will and its vassals.

Miniature Ranni. type: Quest. usage: Doll resembling Ranni the Witch.. location: Found in an open stone coffin in the waters of Ainsel River Main[Map Link]. description: A doll resembling Ranni the Witch. From head to toe every detail is perfect. This unresponsive doll seems pleasantly cool. A doll resembling Ranni the Witch. From head to toe every detail is perfect. The chilliness is gone, feeling now like an empty husk. There is no response. Ach, this form hath loosened my tongue. I've let slip too much. Forget what thou'st heard. Forget.

Dark Moon Ring. type: Quest. usage: Ring of Lunar Princess Ranni's cold oath.. location: Found in a locked chest next to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library Site of Grace - unlocked using the Discarded Palace Key[Map Link]. description: Ring depicting a leaden full moon. Symbolic of a cold oath, the ring is supposed to be given by Lunar Princess Ranni to her consort. Ranni is an Empyrean, meaning her consort would by rights earn the title of lord. A warning is engraved within; "Whoever thou mayest be, take not the ring from this place, the solitude beyond the night is better mine alone."

Deathroot. type: Exchange. usage: Beast Clergyman seeks and devours these.. location: See Deathroot for a full list of locations. description: A source that gives rise to Those Who Live in Death. The beast clergyman, found at Bestial Sanctum in the distant east, collects and devours these roots. On the night of the dire plot the stolen Rune of Death enabled the first Death of a demigod. Later, the Rune of Death spread across the Lands Between through the underground roots of the Greattree, sprouting in the form of Deathroot.

Beast Eye. type: Quest. usage: Said to tremble when close to Deathroot.. location: Gurranq, Beast Clergyman rewards the player for bringing Deathroot. description: Claw-marked stone eye received from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman. It is said to tremble when near Deathroot. The murky violet iris writhes as if alive. "I am not sated... Feed me more...Death..."

Dragon Heart. type: Exchange. usage: Gain power of the dragon at the Dragon Communion altar.. location: See Dragon Heart for an extensive list of item locations.. description: Dragon heart seized by a dragon tracker. Riddled with Gravel Stone, this grotesque organ continues to beat vivaciously. An offering used in the Dragon Communion. Consume a dragon's heart at the altar to make its power yours. While a terrible and savage-looking thing, the heart has a peculiar beauty to it.

Lost Ashes of War. type: Exchange. usage: Used to duplicate Ashes of War.. location: See Lost Ashes of War for a full list of locations. description: Empty ashes of war, devoid of any memories of battle. Unable to apply any kind of affinity in their current state, but can be used by Smithing Master Hewg of the Roundtable Hold to recreate other ashes. Thus does the copy pass into becoming the genuine article.

Celestial Dew. type: Exchange. usage: Carry out Absolution at the Church of Vows.. location: See Celestial Dew for a full list of locations. description: A hidden Tear found in the Eternal City. Also known as a Night Tear. Allows one to carry out an Absolution at the Church of Vows, reversing all antagonizations. Once upon a time, the stars of the night sky guided fate, and this is a recollection of those times.

Larval Tear. type: Exchange. usage: Material needed by Rennala to grant rebirth.. location: See Larval Tear for a full list of locations. description: An exceptionally rare creature that burgeons from spiritgraves and lives only a fleeting existence.Neither flesh nor spirit, but something in between. Material required by the amber egg cradled by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, to birth people anew. Being born anew allows the reallocation of attributes boosted by leveling up. An exceptionally rare creature that burgeons from spiritgraves and lives only a fleeting existence. Neither flesh nor spirit, but something in between. Material required by the amber egg cradled by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, to birth people anew. Being born anew allows the reallocation of attributes boosted by leveling up.

Crafting Kit. type: Feature Unlock. usage: Enables item crafting from the main menu.. location: Church of Elleh, Limgrave Can be purchased from Merchant Kalé for 300 Runes[Map Link]. description: Leather bag containing a pestle and mortar, small blade, and various other tools. Enables item crafting from the main menu. Provides both means to fight and means to survive.

Spirit Calling Bell. type: Feature Unlock. usage: Bell that summons various spirits from ashen items. location: Church of Elleh, Limgrave Received from Renna after obtaining the Spectral Steed Whistle. description: A bell capable of summoning various spirits from ashen remains. It usually requires FP to use. Spirits can only be summoned in the vicinity of a rebirth monument. When summoning is possible, the monument icon will be visible on the left side of the screen. Only one type of spirit may be summoned at once, and none may be summoned during multiplayer.

Whetstone Knife. type: Feature Unlock. usage: Can add new battle arts and affinities to weapons. location: Gatefront Ruins, Limgrave A set of stairs leads to a room with a chest containing it and the Ash of War: Storm Stomp[Map Link]. description: Whetstone with a cipher inscription, made to look like a small knifeblade. Allows the use of ashes of war at a site of grace to bestow new battle arts and affinities to armaments as skills. The battle arts and affinities will depend on the ashes of war used.

Cross Map. type: Maps. usage: Map marked with the locations of golden crosses. location: Given by Hornsent when first interacted with. Speak to Hornsent when you first meet him and exhaust his dialogue lines to obtain the item. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: A simple map drafted by a hornsent. Marked with the locations of golden crosses. These crosses indicate Miquella's footprints.

New Cross Map. type: Maps. usage: Map showing new locations of golden crosses. location: Meet Hornsent in the Highroad Cross Site of Grace, to receive this new map. You must pass through Castle Ensis right after defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: A simple map drafted by a hornsent. Recently revised.
