Reveals the locations of newly-discovered golden crosses. The crosses are akin to Miquella's footprints. Or gravestones, which mark what he has left behind.

Ruins Map. type: Maps. usage: Map indicating the location of a hallowed ruin. location: Given by Count Ymir when first met at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: A simple old map, faded and dirty. Acquired from Count Ymir, High Priest. Indicates the location of a hallowed ruin. "I only wish to be of service."

Ruins Map (2nd). type: Maps. usage: Map indicating the location of a hallowed ruin. location: Given by Count Ymir.. description: A simple old map, faded and dirty. Acquired from Count Ymir, High Priest. Indicates another hallowed ruin, apart from the one shown on the first map. "May the gleaming stars guide you evermore."

Ruins Map (3rd). type: Maps. usage: Map indicating the location of a hallowed ruin. location: Given by Count Ymir.. description: A simple old map, faded and dirty. Acquired from Count Ymir, High Priest. Indicates a third and final hallowed ruin, distinct from those shown on the first two maps. "May you join the glimmering stars above."

Map: Gravesite Plain. type: Maps. usage: Map of Gravesite Plain. location: To find this Map Fragment, travel directly northeast from when you first entered the Shadow Realm. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. description: Map of the Gravesite Plain. A somber plain covered in spiritgraves. The spiral tower of the hornsent lies to the northwest, and the entire expanse is marred by the harrowing ravages of war.

Map: Scadu Altus. type: Maps. usage: Map of Scadu Altus. location: It can be found if you continue the path forward past the Highroad Cross Site of Grace, you will eventually run into it. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. description: Map of Scadu Altus. The plateau occupied by Messmer's army that peers towards the Scadutree to the northeast, named after its counterpart in the realm of the Erdtree. At its center lies the shadow keep.

Map: Southern Shore. type: Maps. usage: Map of the southern shore of Gravesite Plain. location: South of the Cerulean Coast Site of Grace past the ghost flame dragon, at a bend in the road. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: Map of the southern shore of the Gravesite Plain. A captivating vista of brilliant blue flowers, intermingled with colossal stone coffins of unknown origin that seemingly drifted to this place. To the east, the jagged peak thrusts upward into the clouds.

Map: Rauh Ruins. type: Maps. usage: Map of the Rauh Ruins. location: Can be looted by the foot of a monolith. To reach this location, make your way into the Scadu Atlus region. Starting from the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace located in Scadu Atlus, head northeast towards the hidden cave and follow the tunnel leading to the Ancient Ruins Base. Next, follow the canyon along and you'll find it just outside the Temple Town Ruins. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. description: Map of the ancient Rauh Ruins. These giant ruins are flooded, overgrown, and split into two by a chasm. To the southwest is the Church of the Bud, overlooking the tower of shadow.

Map: Abyss. type: Maps. usage: Map of the Abyss to the east of Gravesite Plain. location: Map of the Abbys at the east of the Gravesite Plain. Found besides a column. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. description: Map of the abyss at the east of the Gravesite Plain. A thick forest sprawls at the depths of the ravine that is untouched even by sunlight. Known as the sanctum of Sage Midra, and is a region forbidden by the hornsent.

Sewing Needle. type: Quest. usage: A large sewing needle, curved like a fang. Boc the demi-human's prized possession.. location: Coastal Cave, Limgrave Dropped by Demi-Human Chief. description: A large sewing needle, curved like a fang.Boc the demi-human's prized possession.

Gold Sewing Needle. type: Quest. usage: Special sewing needle for demigod attire.. location: Church of Vows, Liurnia Found in a chest. description: Sewing needle made of gold. Unique item made to alter demigod attire. One of the tools brought by Radagon when he entered into marriage with Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, and joined the Carian line.

Tailoring Tools. type: Feature Unlock. usage: Enables armor adjustment at sites of grace.. location: Coastal Cave, Limgrave Dropped by Demi-Human Chief. description: A portable set of tailoring tools. Enables armor alterations at sites of grace.

Golden Tailoring Tools. type: Feature Unlock. usage: Allows demigod garb alteration at sites of grace.. location: Church of Vows, Liurnia Found in a chest. description: Tailoring tools made from gold. Tools brought with the red-haired Radagon when he married into the Carian line. With these, even demigod attire can be altered at a site of grace.

Map: Limgrave, West. type: Maps. usage: Map of Limgrave's western region.. location: Looted from a pillar in Gatefront Ruins, just south from Stormgate[Map Link]. description: Map of the western region of Limgrave. The demesne of Limgrave, far south of the Erdtree, is bordered to the northwest by the cliffs of Stormveil, and under its ever-clouded skies roll the great steppes of the pale lands.

Map: Limgrave, East. type: Maps. usage: Map of Limgrave's eastern region.. location: Can be found North-East of Mistwood Ruins, in front of a pillar containing what appears to be ancient writings[Map Link]. description: Map of the eastern region of Limgrave. Other than the Mistwood which envelops the south, it is known for its lands which lead to Caelid, a path trod by many a soldier in the past.

Map: Weeping Peninsula. type: Maps. usage: Map of Weeping peninsula.. location: The map for Weeping Peninsula is found by following the main road south from the Bridge of Sacrifice, past the Castle Morne Rampart site of Grace[Map Link]. description: Map of the Weeping Peninsula. The peninsula, to Limgrave's south, is named for its unceasing rainfall, redolent of lament.

Map: Liurnia, West. type: Maps. usage: Map of Liurnia's western region.. location: On a monolith in the open field northeast of the North Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace in northern Liurnia[Map Link]. description: Map of Liurnia's western region. The majority of Liurnia, known for its vast forests and ever-present fog, is sinking into a lake. The western coast has always been closely associated with Carian royalty.

Map: Liurnia, East. type: Maps. usage: Map of Liurnia's eastern region.. location: Found in the south of the swampy lake, in the middle by a monument with enlightened texts on it, in Liurnia[Map Link]. description: Map of Liurnia's eastern region. The majority of Liurnia, known for its vast forests and ever-present fog, is sinking into a lake. The eastern coast is home to a highroad running north and south.

Map: Liurnia, North. type: Maps. usage: Map of Liurnia's northern region.. location: You can find the Liurnia North Map at the South Entrance to the Academy Gate Town, by the flooded roads leading to the Academy of Raya Lucaria. description: Map of Liurnia's northern region. The Academy of Raya Lucaria towers over the north, while at its base spreads the town built around it, now flooded. Two highroads end their journeys here.

Map: Altus Plateau. type: Maps. usage: Map of Altus Plateau and environs.. location: North of the Altus Highway Junction site of grace[Map Link]. description: Map of Altus Plateau and environs. The Altus Plateau, where the Erdtree's base can be found, contains the Royal Capital of Leyndell to the east, and Mt. Gelmir to the west. Scars from the Shattering remain apparent to this day.

Map: Leyndell, Royal Capital. type: Maps. usage: Map of Leyndell Capital and environs.. location: Capital Outskirts: Found under a monolith near the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace[Map Link]. description: Map of the Royal Capital of Leyndell and environs. Leyndell, City of the Erdtree, is a metropolis enclosed by double ramparts. The inner wall remains unbreached to this day.

Map: Mt. Gelmir. type: Maps. usage: Map of Mt. Gelmir and environs.. location: Found on a pillar in front of the Road of Iniquity Site of Grace[Map Link]. description: Map of Mt. Gelmir and environs. Mt. Gelmir, which houses the Volcano Manor at its summit, is characterized by sheer cliffs and ominous skies. These qualities only became more pronounced after the Shattering.

Map: Caelid. type: Maps. usage: Map of Caelid and environs.. location: On a monolith near the middle of Caelid Highway South. Directly southeast of the Caelid Highway South Sites of Grace[Map Link]. description: Map of Caelid and environs. Caelid, known as the locale of the last battle between General Radahn and Malenia, Blade of Miquella, is a vast land consummately marred by scarlet rot.

Map: Dragonbarrow. type: Maps. usage: Map of Dragonbarrow and environs.. location: Found on a monolith directly east of the Dragonbarrow West Site of Grace, along the road[Map Link]. description: Map of Dragonbarrow and environs. The dragons that escaped the scarlet rot and made nest of the plateau to Caelid's north. Thus it was named "Dragonbarrow," and none dare to enter.

entity: Map: Mountaintops of The Giants, West
text: Map: Mountaintops of The Giants, West. type: Maps. usage: Map of Western Mountaintops of the Giants.. location: Go up the Grand Lift of Rold from Leyndell, along the path. description: Map of Western Mountaintops of the Giants. Marching ground during the War against the Giants. They carved winding paths in the cliff walls right up to the summit, leading to the untrodden snow-laden region beyond.

source.entity: Map: Mountaintops of The Giants, West

entity: Map: Mountaintops of The Giants, East
text: Map: Mountaintops of The Giants, East. type: Maps. usage: Map of Eastern Mountaintops of the Giants.. location: Mountaintops of the Giants: Found at the altar. You can arrive by walking on the chain from the enemy encampment [Map Link]. description: Map of Eastern Mountaintops of the Giants. The remote, desolate eastern summit is the highest point in all the Lands Between, overlooking even the Flame Peak to the south.

source.entity: Map: Mountaintops of The Giants, East

text: Map: Consecrated Snowfield. type: Maps. usage: Map of Consecrated Snowfield and environs.. location: Map for all of Consecrated Snowfield: find it by following the road north past the snowstorm until you go down and cross a frozen river, then you will spot the map pillar ahead[Map Link]. description: Map of Consecrated Snowfield and environs. The route through this land, crossed east to west by a frozen river, leads to Miquella's Haligtree. This is the path taken by those unchosen, though it is a trial all the same.

Map: Ainsel River. type: Maps. usage: Map of Ainsel River and environs.. location: Found inside a ruin next to the Nomadic Merchant in Ainsel River[Map Link]. description: Map of Ainsel River and environs Two great rivers flow beneath the Lands Between, the Siofra and the Ainsel. The vast region is said to be the grave of civilizations that flourished before the Erdtree.

Map: Lake of Rot. type: Maps. usage: Map of Lake of Rot and environs.. location: Found on a corpse by the water's edge at Lake of Rot, by the Lake Rot Shoreside Site of Grace[Map Link]. description: Map of Lake of Rot and environs. A great lake of standing water downstream of the Ainsel River. It is said that the divine essence of an outer god is sealed away in this land.

Map: Siofra River. type: Maps. usage: Map of Siofra River and environs.. location: Found next to the staircase leading up to Hallowhorn Grounds[Map Link]. description: Map of Siofra River and environs Two great rivers flow beneath the Lands Between, the Siofra and the Ainsel. This vast region is said to be the grave of civilizations that flourished before the Erdtree.

Map: Mohgwyn Palace. type: Maps. usage: Map of Mohgwyn Palace and environs.. location: Found soon after accessing the staircase to Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum, in the underground of Mohgwyn Palace - found just past a group of blood Albinaurics that summon giant skeletons[Map Link]. description: Map of Mohgwyn Palace and environs. In the lightless depths lies the grave of an ancient civilization. It is here Mohg, the Lord of Blood, is building his palace, to be the seat of his coming dynasty named Mohgwyn. And whatever nightmares that may bring.

Map: Deeproot Depths. type: Maps. usage: Map of Deeproot Depths and environs.. location: Can be found on a corpse in a gazebo amid the destroyed ruins[Map Link]. description: Map of Deeproot Depths and environs. At the very depths of the Erdtree's majestic roots lies the source of the Ainsel and the Siofra rivers. Here too begins the network of Greattree roots that spread throughout the Lands Between.

Academy Scroll. type: Spell Unlock. usage: Give to a learned sorcerer to unlock Great Glintstone Shard and Swift Glintstone Shard for purchase.. location: Liurnia Found in a graveyard, west of the Lake-Facing Cliff site of grace[Map Link]. description: Scroll of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, the glintstone sorcerers' place of study. Can be given to a learn sorcerer to gain access to the following sorceries: - Great Glintstone Shard- Swift Glintstone Shard

Conspectus Scroll. type: Spell Unlock. usage: Give to a learned sorcerer to unlock Glintstone Cometshard and Star Shower for purchase.. location: Great Hall, Raya Lucaria Academy From the doorway, go left and you'll find a room, there is a body that you can loot to find the scroll[Map Link]. description: A sorcery scroll from the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Details superior sorceries taught to scholars worthy of donning the stone crown and studying a certain conspectus. Can be given to a learned sorcerer to gain access to the following sorceries: - Glintstone Cometshard - Star Shower

Royal House Scroll. type: Spell Unlock. usage: Give to a learned sorcerer to unlock Glintblade Phalanx and Carian Slicer for purchase.. location: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Keep going to a structure to see a man standing watching over the big structure, alongside a dead body. In that body, you will find the Royal House Scroll. [Map Link]. description: Sorcery scroll of the Carian royal family, the heads of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Can be given to a learned sorcerer to gain access to the following sorceries: -Glintblade Phalanx-Carian Slicer

Two Fingers Prayerbook. type: Spell Unlock. usage: Give to a learned cleric to unlock Lord's Heal and Lord's Aid for purchase.. location: Located nearby a fireplace in the Fortified Manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital. description: Prayerbook containing incantations of the Two Fingers.An item once entrusted to Tarnished worthy of lordship. Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations: - Lord's Heal - Lord's Aid

Assassin's Prayerbook. type: Spell Unlock. usage: Give to a learned cleric to unlock Assassin's Approach and Darkness for purchase.. location: Can be found behind the second Imp Statue door in Roundtable Hold, the first door will require one Key to open, and the second door behind the first requires two keys to open. So you will need three keys total to unlock this.. description: Prayerbook of the Roundtable Hold's assassins. Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations: - Assassin's Approach - Darkness

Golden Order Principia. type: Spell Unlock/ Quest. usage: Give to a learned cleric to unlock Radagon's Rings of Light and Law of Regression for purchase.. location: Located in a chair hanging from the ceiling directly above the[Erdtree Sanctuary site in Leyndell, Royal Capital. ([Map Link]) From the Erdtree Sanctuary site in Leyndell, Royal Capital, exit the east side of the room. Once outside, climb up the root to the left that circles back into the building's 2nd floor. Once inside, exit the only door and immediately turn left to jump down to a nearby roof. Once on the roof, a broken window can be used to get back inside. After entering the broken window, climb the root crossing the room to reach the Golden Order Principia, which is located in the chair hanging from the ceiling.. description: Prayerbook of the Golden Order fundamentalists. A dense and complex academic treatise that contains the Order's fundamental principles. Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations: Radagon's Rings of Light Law of Regression

Dragon Cult Prayerbook. type: Spell Unlock. usage: Give to a learned cleric to unlock Lightning Spear, Honed Bolt, and Electrify Armament for purchase.. location: Dropped by a knight patrolling immediately south of the Liurnia Artist's Shack[Map Link]. description: Prayerbook of the capital's ancient dragon cult. A text of the knights' faith that arose after the War of the Ancient Dragons. Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations: - Lightning Spear- Honed Bolt- Electrify Armament

Ancient Dragon Prayerbook. type: Spell Unlock. usage: Give to a learned cleric to unlock Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear and Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike for purchase.. location: In the middle of the main hall after finding the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths Farum Azula Site of Grace, in Crumbling Farum Azula[Map Link]. description: Prayerbook of the capital's ancient dragon cult. A lost tome that never reached the Lands Between. Contains red lightning incantations. Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations: - Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear - Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike

Fire Monks' Prayerbook. type: Spell Unlock. usage: Give to a learned cleric to unlock O, Flame! and Surge, O Flame! for purchase.. location: Liurnia: Found on a corpse in a Fire Monk outpost in the southern landmass[Map Link]. description: Prayerbook of the Fire Monks, who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants far to the north. Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations: - O, Flame! - Surge, O Flame!

Giant's Prayerbook. type: Spell Unlock. usage: Give to a learned cleric to unlock Giantsflame Take Thee and Flame, Fall Upon Them for purchase.. location: Inside a chest at the very top of Guardian's Garrison in Mountaintops of the Giants. It's in a tower behind NPC mini-boss Chief Guardian Arghanthy, up a ladder. [Map Link]. description: Prayerbook that contains the secrets of the Fire Giants. Kept hidden by the prelates who monitor the Giant's Flame. Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations: - Giantsflame Take Thee- Flame, Fall Upon Them

Godskin Prayerbook. type: Spell Unlock. usage: Give to a learned cleric to unlock Black Flame and Black Flame Blade for purchase.. location: Stormveil Castle. From the Rampart Tower site of grace, head outside. Take a running jump onto the roof across. From the roof, drop down to the grassy courtyard. Descend down the nearby stairs and follow its path until you find a fog wall. Use a Stonesword Key to pass through it and the prayerbook will be in one of the two chests inside the room. [Map Link]. description: Prayerbook bound in supple skin.Incantations of the god-slaying black flame are written within. Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations: - Black Flame- Black Flame Blade

Hefty Cracked Pot. effect: Container required for crafting hefty cracked pot items. description: This hefty empty pot somehow mends itself when broken. Essential vessel for crafting hefty cracked pot items. The materials and magics sealed within deploy their effects when the pot is thrown. The greater potentates of Bonny Village craft these and store them in a frozen gaol.

Beast Horn. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Horn suffused with spirituality. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting horned beasts of the realm of shadow. The Crucible has a particularly strong influence on the beasts of the realm of shadow, causing many to grow horns despite the characteristics of their species.

Spirit Calculus. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: An exceedingly rare to find calculus, suffused with spirituality. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting horned beasts in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Has a distinctive acrid odor, which some claim to be a sign of particular spiritual potency.

Pearlescent Scale. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A glassy and glistening fragment of pearlescent hue. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting lamprey. These retrograde scales are found embedded deep within the skin of lamprey.

Scorpion Liver. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Fresh organ of a spider-scorpion. It is referred to as 'liver,' but no one is quite sure of its purpose. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting spider-scorpions. A delicacy known for its numbing toxins.

Fly Mold. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A species of fungus known for its deathly sweet stench. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting man-flies. Cultivated using the flesh and blood of man-flies, it can serve as pot innards.

Rada Fruit. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Berry-like fruit that grows into spiritgrave grass. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the realm of shadow, though its bitter taste makes it unsuitable for consumption by humans.

Redflesh Mushroom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Red mushroom that grows in sullen lands. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the realm of shadow. The flesh of the mushroom is similar to raw meat, and can serve as pot innards.

Whiteflesh Mushroom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Milky-white mushroom that grows in sullen lands. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the realm of shadow. The flesh of the mushroom is similar to raw meat, and can serve as pot innards.

Knot Resin. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Knot-shaped lump of resin that exuded from the roots of trees. Material used for crafting items. Found near tree roots everywhere in the realm of shadow. Serves as a primitive catalyst, making it suitable for processing using sorceries, incantations, and the like.

Dewgem. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Succulent plant that has supped on night-tinged dew. Material used for crafting items. Glows at night and blossoms mainly at the waterside. Said to have been used in the practice of sprite medicine long ago.

Black Pyrefly. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Fiery butterfly with black cinder wings. Material used for crafting items. Flies in war-torn lands that have been scoured by Messmer's flame. They burn in dark and slender ribbons of fire.

Glintslab Firefly. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Glintstone firefly improved by selective breeding. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found near Manus Metyr. The glintstone that produces its light has become freakishly enlarged, while the span of its life is as brief as a whisper.

Yellow Fulgurbloom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Yellow flower that crackles with lightning. Material used for crafting items. Blossoms in the realm of shadow's underground gravesites and places struck by lightning. Imbued with yellow lightning's essence.

Shadow Sunflower. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A large flower that blooms facing the Scadutree. Material used for crafting items. Found near the Scadutree. These flowers, veiled in shadow and covered in impenetrable thorns, are suffused with profound holinessmuch akin to the Scadutree itself.

Toxic Mossling. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A large moss animal glutted with poison. Material used for crafting items. Found in poison swamps. Round and plump, like a darling infant.

Scarlet Bud. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A large, rotten bud that will never come into bloom. Material used for crafting items. Grows in lands blighted by the scarlet rot. There was a time when these buds were not touched by the scarlet rot's blightwhen they were the symbol of the small church deep in the ancient ruins of Rauh.

Sanguine Amaryllis. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A bloodflower with meaty petals. Material used for crafting items. Grown by bloodfiends in pools of blood. Perhaps even the fiends admire blood's beauty.

Frozen Maggot. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Frozen maggots that somehow continue to wriggle. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found in gaols. The maggots develop in great-jar innards, and are an invaluable source of sustenance to the prisoners.

Deep-Purple Lily. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A deep-purple water lily that is on the verge of wilting. Material used for crafting items. Grows in the blue flower field at the coast. Like a syrupy poison, its nectar lulls the imbiber into sweet, velvety sleep.

Nectarblood Burgeon. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A young shoot, heavy with velvety purple nectar. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. Said to burgeon forth where the nectar-like blood of abandoned Trina pooled.

Winter-Lantern Fly. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Winged insect carrying a dangling frenzied flame grape. Material used for crafting items. Flies lazily around the abyssal forest. Said to be heralds of the aging untouchable. On seeing these, the wise know to stay well clear of that place.

Swollen Grape. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: An eyeball of the frenzied flame that has swollen from within. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. Marked with fingerprint burns, proof of having being touched directly by the Three Fingers' embrace.

Grave Keeper's Brainpan. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Skull bone of an old grave keeper. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found in hidden grave of Charo. The old grave keepers are boatsmen, and continue to summon the dead even after withering away.

Horn-Strewn Excrement. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Excrement of a large carnivorous beast containing fragments of horns. Material used for crafting items. Found underfoot in places like forests where beasts dwell. It is said that the deadliest of the horned predators enjoy the sport of hunting and devouring other horned creatures.

Gas Stone. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Block of stone infused with hot gas. Material used for crafting items. Found in the ruined forges. Perhaps these were once used as fuel for the smithing process.

Ghostflame Bloom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Ghostflame flower that grows in gravesites. Material used for crafting items. Blossoms in the hidden grave of Charo. Of a pair with another gravesite flower, the grave violet. All but incorporeal, it burns without so much as a sound.

Grave Cricket. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Cricket that produces a raspy cry. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found near stone coffins. The sound of these crickets are often taken to be the rustling of the restless dead, or sometimes the sound of their calling voices.

Dragon's Calorbloom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Flower with an uncanny shape, coursing with hot blood. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A single flower is said to blossomonly oncefrom the hearts of dead warriors who oft partook of the Dragon Communion.

Finger Mimic. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Light-pink mushroom resembling a wizened finger. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. Used to by those who wish to become fingers to induce hallucinations. They call these mushrooms the stillborn of the Two Fingers.

Empyrean-Blood Burgeon. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A young shoot, heavy with Empyrean blood. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. Said to burgeon forth from where the golden blood of Miquella, the wounded Empyrean, pooled.

Congealed Putrescence. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Bruise-colored putrescence that oozes from stone coffins, congealed into a large viscous lump. Material used for crafting items. Found underground in the land to where stone coffins drift. The putrescence is what remains of the impure lives kept within the stone coffins.

Roundrock. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Round piece of rock shaped by the water's current. Can be used for crafting, or simply for throwing at enemies. Found on the ground at places like river banks. It breaks easily, owing to extensive cracking.

Spiritgrave Stone. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A piece of a gravestone that has started to turn into a spirit. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found on the Gravesite Plain. In places to where the dead have been brought since antiquity, the oldest gravestones turn into spirits and then fade away,

Rauh Burrow. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Oval-shaped stone bearing an engraving. Material used for crafting items. Relic found at the ancient ruins of Rauh. In the center of the stone is a small nest-like hole. Once this is inhabited by a sprite, the stone can be used as a ritual implement.

Ember of Messmer. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Serpentine, cord-like ember. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found in Scadu Altus. A remnant of Messmer's flame, the symbol of the crusade, it continues to smolder as if crawling across the ground.

Blessed Bone Shard. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Shard of bone with a golden shine. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A bone fragment touched by the gold of the Scadutree, broken from the remains of the warriors who perished in the realm of shadow. A blessing such as this is said to be the greatest honor that can be granted to the dead.

Red Fulgurbloom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Flower that crackles with red lightning. Material used for crafting items. Found at the jagged peak on the south coast. Said to bloom where the red lightning of the ancient dragons strikes the earth.

Nailstone. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Flake-like stone shard with a faint fingerprint engraving. Material used for crafting items. Found at finger ruins. A piece that came loose from the tip of one of the column-like stone fingers that grow at finger ruins.

Sharp Gravel Stone. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A particularly sharp piece of gravel stone. Material used for crafting items. Found at the jagged peak on the south coast. The scale of an ancient dragon that has supped on the blood of lesser dragons.

Furnace Visage. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A smaller imitation of the furnace golem's visage. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A stone mask surrounded by curled horns, depicting the fell god of fire that haunts the sagas of the hornsent.

Aeonian Butterfly. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A butterfly with withered, scarlet wings found in the swamp of Aeonia.Material used for crafting items. According to myth, these butterflies were once the wings of the Goddess of Rot herself.

Albinauric Bloodclot. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: The thick, coagulated blood of the Albinaurics.Material used for crafting items. Albinaurics are lifeforms made by human hands. Thus, many believe them to live impure lives, untouched by the Erdtree's grace.

Altus Bloom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A golden-tinged flower from a succulent plant that blooms on the Altus Plateau.Material used for crafting items. Said to be a funereal flower in an era long past, before the Erdtree grew.

Arteria Leaf. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Dark red leaves with thick, swollen veins. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A faint pulse can be felt in the veins. Stirs the blood, providing an enlivening effect.

Beast Blood. effect: Material used for crafting materials. description: Fresh beast blood, glinting with gold.Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting carnivorous beasts. This glimmering blood never rots or decays.

Beast Liver. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: The fresh liver of a beast; a luscious fruit of life.Material used for crating items.Found by hunting herbivorous beast.Dried liver boost damage negation.

Bloodrose. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Blood-slick roses that bloom in festering blood.Material used for crafting items. Particularly beloved by those who serve the Lord of Blood. Glory to his inevitable reign.

Budding Cave Moss. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves, speckled with tiny, yellow flowers.Material used for crafting items. It is primarily used in perfumes.

Budding Horn. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A rarely-seen specimen of a young, budding horn.Material used for crafting items.Found by hunting herbivorous beasts. This horn began to sprout on a beast that typically bears no horn. Perhaps it's a vestige of the primordial crucible.
Cave Moss. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves. Material used in crafting items. A fundamental ingredient for medicinal boluses.

Cracked Crystal. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A cracked, impure, degraded, and altogether unremarkable crystal.Material used for crafting items Widely found in crystal tunnels.

Crystal Cave Moss. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves, laced with fine crystals.Material used for crafting items. Among mosses, it possesses unique medicinal properties.

Crab Eggs. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Eggs of large crabs which dwell in the shallows.Materials used for crafting items. A nutritious foodstuff that warms from within. The flavor is exquisite. Only those of comfort and means know the truth:a crab's eggs are more delectable than its meat.
Crystal Bud. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A young plant, crystalized before it could mature.Material used for crafting items. Widely found in Liurnia Lake.

Dewkissed Herba. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A herb that grows in the false night in and around the Eternal City.Material used for crafting items. Soaked in arcane dew, it gives off the faint glow of starlight.

Erdleaf Flower. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A dusky-yellow flower that has started to fade and wilt. Material used for crafting items. Found throughout the Lands Between. Said to grow from the old fallen leaves of the Erdtree, these flowers serve as the base material for a number of sorcery techniques.

Eye of Yelough. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A shrub fruit bursting with ripened pulp.Material used for crafting items. Grown in lands afflicted by frenzy, it's used for its pain-relieving properties... Though it's also known to be a dangerous intoxicant.

Faded Erdleaf Flower. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: An Erdleaf flower that has faded into a plate scarlet, found blooming in rotten lands.Material used for crafting items. Said to be fed by leaves that fell from the Erdtree in days of antiquity.

Fire Blossom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A half-ashen and smoldering flower that blooms on the mountaintops of the Giants.Material used for crafting items. Fertilized by the sparks from the forge at the peak where burns the flame of ruin.
Flight Pinion. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Flight feather of a bird of prey.Material used for crafting items.Commonly used for arrow fletchings.

Formic Rock. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Rock formed from solidified giant ant venom. Highly acidic.Material used for crafting items. Found near Ainsel River and other places where giant ants live.

Four-Toed Fowl Foot. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Foot of a four-toed fowl.Material used for crafting items.In the Lands Between, having three digits is seen as a bad omen. As such, the rarer four-toed fowl's is a gift of great luck indeed.
Fulgurbloom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Yellow flower that grows in lightning-struck lands.Material used for crafting items.Imbued with traces of lightning's essence.

Glintstone Firefly. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A firefly whose glowing tail has hardened into glintstone, widely found in Liurnia Lake.Material used for crafting items. Alas, now that its tail is glintstone, it can no longer beguile potential mates.

Glintstone Scrap. effect: Break gem, using FP to produce a magic bolt.. description: Piece of glintstone tinged with unstable magic. Found in crystal tunnels.Break gem, using FP to produce a magic bolt.Poor quality and thereby easily broken, a sorcerer wouldn't give it a second look.

Gold-Tinged Excrement. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Someone's excrement. It has a golden tinge. Material used for crafting items. Often hidden in woods and thickets. Gold-tinged excrement is a highly stable substance; it doesn't dry out, nor does it lose its customary warmth or scent. For better or for worse, it remains as it is.

Golden Centipede. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: The golden, desiccated remains of a centipede. Material used for crafting items. Kept as a fetish by Golden Order fundamentalists, especially the hunters of Those Who Live in Death. As such, they are found near churches and similar. do not

Golden Dung. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Someone's excrement. It has a golden tinge. Material used for crafting items. Gold-tinged excrement is a highly stable substance; it doesn't dry out, nor does it lose its customary warmth or scent. For better or for worse, it remains as it is.

Golden Sunflower. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A golden sunflower that grows facing the Erdtree.Material used for crafting items.Found near Minor Erdtrees. At the foot of the Erdtree, they retain their color, along with a powerful holy essence.
Golden Rowa. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A Rowa fruit tinted with gold.Material used for crafting items. Easily found near the Erdtree.

Golden Sunflower. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A golden sunflower that grows facing the Erdtree.Material used for crafting items.Found near Minor Erdtrees. At the foot of the Erdtree, they retain their color, along with a powerful holy essence.

Grave Violet. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A purple flower that blooms in graveyards.Material used for crafting items. The hue of ghostflame, it's believed to be useful in calling forth spirits.

Gravel Stone. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A small clump of sharp, pointed stones.Material used for crafting items. Such compound stones, found in lands once beset by ancient dragons, are said to be the scales of those very beasts.
Great Dragonfly Head. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Head of a large dragonfly.Material used for crafting items.Long believed to have the ability to neutralize poisons.

Herba. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Evergreen leaves that give off a faint light.Material used for crafting items.This very common medicinal plant can be found in thickets and elsewhere.

Human Bone Shard. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Fragment of bone with dun mottling.Material used for crafting items.Found by hunting Those Who Live in Death. Lamentably brittle, it crumbles at the lightest caress.

Land Octopus Ovary. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Puffy, milky white ovary of a land octopus.Material used for crafting items.Land octopuses eat humans in order to bear young, and theirs is the blood that runs through these ovaries.

Living Jar Shard. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A fragment of a living jar, hardened after its death.Material used for crafting items. Such fragments command a high price due to the magical power locked within. This leaves the living jars unfortunate targets for poachers.

Lump of Flesh. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A lump of beast flesh filled with rich juices.Material used for crafting items.Found by hunting carnivorous beast.Meat suitable for a rustic feast.

Melted Mushroom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A mushroom that grows in the false night in and around the Eternal City.Material used for crafting items. It drips with a viscous fluid that behaves much like oil.

Miquella's Lily. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A delicate water lily of unalloyed gold that has started to fade and wilt.Material used for crafting items.Exeedingly rare to find. A flower signifying faith in the Haligtree.Thought to be beloved by the Empyrean Miquella in his youth.

Miranda Powder. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Pollen from a man-eating miranda flower.Material used for crafting items. Throughout history, perfumers have prized this extremely fragrant form of miranda pollen, not yet scattered into the air.
Slumbering Egg. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Owl eggs that will never hatch.Material used for crafting items. Prized as a symbol of the most sublime slumber.

Mushroom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A fungal growth that thrives in damp thickets and elsewhere.Material used for crafting items.Its thick, spongy flesh makes it a key component in throwing pots.

Nascent Butterfly. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: An arcane butterfly with translucent wings.Material used for crafting items.Exceedingly rare to find. This butterfly appears as if it's just emerged from its cocoon for its entire life.
Poisonbloom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Flower that grows in toxic terrain.Material used for crafting items.Poisonous, but may also provide the cure.
Rimed Crystal Bud. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A young plant, frozen into a crystal before it could mature.Material used for crafting items. Widely found in cold regions.

Root Resin. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Resin secreted from the roots of the Greattree.Can also be found near trees on the surface.Material used in crafting items. The roots of the Greattree were once linked to those of the Erdtree, or so they say, and it is for this reason catacombs are built around Greattree roots.

Rowa Fruit. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Berry-like red fruits that grow in shrubs.Material used for crafting items.Easily found everywhere in the Lands Between, it is primarily used in preserved foods.

Ruin Fragment. effect: Material used for crafting items.. description: Stone fragment found near places where ruins have fallen from the sky. Can be used for crafting, or simply for throwing at enemies. These shards of stone are believed to have once been part of a temple in the sky. They glow with a faint light from within.

Sacramental Bud. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: An immature bud containing fresh blood.Material used for crafting items. Believed to originate long ago from a strain of buds cultivated with youthful, sacramental blood.

Sanctuary Stone. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A rare piece of stone fragment found near places where ruins have fallen from the sky.Material used for crafting items. It feeds and strengthens the light as it shines.

Silver Firefly. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Firefly that gives off a silvery light. Material used in crafting items. Found near bodies of cold water untouched by sunlight. The light of fireflies is believed to have an alluring magic. Silver light is considered to invite riches.

Sliver of Meat. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A slice of thinly carved beast flesh.Material used for crating items.Found by hunting herbivorous beast.The dried meat toughens the constitution.

Strip of White Flesh. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Thin strips of flesh taken from a bloodless creature.Material used for crafting items.The dried meat toughens the constitution, boosting resistance. It'sknown for its long-lasting effect.
Slumbering Egg. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Owl eggs that will never hatch.Material used for crafting items. Prized as a symbol of the most sublime slumber.

Strip of White Flesh. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: Thin strips of flesh taken from a bloodless creature.Material used for crafting items.The dried meat toughens the constitution, boosting resistance. It'sknown for its long-lasting effect.

Tarnished Golden Sunflower. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A large flower that blooms facing the Erdtree.Material used for crafting items.Found near Minor Erdtrees. Though wilted and faded, it still retains holy essence.

Toxic Mushroom. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A mushroom covered in toxic mold that grows in rotten lands.Material used for crafting items. A skilled hand can repurpose its toxic mold into an effective ward against scarlet rot.

Trina's Lily. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A pale purple water lily that is on the verge of wilting.Material used for crafting items.Exceedingly rare to find.A symbol of faith in St. Trina.Dulls the senses, preventing agitation.

Turtle Neck Meat. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A splendid, lengthy cut of turtle neck meat. Material used for crafting items. Considered an especially nutritious ingredient In the south of the Lands Between.
Volcanic Stone. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A smoldering rock containing hot gas. Material used for crafting items. Found on Mt. Gelmir.

Yellow Ember. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: An ember taken from an eye socket of a corpse.Material used for crafting items. A sign that the deceased suffered from the flame of frenzy. This grape has ripened and burst.

Rimed Rowa. effect: Material used for crafting items. description: A berry-like fruit, thought to be the original strain of Rowa.Material used for crafting items.Found in frigid highlands. This hardy species takes root even when frozen solid.

Blue Cipher Ring. type: Reusable. effect: Answers requests for summoning from hunters. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Puts the wearer in ready state to answer should someone in another world call for rescue. You will be summoned to their world as a hunter. During hunter multiplayer, your objective will be to defeat the invader of the summoned world.

White Cipher Ring. type: Reusable. effect: When invaded, request the aid of a hunter. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Allows you to automatically request for a hunter from another world to come to your rescue when your world is invaded. (Summoning is not always possible.) One of the lost mystic codes said to have been bestowed by the Two Fingers.

Furlcalling Finger Remedy. type: Consumable. effect: Reveals co-op and hostile summoning signs. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Craftable item. Reveals cooperative and competitive multiplayer signs. Co-op summoning signs will be shown in gold, while hostile summoning signs will be shown in red. Multiplayer begins when you summon a player from another world through their sign.

Finger Severer. type: Reusable. effect: Sends another, or oneself, home. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Use as a Host of Fingers to select a summoned player and send them back to their world. Use when you have been summoned to another player's world to return to your own world. This phantom blade severs the link formed by a Furled Finger, but the maidens scorn those who abuse its use.

Tarnished's Furled Finger. type: Reusable. effect: Creates cooperative multiplayer summon sign. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Creates a summon sign for cooperative multiplayer. Arrive as a cooperator (Furled Finger) with the objective of defeating the area boss of the world to which you were summoned. A finger of corpse wax, furled like a hook. It is a relic of those who came before, left to help those who would come after.

Duelist's Furled Finger. type: Reusable. effect: Creates competitive multiplayer summon sign.. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Creates a summon sign for competitive multiplayer. Arrive as an adversary (Duelist) with the objective of defeating the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned. A finger of corpse wax, furled like a hook. The bronze adornments are the mark of a duelist.

Tarnished's Wizened Finger. type: Reusable. effect: Used to write messages to other worlds. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Messages menu.) Use to write messages. Your messages will be conveyed to other worlds, allowing other players to read them. A finger of corpse wax, so emaciated the bone is visible. It is a relic of those who came before, left to help those who would come after.

Bloody Finger. type: Reusable. effect: Attempts invasion of other player's world. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Attempts an invasion of another player's world. If successful, you will arrive as an invader (Bloody Finger) with the objective of defeating the Host of Fingers of that world. Glistening blood has been siphoned into the nail of this finger. Its sickly pale skin feels nothing now, but the nail still aches with sweetest pain.

Taunter's Tongue. type: Reusable. effect: Lures in invaders. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Lures in invaders. This allows your world to be invaded without any Furled Finger cooperators present, and it also shortens the interval between windows of opportunity for invasion. Additionally, enables the arrival of a second invader to join when a cooperator is present. (With two invaders, the maximum number of cooperators becomes one.) Dark Souls

Grace Mimic. type: Consumable. effect: Light shows the path, but without order. description: A fetish indicating the guidance of grace. Craftable item. Similar to grace, this fetish draws rays guiding the way, only without any sense of order. Useful as a last resort for those who have lost their way, or for use by those who believe that unrefined guidance will lead to truer encounters.

Small Golden Effigy. type: Reusable. effect: Sends a co-op sign to summoning pools. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Send a cooperative summon sign to several nearby summoning pools (activated pools only). In cooperative multiplayer, your objective will be to defeat the area boss of the world to which you were summoned.

Small Red Effigy. type: Reusable. effect: Sends a hostile sign to summoning pools. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Send a competitive summon sign to several nearby summoning pools (activated pools only). In competitive multiplayer, your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned.

Festering Bloody Finger. type: Consumable. effect: Attempts invasion of other player's world. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Consumed upon use. Attempts an invasion of another player's world. If successful, you will arrive as an invader (Bloody Finger) with the objective of defeating the Host of Fingers of that world. This furled finger is blackened with blood congestion. It seems to have been chopped off rather unceremoniously.

Recusant Finger. type: Reusable. effect: Attempts invasion of other player's world. description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Attempts an invasion of another player's world. If successful, you will arrive as an invader (Recusant) with the objective of defeating the Host of Fingers of that world. This furled finger is covered in snake scales. An heirloom of the lord of the Volcano Manor, bequeathed to Tarnished who have become family.

Scriptstone. type: Consumable. effect: Reveals more messages from other worlds. description: Ruin Fragment with a cipher inscription. Craftable item. Uses FP to reveal more messages from other worlds. Words are gregarious things, drawn to one another much as people are.

Phantom Bloody Finger. type: Consumable. effect: Attempts repeat invasion of last targeted world. description: Item for online play.Obtained after invading another world.Consumed upon use. Attempts another invasion of the most recently invaded world.This may come in handy should separation from the Host of Fingers force a temporary retreat.

entity: Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider
text: Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Commander Gaius, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Both were as elder brothers to the lion, and both were cursed from birth. In spite of, or perhaps because of this very reason, Gaius was both Messmer's friend and the leader of his men.. boss: Commander Gaius. option 1: Weapon: Sword Lance. option 2: Sorcery: Blades of Stone. value: 30,000

source.entity: Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider

text: Remembrance of the Impaler. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Messmer the Impaler, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. A malevolent snake writhed within Messmer, and so his very mother plucked out his eye and put in its place a seal of grace. Yet, having done so, her fear compelled her to secret away her child within the realm of shadow. Hidden away—keeping company with the original sin, and a hatred that would not be confined.. boss: Messmer the Impaler. option 1: Weapon: Spear of the Impaler. option 2: Incantation: Messmer's Orb. value: 40,000

Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of the Scadutree Avatar, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Scadutree is the shadow of the Erdtree. Born of dark notions that bear no sense of Order, that twist and bend its stock, rendering it brittle.. boss: Scadutree Avatar. option 1: Weapon: Shadow Sunflower Blossom. option 2: Incantation: Land of Shadow. value: 40,000

entity: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight
text: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Once a Carian princess, Rellana disavowed her birthright and chose to stand at Messmer's side instead, knowing full well that not even the brilliance of the moon could grant him succor. Before long, she became known as the Sword of Messmer.. boss: Rellana, Twin Moon Knight. option 1: Weapon: Rellana's Twinblade. option 2: Sorcery: Rellana's Twin Moons. value: 30,000

source.entity: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight

entity: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud
text: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Romina, Saint of the Bud, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. After the church was burned to the ground, Romina discovered a twisted divine element, which she weaved into the baleful scarlet rot. Perhaps then, the buds might find somewhere to gain purchase once more, within the scorched remains.. boss: Romina, Saint of the Bud. option 1: Weapon: Poleblade of the Bud. option 2: Incantation: Rotten Butterflies. value: 30,000

source.entity: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud

text: Remembrance of the Dancing Lion. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of the Dancing Lion, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. When the Impaler's army assailed the tower, the ritual of the lion dance was turned toward martial ends—its divinity, its fury, its light-footed beauty.. boss: Divine Beast Dancing Lion. option 1: Talisman:Enraged Divine Beast. option 2: Ash of War:Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp. value: 30,000

entity: Remembrance of a God and a Lord
text: Remembrance of a God and a Lord. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Radahn, consort of Miquella, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. In their childhood, Miquella saw in Radahn a lord. His strength, and his kindness, that stood in stark contrast with their afflicted selves. And so Miquella made his heartfelt wish. That Radahn would one day be his king consort.. boss: Radahn, Consort of Miquella. option 1: Greatsword of Radahn (Lord)/Greatsword of Radahn (Light). option 2: Light of Miquella. value: 50,000

source.entity: Remembrance of a God and a Lord

entity: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame
text: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. As the golden barbs inflicted eternal agony upon him, Midra held fast to Nanaya's entreaty: "Endure." The word was a curse.. boss: Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame. option 1: Weapon: Greatsword of Damnation. option 2: Incantation: Midra's Flame of Frenzy. value: 40,000

source.entity: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame

entity: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers
text: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Metyr, the Mother of Fingers, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The mother of all Two Fingers and Fingercreepers was in turn a magnificently gleaming daughter of the Greater Will, and the first shooting star to fall upon the Lands Between.. boss: Metyr, Mother of Fingers. option 1: Weapon: Staff of the Great Beyond. option 2: Weapon:Gazing Finger. value: 40,000

source.entity: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers

text: Remembrance of Putrescence. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of the Putrescent Knight, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. All tainted flesh eventually becomes putrescence, and this clump of it imbibed St. Trina's nectar, which granted it eternal rest. And so it was that putrescence became her knight.. boss: Putrescent Knight. option 1: Weapon: Putrescence Cleaver. option 2: Sorcery: Vortex of Putrescence. value: 30,000

Heart of Bayle. type: Remembrance. description: The biatrial heart of Bayle the Dread. Dotted with horn-like gravel stones and glistening with deep-red liquor. Gorge upon this at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion to absorb Bayle's power. The purest form of Communion, in the words of its priestess.. boss: Bayle the Dread. option 1: Incantation:Bayle's Flame Lightning. option 2: Incantation:Bayle's Tyranny. value: 0

Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor Spirit, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader.Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Ancestral spirits exist as a phenomenon beyond the purview of the Erdtree. Life sprouts from death, as it does from birth. Such is the way of the living.. boss: Regal Ancestor Spirit. option 1: Weapon:Winged Greathorn. option 2: Talisman:Ancestral Spirit's Horn. value: 30,000

Remembrance of theNaturalborn. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader.Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. A malformed star born in the flightless void far away. Once destroyed an Eternal City and took away their sky. A falling star of ill omen.. boss: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void. option 1: Ash of War:Waves of Darkness. option 2: Weapon:Bastard's Stars. value: 30,000

Remembrance of theLichdragon. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Lichdragon Fortissax, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. After Godwyn the Golden became the Prince of Death, the ancient dragon fought long and hard against the Death within its companion. Alas, victory was never achieved and its only reward was corruption.. boss: Lichdragon Fortissax. option 1: Incantation:Fortissax's Lightning Spear. option 2: Incantation:Death Lightning. value: 30,000

Remembrance of the Fire Giant. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Fire Giant, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Fire Giant is a survivor of the War against the Giants. Upon realizing the flames of their forge would never die, Queen Marika marked him with a curse. "O trifling giant, mayest thou tend thy flame for eternity.". boss: Fire Giant. option 1: Weapon:Giant's Red Braid. option 2: Incantation:Burn, O Flame!. value: 30,000

Remembrance of the Grafted. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Godrick, the Grafted, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. A feeble man sought power through the grotesque act of grafting. "One day we'll return together, to our home, bathed in rays of gold.". boss: Godrick the Grafted. option 1: Weapon:Axe of Godrick. option 2: Weapon:Grafted Dragon. value: 20,000

entity: Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen
text: Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader.Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. In her youth, Rennala was a prominent champion who charmed the academy with her lunar magic, becoming its master. She also led the Glintstone Knights and established the house of Caria as royalty.. boss: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. option 1: Sorcery:Rennala's Full Moon. option 2: Weapon:Carian Regal Scepter. value: 20,000

source.entity: Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen

text: Remembrance of theBlasphemous. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Rykard took the form of a giant serpent that he might devour, grow, and live eternally. "I understand. The road of blasphemy is long and perilous. One cannot walk it unprepared to sin.". boss: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. option 1: Sorcery:Rykard's Rancor. option 2: Weapon:Blasphemous Blade. value: 50,000

Remembrance of theStarscourge. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Starscourge Radahn, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader.Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Red Lion General wielded gravitational powers which he learned in Sellia during his younger days. All so he would never have to abandon his beloved but scrawny steed.. boss: Starscourge Radahn. option 1: Weapon:Starscourge Greatsword. option 2: Weapon:Lion Greatbow. value: 40,000

Remembrance of the Omen King. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Morgott, the Omen King, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader.Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Though born one of the graceless Omen, Morgott took it upon himself to become the Erdtree's protector. He loved not in return, for he was never loved, but nevertheless, love it he did.. boss: Morgott the Omen King. option 1: Weapon:Morgott's Cursed Sword. option 2: Reusable Tool:Regal Omen Bairn. value: 30,000

Remembrance of the Blood Lord. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Mohg, Lord of Blood, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader.Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Wishing to raise Miquella to full godhood, Mohg wished to become his consort, taking the role of monarch. But no matter how much of his bloody bedchamber he tried to share, he received no response from the young Empyrean.. boss: Mohg, Lord of Blood. option 1: Weapon:Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear. option 2: Incantation:Bloodboon. value: 30,000

Remembrance of the Rot Goddess. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Malenia, Goddess of Rot, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Miquella and Malenia are both the children of a single god. As such they are both Empyreans, but suffered afflictions from birth. One was cursed with eternal childhood, and the other harbored rot within. Carved into the Golden Tree Goddess of Rot, Recollection of Malenia Miquella and Malenia, are children of a single god because of this, the pair are god people, but, their lives are frail one, is forever immature, the other carries rot zei・jyaku the body is easy to enter, whether it's pathogens... or overly sentimental cursed I am Malenia. Blade of Miquella weak easy to beat. boss: Malenia, Blade of Miquella. option 1: Weapon:Hand of Malenia. option 2: Incantation:Scarlet Aeonia. value: 50,000

Remembrance of the Black Blade. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Maliketh, the Black Blade, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Maliketh was a shadowbound beast given to his Empyrean. Marika's sole need of her shadow was a vessel to lock away Destined Death. Even then, she betrayed him.. boss: Maliketh, the Black Blade. option 1: Weapon:Maliketh's Black Blade. option 2: Incantation:Black Blade. value: 30,000

Remembrance of Hoarah Loux. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of the warrior Hoarah Loux, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader.Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. When Godfrey, first Elden Lord was robbed of his grace, becoming Tarnished, he took with him his kinfolk and left the Lands Between. After the Long March of the Tarnished came to an end, Godfrey divested himself of kingship, becoming a simple warrior once more.. boss: Hoarah Loux, Warrior. option 1: Weapon:Axe of Godfrey. option 2: Ash of War:Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker. value: 30,000

Remembrance of theDragonlord. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Dragonlord whose seat lies at the heart of the storm beyond time is said to have been Elden Lord in the age before the Erdtree. Once his god was fled, the lord continued to await its return.. boss: Dragonlord Placidusax. option 1: Weapon:Dragon King's Cragblade. option 2: Incantation:Placidusax's Ruin. value: 30,000

Elden Remembrance. type: Remembrance. description: Remembrance of the Elden Beast, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. It was the vassal beast of the Greater Will and living incarnation of the concept of Order.. boss: Elden Beast. option 1: Weapon: Marika's Hammer. option 2: Weapon: Sacred Relic Sword. value: 50,000

Prattling Pate Lamentation. type: Prattling Pate. usage: Emits a blissful lamentation. location: Lamenter's Gaol: Lamenter's Gaol. Climb up the long ladder, cross the connecting stone bridge, and enter the room on the left, you'll find this key item on a corpse. [Map Link]. description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a blissful "Lamentation". The voice resounds, seeping into the brain. Weeping, weeping, weeping. Ever weeping.

Bondstone. type: Offensive. usage: Causes a spiritual explosion, consuming sprite dwelling within spritestone. location: From the entrance of the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, head north towards the edge, and head west, you will find an area with an item below in which you can jump. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. description: A large burrowstone studded with a perfectly white gem, said to be the polished form of a special kind of crystal. A ritual implement made to control explosions of spiritual power. Use to cause a spiritual explosion, consuming the sprite dwelling within spritestone. Bonds with the sprites were made to be broken.

Spritestone. type: Defensive. usage: Uses FP to release a sprite that slowly homes in on enemies. location: Location goes here.... description: A Rauh Burrow inhabited by a sprite. Craftable item. Uses FP to release a sprite that slowly homes in on enemies. After a short time, the sprite fades away into glittering lights, causing a spiritual explosion on its passing. According to the records left by hornsent scholars, there were also contrivances known as "bondstones" that could manipulate the moment that the sprite vanishes.

Horned Bairn. type: Defensive. usage: Uses FP to summon vengeful spirits surrounding caster. location: Drops from the Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit near the Ellac River Cave Site of Grace. [See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]. description: Doll of a tanglehorn bairn. Uses FP to summon vengeful spirits around the caster that autonomously chase down foes. Tangled horns are a symbol of spirituality, but most young born bearing the oversized horns meet a frightfully early demise. These fetishes are made to memorialize them.

Perfumed Oil of Ranah. type: Offensive. usage: Uses FP to spout flames forward. location: Looted from the corpse in the small island found East from Cerulean Coast. The island is accessed by traversing an underground cave passage located along the coast just south near the Cerulean Coast West Site of Grace. See the Perfumed Oil of Ranah location in the [Shadow of the Erdtree Map].. description: A small bottle wrapped in a bright-red cloth. Filled with flammable perfume oil. Uses FP to spout flames forward. The dancers of Ranah keep these concealed as they dance, marking their height of their passion with an explosion of searing flame and sweet, enticing scents.

Call of Tibia. type: Offensive. usage: Uses FP to summon one lost in death. location: Looted from a grave by a skeleton ambush. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. description: An ancient ceremonial tool that uses a grave keeper's skull as a catalyst. Craftable item. Uses FP to summon one lost in death at the spot that it is thrown. The creature spins and mows down foes in the vicinity three times before dissipating. The dead have long been left to wander; what they need is leadership.

Surging Frenzied Flame. type: Offensive. usage: Uses FP to spew frenzied flame. location: Drops off the untouchable enemies in the abyss. they can be spell parried, and the riposte does damage.. description: Spiritgrave stone burned by frenzied flame. Craftable item. Uses FP to place a stone on the ground, where it spews frenzied flames. Spirits are eternal, and yet frenzied flame melts them away regardless. No wonder the hornsent forbid the flame's use.

Golden Vow (Tool). type: Offensive. usage: Uses FP to increase attack and defense. location: Shadow Keep: x3 Can be found in the area with the big golden tree, it is guarded by a Black Knight. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map] Shadow Keep: At the end of the room, hanging from a body. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. description: Remains that turned into light after being blessed with an incantation of the Erdtree. Craftable item. Uses FP to rise into the air, increasing attack and defense of caster and nearby allies. The incantation serves as a rite that honors the comrades who placed their faith in the distant Erdtree and gave their lives in the crusade.

Fire Coil. type: Offensive. usage: Uses FP to conjure a tiny fire snake. location: X1 Can be found inside one of the right tent in the Messmer Soldiers Camp, near the Church of Consolation. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map] Shadow Keep: Enter the eastern side of the library of the First floor of the Storehouse. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map] Shadow Keep: x2 As you reach the fifth floor from the outside area, turn right and defeat the enemy on the alcove, there is an item there. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map] Shadow Keep: x3 From the Storehouse site of grace, find the ladder and climb it up, pass the enemies. Circle the area on your right and turn back, Head all the way back to find the item. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. description: A device of fire used by Messmer's soldiers. Lingering embers, bundled into a coil. Craftable item. Uses FP to conjure tiny fire snakes from the spot that it is thrown. The writhing snakes pursue foes. Fire was a symbol of the crusade, and even Messmer's rank-and-file soldiers would wield it.

Fire Spritestone. type: Offensive. usage: Uses FP to release a fire sprite that bounces along the ground. location: Past the door opened with the lever, turn to the right at the first forked path and past the shadow enemies, you will find the item on a body hanging on the edge. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map] North of the temple town ruins site of grace, past the red servants of rot, there is a cave, inside it you will find a Shadowpothead enemy. Beware of the poison traps littered around. Drops x3 Fire Spritestone, and Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook [1]. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. description: A Rauh Burrow inhabited by a fire sprite. Craftable item. Uses FP to release a fire sprite that bounces along the ground. The sprite pierces through enemies, dealing fire damage. Of all the sprites, the fire sprites are said to be the most boisterous in nature.

Glinting Nail. type: Offensive. usage: Uses FP to fire a shattering magic nail. location: Cathedral of Manus Metyr: Leave the main room from the opening on the side. Ride Torrent and circle the building, you will find a Marionette Soldier guarding this item. [Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Interactive Map]. description: Nailstone with shining fingerprints floating above. Craftable item. Uses FP to fling a magic nail that crumbles during flight. The lampreys that guard the finger ruins resemble fingers far more than they do humans, and so the finger-weavers imitated their sorcery.

Sunwarmth Stone. type: Deffensive. usage: Uses FP to continuously heal nearby allies. location: Location goes here.... description: Spiritgrave stone blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Craftable item. Uses FP to generate sunwarmth, continuously restoring the HP of those nearby. Has a more potent effect than a Warming Stone. Sunlight feels all the warmer in darkened lands.

Charming Branch. type: Offensive. usage: Uses FP to charm stabbed enemy and surrounding enemies. location: Location goes here.... description: Branch blessed with an incantation of unalloyed gold. Craftable item. Uses FP to stab an enemy, charming it and the surrounding enemies. Charmed enemies act as your allies for a short while. Those who would otherwise be at each other's throats are united in service to Miquella—as long as the charm that binds them remains intact.

Memory of Grace. type: General Use. usage: Lose all runes, return to last site of lost grace visited.. location: All Classes start the game with this item. description: The memory of first grace, which once guided bygone Tarnished to the Lands Between. Lose all runes and return to last site of grace visited. It is merely a cycle. Stand before the Elden Ring. Become the Elden Lord.

Spectral Steed Whistle. type: General Use. usage: Summon and ride spectral steed.. location: Received from Melina after meeting her at an overworld Site of Grace beyond the tutorial area.. description: A delicate goldwork ring. Can be used as a finger whistle. Sound the whistle to summon and ride Torrent, the spectral steed. (Dismounts steed when used while on horseback.) Upon his death, the spectral steed can be summoned again, but doing so drains the Flask of Crimson Tears.

Wraith Calling Bell. type: Offensive. usage: Uses FP to ring bell and calls prowling wraiths.. location: Laskyar Ruins Found in an underground room. The steps leading down can be found in the northwest section. [Map Link]. description: Bell used by worshippers of revenants. Ring bell, using FP to summon prowling wraiths. This can be done multiple times in a row. Wraiths are said to be the vengeful spirits of those who died when cursed. similar

Ancestral Infant's Head. type: Offensive. usage: Uses FP to spray spirit vapor.. location: Nokron, Eternal City Found in a chest guarded by an Ancestral Follower in a submerged ruin. [Map Link]. description: Skull of a very young ancestral spirit. Just think how many sproutings It might bear. Uses to spray spirit vapor inflicting magic damage.
